articles.title: I’ve spent years testing all kinds of gaming keyboard switches — these are the best mechanical, analog, and membrane clackers for Black Friday
articles.text:
I’ve spent years testing mechanical, analog, and membrane gaming keyboards — these are my top picks for Black Friday
In the battle of the keyboard switches, which comes out on top?
In the ever-expanding gaming keyboard market, there appears to be no end to the variety of shapes, sizes, and features available. One of the most important — and contentious — facets, though, has been (and probably always will be) switch type.
The intensity with which gamers debate the topic is hardly surprising, given how different switches can radically affect both feel and performance. Mechanical boards have long been touted as the only sensible option for those who take their gaming seriously, but alternatives are becoming increasingly viable in today’s space.
I’ve spent years testing clackers with every kind of switch imaginable, and below I’ve rounded up the best gaming keyboards featuring some of the most popular types. Keep an eye out for them in the Black Friday sales.
The original king
As mentioned, mechanical switches are often considered the top choice for gamers. This is largely thanks to their tactile feedback and instant response times, as well as their durability and repairability should they fail.
There are a variety of subtypes available, each having its own unique feel and advantages. What’s more, they can often be swapped out, giving gamers the chance to experiment to find what works best for them, without having to purchase an entirely new board.
The Logitech G316 X is a fine example of a mechanical keyboard. When I tested it, I found its switches satisfying and solid, and appreciated its feature-filled software and tough build. My main grievance with the G316 X, though, is its shallow tilt angle, which may bother some gamers more than others.
Another negative is its fairly useless display, although this doesn’t exactly hamper performance in any way. It’s also wired only, although that’s forgivable considering its reasonable price.
Sign up for breaking news, reviews, opinion, top tech deals, and more.
I also reviewed the Razer BlackWidow V4 Pro, another stellar mechanical keyboard that won me over with its sublime tactility and feedback, as well as its tank-like build quality. This is, however, a truly premium purchase, so best reserved for when it gets a doorbusting deal.
The new kid in town
A more modern switch type looking to usurp mechanical is analog. What sets keyboards with these switches apart is their adjustability: as the name suggests, they have a modularity that lets you change the point at which they actuate along their travel. This can be achieved via hotkeys, companion software, or even an integrated interactive screen in some cases.
There are plenty more adjustments and features available to analog switches besides. One of the most notable is Rapid Trigger (RT). This improves the speed of a quick succession of taps by dynamically altering the actuation point after the first press to allow for quicker registers. Some keyboards even let you manually adjust this RT actuation point yourself.
I’ve long sung the praises of SteelSeries’ Apex Pro as the paragon of analog keyboards. However, the Apex Pro certainly isn’t without its competitors. The Razer Huntsman V3 HE is perhaps its sternest rival; it impressed me with its tactile feel and blistering performance, pretty much equaling the Apex Pro in my mind.
Standing up for the underdog
Perhaps the most underappreciated switches for gamers are membrane. These are often seen as inferior to every other kind, maligned for their squishy feel and lack of feedback.
There is some truth to these charges, as mechanical and analog switches generally have a more robust and refined action that many gamers just can’t do without. But membrane switches have come on leaps and bounds in recent years, and they may no longer be such a dreadful choice.
One of the best gaming keyboards I’ve tested with these switches is the Corsair Skiff 100. Presses are soft and cushioned, which also means you get that trademark silence when hammering away at the keys. However, it doesn’t suffer performance-wise, as I found it perfectly capable when playing fast-paced games.
What’s more, it’s also one of the best budget gaming keyboards I’ve come across, costing considerably less than all of the aforementioned, despite having a full-size layout and a detachable wrist rest. You will have to settle for a wired connection, but this only helps to keep the costs down, and isn’t as restrictive as it is on gaming mice.
Conclusion
All three of the main switch types have their advantages and disadvantages, and there are boards containing each that are great for gaming. But the main takeaway is that if you want great performance while keeping costs down, there’s no reason not to consider a board with membrane switches.

articles.title: Estos son los 3 juegos que PlayStation Plus regalará en diciembre de 2026
articles.text:
Sony anunció los tres juegos que los suscriptores de PlayStation Plus podrán sumar a su biblioteca en diciembre: Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3+4, Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 y Amnesia: The Bunker. Estarán disponibles desde el martes 1 de diciembre hasta el lunes 4 de enero, según el blog oficial de PlayStation.
La compañía los presentó como los juegos mensuales para todos los miembros del servicio. Quien los reclame dentro de ese plazo podrá jugarlos mientras mantenga la suscripción activa. Sony aclara que la oferta puede variar según la región y remite a la página de PlayStation.com para consultar el detalle de cada país.
El anuncio lo firmó Adam Michel, director sénior de servicios de juego de Sony Interactive Entertainment. Los títulos llegan con casi cinco semanas de margen: el período de reclamo se extiende más allá de las fiestas de fin de año.
Tres juegos de géneros muy distintos
Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3+4 estará en su edición para dos generaciones de consolas, PS5 y PS4. Reúne las versiones renovadas del tercer y el cuarto juego de la saga de skate, con más patinadores, parques nuevos, trucos adicionales y música.
Según Sony, los escenarios de ambas entregas fueron rehechos en resolución 4K, con objetivos simplificados y el formato clásico de dos minutos por carrera. También incluye los modos Create-A-Skater y Create-A-Park, que permiten diseñar patinadores y parques. Por primera vez, los jugadores pueden crear objetivos propios y compartirlos con amigos.
En PS5, el juego corre en 4K nativo a 60 cuadros por segundo en el modo Fidelity. Sony advierte que la salida en 4K requiere un televisor o monitor compatible.
Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 también llegará para PS5 y PS4. Es un juego de acción y rol basado en la serie de animación: el jugador crea su propio personaje, recorre Conton City y se alía con figuras conocidas de la franquicia para entrenar y enfrentar a distintos enemigos.
Tiene modos multijugador en línea. Los usuarios pueden pelear contra otros jugadores de todo el mundo o participar en las Raid Battles, combates cooperativos contra enemigos gigantes.
Amnesia: The Bunker es el único de los tres que figura solo para PS4. Es un juego de terror en primera persona de los creadores de Soma y de la saga Amnesia, ambientado en un búnker abandonado de la Primera Guerra Mundial.
Recursos escasos y un recordatorio de noviembre
El jugador encarna a Henri Clément, un soldado francés que queda solo con un revólver con una única bala, una linterna de dinamo ruidosa y pocos suministros que debe recolectar y fabricar. Según la descripción oficial, un peligro constante reacciona a cada movimiento y sonido, y cada partida es distinta por la aleatoriedad del juego.
Los juegos de diciembre reemplazan a los de noviembre, que todavía pueden reclamarse. Dead Island 2, Tomb Raider IV-VI Remastered y Monster Train 2 estarán disponibles hasta el lunes 30 de noviembre, de acuerdo con el mismo blog.
Pasada esa fecha, quienes no los hayan agregado a su biblioteca no podrán hacerlo con el beneficio del servicio.
Juegos de Xbox Game Pass para diciembre
Por su parte, Xbox Game Pass, el servicio que compite con PlayStation Plus, ya suma seis juegos confirmados para diciembre de 2026, cinco de los cuales llegarán durante los primeros cuatro días del mes. La selección combina estrenos del día uno con el regreso de una franquicia de terror pensada para el multijugador, además de una aventura cooperativa ambientada en paisajes del norte de Suecia.
Ambos títulos estarán disponibles en Xbox Series, PC y mediante juego en la nube, aunque con una diferencia relevante: uno se incorpora directamente a los planes Ultimate y PC Game Pass, mientras que el otro también llegará a Premium. Todavía resta que Microsoft confirme el resto del calendario de diciembre, algo que se espera durante la primera semana del mes, sin fecha ni formato de anuncio definidos.

articles.title: Melhor Soundbar JBL: 6 modelos para comprar em 2026
articles.text:
Melhor Soundbar JBL: 6 modelos para comprar em 2026
Confira quais soundbars da JBL valem a pena atualmente, avaliando opções de 2.1 a 11.1.4 canais, graves de subwoofer sem fio e modelos com caixas traseiras removíveis
As melhores soundbars da JBL atendem a diferentes perfis de consumidores, desde quem busca melhorar o áudio da televisão até quem deseja montar um sistema de som surround em casa. O catálogo da fabricante inclui modelos com subwoofer sem fio, caixas traseiras removíveis e alto-falantes com Dolby Atmos.
Além da potência sonora e da quantidade de canais, características como conectividade, calibração acústica e dimensões dos equipamentos devem ser consideradas na hora da compra.
Para te ajudar na decisão, o Tecnoblog selecionou seis soundbars da JBL e reuniu as principais características, vantagens e limitações de cada modelo. Confira a seguir.
A JBL Bar 1300XMK2 é uma alternativa aos sistemas de home theater tradicionais. O modelo possui sistema de 11.1.4 canais e acompanha duas caixas surround removíveis, que podem ser posicionadas atrás de um sofá — elas possuem baterias recarregáveis e podem funcionar como alto-falantes independentes.
O sistema oferece potência total de 785 W RMS e conta com um subwoofer sem fio de 12 polegadas. A soundbar é compatível com Dolby Atmos e DTS:X e possui seis alto-falantes direcionados para cima, distribuídos entre a barra e as caixas traseiras.
Nas conexões, a JBL oferece três entradas HDMI e uma saída HDMI eARC, com passagem de vídeo em 4K e suporte a HDR10+ e Dolby Vision, além de entrada óptica. A soundbar também possui Bluetooth 5.3 na barra principal, Bluetooth 5.4 nas caixas removíveis e Wi-Fi 6 de banda dupla (2,4 GHz e 5 GHz).
A JBL Bar 1000MK2 também traz caixas surround removíveis com baterias recarregáveis com bateria para até 10 horas, segundo a fabricante. Porém, o sistema utiliza uma configuração de 7.1.4 canais e oferece potência total de 480 W RMS — 150 W são do subwoofer sem fio de 10 polegadas.
A soundbar conta com quatro alto-falantes direcionados para cima, sendo dois na barra principal e um em cada caixa traseira, além de suporte aos formatos Dolby Atmos e DTS:X. Isso é interessante para quem busca uma reprodução de áudio espacial com canais dedicados.
O modelo mantém as três entradas HDMI presentes na Bar 1300XMK2, permitindo conectar diferentes equipamentos diretamente à soundbar. Também oferece uma saída HDMI eARC com passagem de vídeo em 4K, HDR10+ e Dolby Vision, além de entrada óptica, Bluetooth 5.3 e Wi-Fi 6.
A JBL Bar 800MK2 é para quem procura um sistema de som surround com caixas traseiras dedicadas. O modelo tem sistema de 7.1 canais e acompanha duas caixas removíveis que funcionam com baterias recarregáveis, facilitando a instalação em ambientes sem tomadas próximas.
Apesar de oferecer suporte ao Dolby Atmos e ao DTS Virtual:X, a soundbar não possui alto-falantes físicos dedicados à reprodução de efeitos de altura, diferentemente das anteriores. O sistema utiliza processamento sonoro para simular esses efeitos, enquanto as caixas traseiras são responsáveis pela reprodução surround.
A potência total é de 390 W RMS, incluindo um subwoofer sem fio de 10 polegadas e 150 W RMS. Nas conexões, o modelo oferece uma entrada HDMI e uma saída HDMI eARC, com passagem de vídeo em 4K e compatibilidade com HDR10+ e Dolby Vision, além de entrada óptica.
Também conta com Bluetooth 5.3, Wi-Fi 6 dual-band e integração com o aplicativo JBL One, que permite ajustar a equalização e acessar serviços de streaming de música.
A JBL Bar 500MK2 pode ser interessante para quem deseja melhorar o áudio da televisão sem precisar acomodar caixas de som atrás do sofá. O sistema de 5.1 canais oferece potência total de 375 W RMS, distribuídos entre a barra de som (225 W RMS) e o subwoofer sem fio de 10 polegadas (150 W RMS).
O modelo é compatível com Dolby Atmos e DTS Virtual:X, porém não possui alto-falantes direcionados para cima nem caixas traseiras dedicadas. O sistema utiliza processamento de áudio e a tecnologia MultiBeam 3.0 para criar a sensação de som de diferentes direções.
Além do Bluetooth 5.3, o equipamento possui Wi-Fi 6 e permite reproduzir músicas por meio de serviços e tecnologias como Spotify Connect, AirPlay, Google Cast e Tidal Connect. O conjunto inclui uma entrada óptica, uma entrada HDMI e uma saída HDMI eARC, com passagem de vídeo em 4K e suporte a HDR10+ e Dolby Vision.
A JBL Cinema SB595 é uma soundbar mais barata para quem busca um som com Dolby Atmos. O sistema traz configuração de 3.1.2 canais, incluindo um canal central dedicado aos diálogos e dois alto-falantes direcionados para cima.
A potência total é de 220 W RMS, sendo 100 W destinados à barra de som e 120 W ao subwoofer sem fio de 6,5 polegadas. Os alto-falantes superiores utilizam a reflexão do som no teto para reproduzir efeitos de altura, um diferencial em relação aos modelos que dependem exclusivamente de processamento digital para simular esses efeitos.
Esse modelo não acompanha caixas traseiras para a reprodução de efeitos surround, como ocorre nas soundbars mais avançadas da JBL. Ele traz uma entrada HDMI e uma saída HDMI eARC, além de entrada óptica para conexão com televisores compatíveis. Também oferece Bluetooth 5.4, mas não conta com Wi-Fi.
A JBL Cinema SB180 é para quem procura uma soundbar mais simples para substituir o áudio integrado da televisão. Ela possui configuração de 2.1 canais e potência total de 110 W RMS, distribuídos entre dois alto-falantes de 25 W RMS na barra e um subwoofer sem fio de 6,5 polegadas com 60 W RMS.
Diferentemente da SB595, o equipamento não possui canal central dedicado nem suporte ao Dolby Atmos. Os diálogos são reproduzidos pelos canais esquerdo e direito da barra. Entretanto, o modelo oferece três modos de áudio (Cinema, Música e Notícias), que ajustam a reprodução sonora.
Nas conexões, a SB180 oferece HDMI 1.4 com ARC, entrada óptica, USB para reprodução de arquivos MP3 e Bluetooth 5.3. O modelo não possui Wi-Fi nem entrada HDMI adicional para conectar consoles ou outros dispositivos diretamente à soundbar.
Para escolher a melhor soundbar JBL para seu perfil de uso, observe a conectvidade disponível, o tamanho do ambiente e outros quesitos, como a quantidade de canais do sistema, a presença ou ausência de subwoofer e a potência máxima suportada. É importante ficar atento aos seguintes critérios:
- Canais de áudio: sistemas de 2.1 canais podem atender quem busca melhorar o áudio da TV, enquanto os de 3.1 canais acrescentam um canal central dedicado aos diálogos. Configurações de 5.1 canais ou superiores são mais indicadas para quem busca uma experiência sonora envolvente em filmes, séries e jogos;
- Potência sonora: considere o tamanho do ambiente e a distância entre a soundbar e quem está assistindo. Salas maiores podem demandar sistemas com maior capacidade de reprodução sonora;
- Subwoofer: modelos com subwoofer dedicado são interessantes para quem deseja uma reprodução de graves mais presente em filmes, músicas e jogos. Opções com conexão sem fio facilitam o posicionamento no ambiente, embora ainda precisem de uma tomada para alimentação elétrica;
- Caixas surround: soundbars com caixas traseiras dedicadas favorecem a percepção de sons de diferentes direções. Modelos com caixas removíveis e baterias recarregáveis facilitam a instalação em ambientes sem tomadas próximas ao sofá;
- Conectividade: confira se a TV possui HDMI ARC ou eARC, sendo este último mais indicado para transmitir formatos de áudio de alta taxa de dados. Entradas HDMI adicionais permitem conectar consoles e outros dispositivos diretamente à soundbar;
- Recursos de áudio: tecnologias de aprimoramento de diálogos, equalização e calibração acústica permitem adequar a reprodução sonora a diferentes conteúdos e características do ambiente. Verifique também a disponibilidade de ajustes pelo aplicativo JBL One;
- Conexões sem fio: o Bluetooth facilita a reprodução de músicas diretamente do celular, enquanto a conectividade Wi-Fi permite utilizar serviços e tecnologias de transmissão de áudio pela rede doméstica, como Spotify Connect e AirPlay;
- Dimensões e instalação: verifique se a largura e a altura da barra são compatíveis com o móvel e o posicionamento da TV. Considere também o espaço necessário para acomodar o subwoofer e eventuais caixas traseiras, além da disponibilidade de tomadas no ambiente.
A JBL Bar 1300XMK2 é a mais indicada. O sistema de 11.1.4 canais combina duas caixas surround traseiras, seis alto-falantes dedicados aos efeitos de altura e um subwoofer de 12 polegadas.
O modelo também oferece calibração acústica para adequar a reprodução sonora às características do ambiente.
A JBL Cinema SB595 é uma soundbar com o melhor custo-benefício para salas pequenas, com sistema de 3.1.2 canais, subwoofer sem fio e Dolby Atmos com canais físicos de altura. Já a JBL Cinema SB180 é uma alternativa mais simples para quem prioriza a economia e deseja apenas melhorar o áudio da TV.
As JBL Bar 1300XMK2, Bar 1000MK2 e JBL SB595 possuem alto-falantes direcionados para cima, com seis, quatro e dois drivers dedicados aos efeitos de altura, respectivamente.
Diferentemente dos modelos com Dolby Atmos virtualizado, esses equipamentos utilizam a reflexão do som no teto para reproduzir os efeitos sonoros verticais.

Typing 365 Turns PC Building, Technology and More into Typing Practice
Typing faster is useful, but what if practice could also teach you something? Typing 365 is a free native Windows app that combines structured typing lessons, educational content, and competitive challenges.
With over 100,000 installs and nearly 4 million typing races completed worldwide, Typing 365 has grown into more than a speed test. Its Albums Store offers themed collections covering technology, science, history, psychology, and more.Build Your PC: A Free Album for First-Time Builders
The new Build Your PC album features 40 free typing exercises about desktop hardware. It covers motherboards, component compatibility, assembly, first boot, operating system installation, and troubleshooting.
Here's the idea in practice: instead of just reading a guide, you type passages such as "Before buying a CPU, check that its socket matches your motherboard and that the board's BIOS supports it." By the end of the album, you've practiced thousands of keystrokes while picking up the fundamentals of building a PC.
You might already know your way around a PC case, but it's an easy recommendation for students, first-time builders, or that friend whose build you always end up helping with.
Why a Native Windows App?
Browser-based typing sites are great for a quick test. Typing 365 is designed for consistent practice, combining a dedicated Windows experience with structured courses, progress tracking, and detailed performance statistics.
Beginners can start with Typing 101, a free course that gradually introduces keys before moving on to complete sentences. Other courses cover keyboard rows, punctuation, and speed development.
During practice, an on-screen keyboard and optional hand guidance support finger placement. The app tracks words per minute (WPM), characters per minute (CPM), accuracy, and mistakes. You can also turn your own notes or technical material into typing exercises.Find Your Weak Spots with PRO Analytics
The free app offers plenty of practice material, while Typing 365 PRO adds detailed analytics for users who want to improve their skills. View speed trends, session history, and keyboard heatmaps, or identify slow words, characters, and letter pairs for targeted practice.
PRO also unlocks exclusive albums, advanced courses such as Typing 102, which focuses on building typing speed, plus additional fonts, keyboard sounds, avatars, and customization options.
PRO is available through a monthly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase, with US pricing starting at $2.99/month or $29.99 lifetime. Prices may vary by region.
Race Against Other Typists
Prefer competition? Join ranked typing races, compare your results with other players, and climb the global leaderboards. Whether you're chasing a personal best or a higher rank, every race offers a new challenge.
Practice in Five Languages
Typing 365 supports English, German, Spanish, Russian, and Arabic, allowing users to practice across languages and keyboard layouts.
From learning keyboard basics to understanding how a PC comes together, Typing 365 turns everyday practice into something worth your time.
Download Typing 365 for free from the Microsoft Store and start typing.
Typing 365 is available for Windows PCs, with optional premium albums and PRO features.

articles.title: Nvidia's RTX 5090 costs $7,000 alone — this full Corsair PC is $8,700
articles.text:
Nvidia's RTX 5090 costs $7,000 on its own — so Corsair's $2,600 Black Friday discount on this full 64GB PC is wild value
It's the cheapest RTX 5090 PC I've found
I've just found the cheapest RTX 5090 PC you can get, with the Corsair Vengeance i7600 Air currently $8,700 (was $11,300) direct from Corsair. That's already a pretty steep $2,600 price cut.
But what really stands out is that GPU. Buying an Nvidia RTX 5090 graphic card alone costs about $7,000 right, so this is a serious saving on a well-specced tower desktop. I'm not saying buy the card and get the rest of the PC for $1,700, but that's effectively what you have here.
Alongside the 5090 GPU, the Vengeance i7600 Air comes equipped with Intel Core Ultra 9 285K chip, fast 64GB DDR5 memory, and 2TB NVMe SSD. It's running Windows 11 Home. As a pre-built workstation, it's well-specced for content creation, 3D design, and local AI workloads.
The discount on this PC is eye-catching enough, but the fact that it comes equipped with an RTX 5090 GPU that costs only a fraction less than the entire PC is the real headline here.
Why we recommend it
As a gaming PC, this machine is well-equipped for creative professionals and AI developers, with the RTX card and DDR5 RAM offering a lot of headroom for graphics-intensive video editing and AI workloads. Handling those graphics is a 1200W ATX 80 Plus Gold power supply, which maintains stability at its limits.
Port selection is excellent, and includes multiple USB-A and USB-C ports, DisplayPorts, and audio ports (how many times can I say "ports"?). Connectivity is similarly good, featuring Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 5.4, and 5G Ethernet.
But I keep coming back to that $7,000 Nvidia graphics card that comes installed in a $8,700 PC. Impressive stuff.
Price context & historical value
It's no secret that graphics card prices are skyrocketing, thanks to their use for AI - just like every other PC component right now, it seems.
Demand for top-end GPUs and RAM is pushing up costs in every corner of computing, so, this is a genuinely good price in today's landscape.
Should you buy it?
✅ Buy the Corsair Vengeance i7600 Air if...
You're a professional creator, gamer, or AI engineer that needs a prebuilt workstation with RTX graphics - it's $1,700 more than the GPU alone.
❌ Skip the Corsair Vengeance i7600 Air if...
You just need a basic desktop PC for work, you don't need RTX 5090 graphics (an RTX 5080 configuration is also available), or Windows 11 Pro out of the box.

Black Friday HDD Deals: What to Look For
- It is important to be aware of the drive’s form factor, with 3.5-inch being the most common for the best HDDs (this is the only type we cover). If you need a 2.5-inch, your options are more limited, especially for capacity. Otherwise, your computer case’s ability to house a certain number of 3.5-inch drives might be your primary limitation.
- The ubiquitous SATA interface is used for desktop PCs, and most motherboards have ample available ports, which makes expansion easy. Most consumer NAS systems also use SATA, with the SAS interface typically reserved for servers and enterprise-class NAS.
- If you're shopping for an HDD, you’re probably looking for the lowest possible cost per terabyte, but you should also consider performance and support for specific applications. There are several potential performance pitfalls to consider when purchasing a new HDD, and the type of recording technology is one of the most crucial factors. Unless you are solely interested in cost and willing to sacrifice performance, we only recommend conventional magnetic recording (CMR) drives and not shingled (SMR), as the latter comes with performance and operational caveats.
- For performance, HDDs are also often gauged by rotations per minute (RPM), which is usually a direct indicator of performance. The RPM value affects both sequential transfers and random access latency. Lower RPM drives tend to be quieter and more efficient, while higher RPM drives have better performance. There are also variable RPM drives that try to achieve the best of both worlds. Power draw, heat, and noise are factors related to performance.
- HDDs also have a certain amount of DRAM to help temporarily cache data. This amount of cache typically scales with the drive's capacity. More cache is, of course, better, but if it comes at the expense of something else — for example, a support service — then you should carefully consider your priorities when making a purchase.
- You will want specialized drives for NAS, surveillance/DVR/NVR, raw storage for media and backups, or for heavier workloads. Certain drives will offer a better value for the money if you just want the extra capacity, or you may require a lower RPM drive to avoid the noise associated with faster drives.

articles.title: Un dron de Amazon chocó contra un garaje durante una entrega en Michigan y la FAA abrió una investigación
articles.text:
La Administración Federal de Aviación de Estados Unidos (FAA) abrió una investigación después de que un dron de Amazon chocó contra un garaje durante una entrega en Huntington Woods, Michigan.
El aparato, que acababa de dejar una botella de champú en el patio de un cliente, golpeó un cable de fibra óptica al despegar, perdió una hélice y terminó atrapado entre líneas eléctricas. No hubo heridos.
El incidente ocurrió el viernes 20 de noviembre, cerca de las 16:30, hora local, en este suburbio de Detroit. El informe preliminar de la autoridad aeronáutica señala que la aeronave no tripulada impactó un cable de fibra, una vivienda con garaje y quedó enredada en el tendido eléctrico durante el despegue.
Ahora, la agencia deberá determinar ahora las causas del hecho y si corresponde adoptar medidas regulatorias.
El MK30 entregó el paquete y perdió una hélice al iniciar el ascenso
El vehículo de Prime Air, el servicio de entregas aéreas de Amazon, dejó el pedido en el patio trasero de la vivienda de Jim Brennan. Según el testimonio del residente recogido por CNBC, el dron rozó un cable de fibra óptica cuando retomaba altura y una de sus hélices resultó dañada.
Brennan había recibido una notificación que indicaba que el envío llegaría por aire y salió a observar el recorrido. En el video que registró, el aparato se balancea y se desplaza sin estabilidad antes de caer sobre el garaje de una propiedad vecina. El paquete, una botella de champú encargada por su esposa, sí había sido entregado.
El dueño del garaje, Logan Coomes, dijo a la cadena local WXYZ que el impacto desplazó algunas tejas y dejó una parte del techo expuesta. El dron quedó inmovilizado entre la estructura y los cables de electricidad, una situación que obligó a intervenir a técnicos de la empresa eléctrica.
La FAA analiza el accidente y la NTSB reúne información
La FAA confirmó que investiga el accidente. Su informe preliminar no atribuye todavía el suceso a una causa concreta ni informa el estado final de la aeronave.
La revisión federal busca establecer cómo se produjo el contacto con la infraestructura residencial y si la operación cumplió con las condiciones aplicables al vuelo.
La Junta Nacional de Seguridad en el Transporte (NTSB, por sus siglas en inglés) conoce el caso y recopila datos, pero aún no decidió si abrirá una pesquisa propia.
Amazon indicó que retiró el dispositivo y que se puso en contacto con los residentes afectados. Jack Stelzner, portavoz de la compañía, afirmó que la seguridad es la prioridad de la empresa y que cada entrega que no se desarrolla según lo previsto es objeto de análisis.
Para retirar el equipo, la distribuidora DTE Energy interrumpió temporalmente una línea de acometida. Un equipo de Amazon llegó poco después del impacto, aunque la recuperación del dron demandó cerca de tres horas, según los reportes locales.
La compañía ofreció colaborar con las reparaciones del techo y entregó tarjetas de regalo de USD 100 a Brennan y a algunos vecinos afectados.
El accidente ocurre durante la expansión de las entregas aéreas de Amazon
El modelo involucrado es el MK30, una aeronave de reparto capaz de transportar pedidos de hasta 2,3 kilogramos. Amazon sostiene que el sistema utiliza cámaras, sensores y mecanismos de navegación redundantes para detectar obstáculos y realizar los vuelos autónomos.
El caso se produjo mientras la empresa busca que Prime Air opere en casi 500 ciudades y localidades de Estados Unidos antes de que concluya 2026.
Amazon afirma que el servicio efectúa cerca de 6.000 entregas diarias y que acumuló cientos de miles de paquetes distribuidos este año. Esos objetivos de expansión y los antecedentes del programa fueron informados por Arstechnica.
La operación de los drones de reparto cuenta con certificación Parte 135 de la FAA, pero el programa ha afrontado retrasos regulatorios, dificultades técnicas y cuestionamientos de comunidades cercanas a sus zonas de prueba.
En octubre de 2025, dos unidades MK30 chocaron contra una grúa de construcción en Arizona y los vuelos se suspendieron de forma temporal; un mes más tarde, otro dron derribó un cable de internet en Waco, Texas. Las investigaciones sobre esos episodios también quedaron en manos de autoridades federales.

Black Friday 2026 : Le casque Bluetooth Sonos Ace à 189,99 € (-21%)
À l'occasion du Black Friday, le casque Bluetooth Sonos Ace passe à 189,99 € chez Amazon et Boulanger.com, soit une baisse d'environ 21 % et 50,72 € d'économie. Confortable et doté d'une réduction de bruit active très efficace ainsi que d'un mode home cinéma réussi, il affiche une note actuelle de 4,5/5 dans nos tests.
Sonos signe avec l'Ace son premier casque Bluetooth nomade circum-auriculaire, pensé pour écouter de la musique en déplacement ou relier le son d'une barre de son de la marque. Cet appareil s'est distingué lors de son passage dans notre labo grâce à son confort et ses fonctions dédiées au visionnage de films.
À l'occasion du Black Friday, le Sonos Ace descend à 189,99 € chez Amazon et Boulanger.com, soit environ 21 % de moins que le prix moyen constaté ces 30 derniers jours (240,71 €). Cela représente une économie de 50,72 €.
Réduction de bruit active et immersion cinéma
Le casque isole efficacement des bruits extérieurs dans les transports tout en proposant un mode Conscient pour garder une oreille sur son environnement sans retirer l'appareil. Lors des séances vidéo, il diffuse une scène sonore aérée sur les pistes Dolby Atmos et prend en charge le basculement direct avec les barres de son du fabricant pour regarder un film sans déranger la pièce. Notre banc de test a mesuré une autonomie de 30 heures avec la réduction de bruit active enclenchée, ce qui assure plusieurs jours d'écoute musicale sans repasser par le câble USB-C. Pour découvrir toutes ses mesures en détail, consultez notre test complet.
Sonos Ace
Points forts
- Signature sonore équilibrée et agréable.
- Scène sonore aérée, belles performances sur les contenus Dolby Atmos.
- Mode home cinéma réussi.
- Excellente efficacité de la réduction de bruit et du mode Conscient.
- Construction impeccable (coussinets facilement détachables).
- Connectivité avancée (multipoint, aptX Lossless, audio via USB).
Points faibles
- Rendu sonore manquant de précision et de détails.
- Manque d’énergie dans le grave.
- Un poil lourd.
NB : La baisse de prix rapportée est calculée en comparant le prix le plus bas du jour avec la moyenne des prix les plus bas pratiqués par tous les marchands pour le produit le mois dernier, avec des règles de sécurité pour écarter les prix des boutiques dont la politique en matière de TVA n’est pas claire (dites boutiques “grises”, typiquement en cas d’import de Chine).
Une restitution sonore confortable malgré des basses sages
La signature audio générale reste équilibrée au quotidien et s'adapte à de nombreux styles musicaux. Le rendu manque toutefois de précision dans le détail et d'énergie dans les fréquences graves, ce qui peut frustrer les amateurs de rythmiques très percutantes sans pour autant gêner l'écoute de podcasts ou de musique acoustique. La construction intègre des coussinets détachables qui simplifient leur entretien ou leur remplacement à long terme. La connexion gère le Bluetooth multipoint afin de basculer sans manipulation entre un ordinateur portable et un smartphone.
Sony WH-1000XM4C : l'autre option face au Sonos Ace
Le Sony WH-1000XM4C mise sur une isolation phonique éprouvée et un rendu sonore plus précis dans les médiums et les aigus. De son côté, le casque Sonos met en avant son mode home cinéma dédié et des coussinets facilement détachables, alors que les coussinets du modèle Sony restent fixes.
Le Sony WH-1000XM4C est vendu 9,00 € plus cher que le Sonos Ace à son tarif remisé, mais il conserve l'avantage d'une note actuelle de 5/5 face aux 4,5/5 du casque Sonos.
Sony WH-1000XM4C
Points forts
- Restitution claire et naturelle.
- Excellent équilibre médiums/aigus.
- Réduction du bruit toujours à la page.
- Confort irréprochable, design pliable.
- Commandes intuitives et complètes.
Points faibles
- Basses trop présentes.
- Connectivité limitée (pas de LE Audio ni d'audio en USB-C).
- Mode Transparence peu efficace.
- Micros en difficulté en milieu bruyant.
- Quelques caractéristiques datées.

articles.title: Bancos dos EUA criam “botão de emergência” contra agentes de IA
articles.text:
Bancos dos EUA criam “botão de emergência” contra agentes de IA
Instituições revisam acessos e mecanismos de desligamento após incidentes com modelos da OpenAI.
Bancos de grande e médio porte dos Estados Unidos estão revisando mecanismos de desligamento de emergência para seus agentes de inteligência artificial. Segundo uma reportagem recente da Reuters, a revisão foi motivada por incidentes em testes da OpenAI com modelos que driblaram restrições de segurança.
As instituições ouvidas não foram identificadas. Segundo a agência, nenhum banco foi atingido por episódios semelhantes.
Conhecidos como kill switches, esses mecanismos servem para desconectar agentes que apresentem falhas ou tenham sido comprometidos. Como o desligamento pode afetar as operações bancárias, as instituições testam alternativas para atividades como detecção de fraudes. O objetivo é manter os serviços funcionando enquanto o agente fica suspenso.
Os bancos também restringem permissões, separam os ambientes de testes das operações diárias e limitam o tempo de atividade dos agentes. Senhas e registros de atividade são mantidos fora do alcance desses sistemas.
Os agentes de IA conseguem planejar etapas, utilizar ferramentas e executar tarefas. Em um ambiente bancário, essa capacidade exige definir quais informações cada ferramenta pode acessar. Permissões amplas demais podem permitir ações que ultrapassem o objetivo da tarefa. Essa preocupação aparece em um documento publicado este mês pelo Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC), órgão americano de supervisão bancária.
O documento cita os kill switches entre os recursos para conter agentes que continuem funcionando enquanto executam ações inadequadas. O impacto sobre clientes, a possibilidade de desfazer uma ação e o grau de autonomia também influenciam a avaliação do risco. Para preservar o atendimento, o material cita alternativas, como outro agente com funções limitadas.
O setor de tecnologia também desenvolve ferramentas de contenção. Em setembro, a Nvidia apresentou uma plataforma para limitar permissões de agentes e interromper comunicações quando eles tentarem ultrapassar restrições.
O episódio que motivou a revisão ocorreu em julho. A OpenAI confirmou que modelos usados em avaliações internas de cibersegurança contornaram o isolamento da internet e acessaram infraestrutura da própria empresa e da Hugging Face.
Os sistemas exploraram vulnerabilidades e estabeleceram comunicações não autorizadas. A investigação apontou como principal responsável um modelo experimental de pesquisa que não estava disponível ao público.
Esses testes tinham proteções reduzidas. Segundo a OpenAI, o incidente não afetou dados de clientes nem o funcionamento dos produtos. Após a investigação, a empresa anunciou medidas como ambientes de testes mais isolados e restrições adicionais de acesso.

articles.title: Games Without AI Festival Launches Following Controversial "AI Slop" Steam Next Fest
articles.text:
Wednesday, November 25th 2026
Games Without AI Festival Launches Following Controversial "AI Slop" Steam Next Fest
Steam Next Fest used to be a game event showcasing games by developers from all walks of life, but the October 2026 Next Fest was a little different, with many gamers and game developers alike taking to social media to bemoan the influx of "AI slop games" and projects that were hastily slapped together with little care for quality. While Valve doesn't seem to be too keen on intervening on that front, Games Without AI has formed as a response to the rise of AI-generated games. 
The first Games Without AI Festival is being hosted and organized by Dev Land Marketing, showcasing over 90 indie games with new trailers, updates, and announcements in the mix. The event is accompanied by a Games Without AI Steam Event page, which will be live until December 6. All developers taking place in the festival have had to submit proof that their games were created without AI. The organization is clear that the games featured in the event must be free of AI-generated music, art, and voice tracks. While AI-generated code is also banned, the organization head, Gadja Andrea, admits that it's nearly impossible to identify AI-generated code. The full game trailer showcase follows, including games from a number of genres, including cozy games, card games, life simulators, adventure games, horror games, and more.

articles.title: Amazon Autos is coming to the UK with £99 car reservations — but you won’t get home delivery
articles.text:
Amazon Autos is about to change the way you buy a car in the UK — as experts say it could 'seriously disrupt' rivals like Autotrader
Online giant wants to make car shopping easier in 2027
- Amazon Autos launches in the UK in early 2027, with Hyundai confirmed as its first manufacturer
- Buyers will be able to compare vehicles, check finance options and reserve a car
- The final purchase, paperwork and collection will still happen at the dealership
Following the success of its automotive platform launch in the US, Amazon wants to make buying a car feel more like ordering a new TV, with its online car-shopping service arriving in the UK in early 2027.
Amazon Autos will let shoppers browse new and used vehicles, compare prices and finance options, get an estimate for their existing car and reserve their next set of wheels without having to drive around numerous dealer forecourts.
The UK will be the first market outside the US to get the service, and Hyundai is the first manufacturer confirmed for the British launch, with its range of electric, hybrid and gas-powered models set to appear on Amazon.co.uk.
Dealer group Vertu Motors has also signed up to list used and 'approved-used' cars.
While you won't be able to have a new car dropped on your driveway alongside your toilet paper or electric toothbrush purchase, the retailer is clearly hoping to make the early stages of the buying process feel much more familiar.
“Customers often are already logged in. They already have the Amazon app. They're familiar with the experience. Amazon Autos will look and feel like Amazon to them,” Matt Nuffort, director of Amazon Autos International, told James Baggott in an interview for Car Dealer Magazine.
This is where Amazon wants to capitalize. Buying a car is a massive financial commitment, and the process can involve hours of research, comparing dealer listings, working out finance payments and negotiating a part-exchange.
Sign up for breaking news, reviews, opinion, top tech deals, and more.
Amazon's pitch is that much of this can be handled through a website or app that shoppers already know how to use.
“Buying a car is one of the biggest purchases people make, and we think it should feel as simple and transparent as shopping for anything on Amazon,” Nuffort said in Amazon's UK launch announcement.
Potential customers will be able to sort results based on geographical location, or shop to a strict budget or features wishlist, with reservations for a new vehicle starting at just £99.
Amazon also says its platform can compare upfront prices and finance deals, including the popular personal contract purchase (PCP) and hire purchase (HP) options, alongside cash prices for buyers who don't want the monthly financial burden.
Buyers can also get a quick estimate on the value of their trade-in, based on model, mileage and condition.
However, the remainder of the buying journey is still handled by the dealership, with all paperwork and final trade-in values occurring in person.
Amazon says it is not cutting dealerships out of the process. Instead, it's trying to make the online research and shopping experience more straightforward, before handing the customer over to the retailer selling the car.
Analysis: Amazon has the power to disrupt
Autotrader has long been the dominant force in both new and used car sales in the UK, with numerous rivals burning through stacks of money in an attempt to take it on.
So far, the likes of CarWow and Motorway have got close, but most buyers in the market for a new vehicle still flock to Autotrader.
James Baggott, editor of CarDealer Magazine, told me that Amazon has the potential to “seriously disrupt the automotive advertising market”, because car dealers are “desperate for an alternative” that offers the same level of leads for a fraction of the cost.
Hyundai is the first new-car brand confirmed for the UK launch. Its selection will include the Ioniq 3 and Ioniq 5 electric cars, alongside the i20 and Kona, with petrol, hybrid and electric options available.
Vertu Motors will also list used vehicles, and Amazon says more brands and franchised partners will be announced ahead of launch.
That could be important for buyers: the more dealerships and brands Amazon attracts, the more useful it becomes as a place to compare cars.
It's also an area where Amazon will want to prove itself. A familiar shopping experience is one thing, but car buyers will still want a broad selection of vehicles, competitive prices and confidence that the dealer on the other end of the listing can deliver.
But its US operation appears to be a success, growing from 48 cities to more than 150, with vehicles from 35 brands available through the platform.
Amazon says its UK launch will build on that experience, although the full choice of cars available to British shoppers has yet to be confirmed.
Follow TechRadar on Google News and add us as a preferred source to get our expert news, reviews, and opinion in your feeds.
Leon has been navigating a world where automotive and tech collide for almost 20 years, reporting on everything from in-car entertainment to robotised manufacturing plants. Currently, EVs are the focus of his attentions, but give it a few years and it will be electric vertical take-off and landing craft. Outside of work hours, he can be found tinkering with distinctly analogue motorcycles, because electric motors are no replacement for an old Honda inline four.

articles.title: Vers un événement Intel fin février : la présentation officielle de Nova Lake ?
articles.text:
Que de mystère autour de la prochaine génération de processeurs signée Intel : le lancement pourrait finalement arriver en mars prochain.
Intel joue gros. Le lancement de son architecture Nova Lake sera l'occasion de se tester sur le marché du processeur grand public pour un groupe américain qui subit de plein fouet le recul du marché du PC domestique et la concurrence de son meilleur ennemi, AMD.
BenQ iScreenBar : la barre lumineuse qui s’accorde avec l’iMac
Des lignes en harmonie avec celles de l’ordinateur d’Apple, une conception rigoureuse, des matériaux sélectionnés, rien n’a été laissé au hasard, tout comme le service qu’elle rend une fois allumée !
Un événement presse fin février ?
À Clubic, nous parlons des puces Nova Lake depuis maintenant plusieurs mois et, pour être tout à fait honnête, les premières informations remontent même à plusieurs années. Mais, on commence enfin à avoir du très concret.
En effet, alors que certaines rumeurs évoquaient une possible présentation par Intel lors du CES 2027 qui se tiendra début janvier à Las Vegas, tout porte à croire que l'entreprise présidée par Lip-Bu Tan se dirige vers un lancement commercial un peu plus tardif. Cela dit, l'un ne contredit pas forcément l'autre, le site VideoCardz précise justement les choses.
À en croire notre confrère, plusieurs médias auraient été contactés par Intel afin de vérifier qu'ils soient bien disponibles pour un événement autour de sa prochaine génération de processeurs desktop. VideoCardz souligne qu'il s'agit d'un événement d'une durée de quatre jours, organisé à Berlin, et que cela se passerait au cours de la dernière semaine de février.
Un événement allemand qui n'empêcherait pas la tenue d'une présentation officielle lors du CES de Las Vegas six semaines plus tôt, au contraire. Intel aurait alors dans l'idée de, d'abord, présenter la nouvelle génération de puces, en grande pompe, dans le Nevada.
Une présentation en deux temps pour Nova Lake
Dans un second temps, Intel réunirait la presse internationale à Berlin pour un événement plus technique, comme le groupe américain a déjà pu le faire par le passé afin de décortiquer la nouvelle architecture.
Cet événement serait aussi bien plus proche du lancement officiel et, donc, de la commercialisation des puces Nova Lake, laquelle pourrait intervenir au cours du mois de mars. VideoCardz souligne qu'un tel calendrier coïnciderait avec les informations reçues dès le mois de juillet : il était alors question d'un lancement en plusieurs étapes pour cette nouvelle génération.
Le premier processeur Nova Lake prévu serait donc le modèle 28 cœurs qui pourrait débouler dans la foulée de cet événement allemand. D'autres modèles seraient ensuite prévus par Intel, tout au long de l'année 2027. Le navire amiral de cette nouvelle génération Nova Lake, le surpuissant modèle 52 cœurs, ne débarquerait pour sa part pas avant le mois de septembre.
Gardez bien à l'esprit que ces différents éléments de calendrier n'ont jamais été confirmés de quelque manière que ce soit par Intel. Toutefois, nos confrères n'ont pas l'habitude de relayer ce genre d'informations sans de solides éléments. Tout porte à croire que deux rendez-vous sont donc pris avec Intel : début janvier et fin février.
Source : VideoCardz

Gaming PC Specifications to look for

You can sometimes find gaming rigs that have last-generation parts that will still play games well and save some cash.
GPU: A choice between Nvidia, AMD, or Intel in your system will determine how well the computer game graphics are displayed on your monitor. Nvidia has the most powerful GPUs, with the likes of the RTX 5090 and RTX 5080, but AMD's RX 9070 XT is also a great mid-range card. See our GPU hierarchy for an idea of GPU performance.
CPU: Either AMD or Intel will get the job done, but AMD currently rules the roost in pure gaming benchmarks, with the 9000-series X3D processors providing the best performance.
Memory: At a minimum, you'll want 16GB of RAM. Operating systems and browsers can swallow a huge chunk of your available system RAM before you even boot your game. Having 32GB of memory is ideal for gaming if you can splurge.
Storage: With the size of AAA games constantly expanding, you ideally want a minimum of 1TB of storage, preferably in the form of a fast M.2 SSD. You can do better than a spinning hard drive.

articles.title: Cuánto vale hoy GTA VI y cuánto aumentó de precio la saga desde hace 13 años
articles.text:
Tras su lanzamiento oficial el 19 de noviembre de 2026, Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) marcó un punto de inflexión comercial para la industria de los videojuegos. Disponible inicialmente para PlayStation 5 y Xbox Series X|S, la nueva entrega de Rockstar Games no solo rompe una espera de 13 años desde el estreno de su predecesor, sino que establece un nuevo techo de precios para las producciones de alto presupuesto (AAA) en tiendas digitales.
Precios oficiales de GTA VI en tiendas digitales
Take-Two Interactive, empresa matriz de Rockstar Games, estructuró el lanzamiento digital de GTA VI en dos niveles de comercialización, superando el estándar de 69.99 dólares que dominó los primeros años de la actual generación de consolas:
- Standard Edition (USD 79.99): Incluye el juego base completo para PS5 o Xbox Series X|S. Este monto representa un incremento directo de 10 dólares por encima del estándar vigente de la industria y de 20 dólares respecto al lanzamiento original de GTA V.
- Ultimate Edition (USD 99.99): Dirigida a los usuarios que buscan contenido adicional desde el primer día, integra bonificaciones digitales y beneficios orientados al ecosistema multijugador del título.
El salto de precio frente a GTA V: 13 años de diferencia
Cuando Grand Theft Auto V llegó al mercado en septiembre de 2013 para PlayStation 3 y Xbox 360, su edición estándar se comercializó a USD 59.99. Al comparar esa cifra con los USD 79.99 que cuesta hoy la edición básica de GTA VI, la franquicia registra un aumento nominal de 20 dólares, equivalente a un incremento del 33,3 % en un lapso de 13 años.
Un dato relevante de esta comparativa es el desplazamiento de las categorías de precio: en 2013, pagar USD 79.99 permitía adquirir la Special Edition de GTA V (que incluía contenido físico y digital exclusivo). En 2026, esa misma cifra corresponde únicamente al acceso básico del juego en formato digital.
Evolución histórica: fechas y precios de los títulos anteriores
Antes de la ruptura de la barrera de los 70 dólares con GTA VI, la franquicia de Rockstar Games se mantuvo alineada con los estándares de precio de cada generación de consolas. El historial de lanzamientos de la saga principal (en sus ediciones estándar para Estados Unidos) se distribuye de la siguiente manera:
- Grand Theft Auto (1997). Lanzado originalmente para PC y PlayStation con un precio de USD 49.99. Introdujo la perspectiva cenital y las mecánicas de mundo abierto que definieron la marca.
- Grand Theft Auto 2 (1999). Estrenado en PC y PlayStation a USD 49.99, manteniendo el formato 2D con mejoras en el sistema de facciones.
- Grand Theft Auto III (2001). Llegó a PlayStation 2 a USD 49.99. Marcó la transición de la saga al entorno tridimensional (3D).
- Grand Theft Auto: Vice City (2002). Publicado para PlayStation 2 a USD 49.99, ambientado en la versión ficticia de Miami que sirve de base geográfica para GTA VI.
- Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas (2004). Lanzado en PlayStation 2 a USD 49.99, cerrando la trilogía de la sexta generación de consolas sin alteraciones en su valor base.
- Grand Theft Auto IV (2008). Estrenado en PlayStation 3 y Xbox 360 a USD 59.99. Fue el primer título de la saga en aplicar un aumento de 10 dólares (+20 %), impulsado por los costos de desarrollo en alta definición.
- Grand Theft Auto V (2013). Lanzado inicialmente en PS3 y Xbox 360 a USD 59.99. Posteriormente, mantuvo ese mismo precio en sus relanzamientos para PS4/Xbox One (2014) y PC (2015), antes de reducirse a USD 39.99 en su versión optimizada para PS5 y Xbox Series X|S en 2022.

Pour les joueurs, le fabricant intègre une fréquence de dalle atteignant 165 Hz et quatre ports HDMI 2.1. Cette configuration assure une fluidité exemplaire pour connecter des consoles modernes ou un PC de jeu. Le système Ambilight sur quatre côtés diffuse des halos de couleur sur le mur arrière en accord avec l'image, renforçant la sensation d'immersion au salon.
Philips 65OLED951
Points forts
- Contraste quasi parfait et noirs profonds.
- Excellente colorimétrie en SDR comme en HDR.
- Pic lumineux très élevé pour de l’Oled.
- Compatibilité avec tous les formats HDR.
- Très bon TV pour les joueurs.
- Système audio convaincant.
- Ambilight toujours sympathique.
Points faibles
- Titan OS loin d’être parfait.
- Des réglages un peu obscurs.
- Pieds trop bas pour installer une barre de son sans gêne.
- Banding assez visible dans certaines scènes.
- Antireflet en retrait de Samsung et Sony.
- Consommation plus élevée que la moyenne.
Une interface perfectible mais de très hautes performances d'image
Le système d'exploitation Titan OS souffre d'un catalogue d'applications plus réduit que les systèmes concurrents et présente parfois des ralentissements dans la navigation. Ce défaut n'enlève rien aux qualités de l'écran et s'efface simplement pour les utilisateurs qui passent par une box multimédia externe pour leurs contenus en streaming.
Le téléviseur affiche à ce jour la note maximale de 5/5 dans nos colonnes grâce à des noirs parfaits et une excellente colorimétrie. La section sonore intégrée offre également un rendu solide qui évite le recours systématique à une installation externe, d'autant que le pied très bas complique le placement d'une barre de son devant la dalle.
LG 65G6 : l'autre option face au Philips 65OLED951
Le LG 65G6 constitue la principale solution concurrente sur ce format de 65 pouces. Il partage avec le modèle de Philips une note actuelle de 5/5 et une excellente qualité d'image Oled adaptée au cinéma et aux jeux vidéo. LG propose une formule très complète avec un filtre antireflet performant, mais se passe du rétroéclairage d'ambiance propre à la marque concurrente.
Le LG 65G6 coûte 48,00 € de plus que le Philips 65OLED951 à son tarif remisé du jour, laissant à ce dernier l'avantage du prix et de son système d'éclairage Ambilight.
LG 65G6
Points forts
- Contraste parfait de l’Oled.
- Forte luminosité HDR.
- Antireflet efficace.
- Colorimétrie HDR et qualité d'image remarquable.
- Très bonnes performances en jeu vidéo.
- Quatre ports HDMI 2.1, 165 Hz, G-Sync.
- Consommation très maîtrisée.
- Bon système son.
Points faibles
- Luminosité qui stagne par rapport au G5, hormis sur les petites fenêtres.
- Spatialisation audio encore limitée.
- Télécommande non rétroéclairée.
- Compte LG désormais obligatoire.

articles.title: Revopoint Launches MIRACO 2 on Kickstarter: Scan in One, Create with Agents
articles.text:
Wednesday, November 25th 2026
Revopoint Launches MIRACO 2 on Kickstarter: Scan in One, Create with Agents
An all-in-one 3D scanner combining high-precision capture, powerful onboard computing, and AI-driven workflows—with Super Early Bird pricing starting at $1,425.
The Offer is available from today, November 18 on Kickstarter. Grab the Super Early Bird Offer, with up to 38% off, starting at $1,425. 
Back MIRACO 2 on KickstarterTruly Standalone Design with Powerful Onboard ComputingWeighing just 960 g, MIRACO 2 integrates depth computation, 3D scanning, point cloud processing, and basic editing into one portable device.
Powered by an 8-core CPU and 6-core NPU, it supports three operating modes:
- Standalone Mode: Scan, preview, process, and make adjustments directly on its 6-inch 2K AMOLED touchscreen.
- Wireless PC Mode: Connect to a computer via Wi-Fi 6 for a flexible scanning workflow.
- Wired PC Mode: Connect via USB-C 3.0 for a stable, high-performance workflow.
When connected to a GPU-powered PC, Multi-Line Laser scanning can reach speeds of up to 120 FPS.
High Precision Meets Versatile Scanning Capabilities
MIRACO 2 delivers single-frame accuracy of up to 0.02 mm in Multi-Line Laser Mode and offers six scanning modes to handle a wide range of objects and applications:
- 34-Line Blue Cross Laser
- 15-Line Parallel Laser
- Single-Line Deep-Hole Laser
- Full-Field HD
- VCSEL Rapid
- Hybrid HD
With a maximum capture rate of 10 million points per second in Hybrid HD mode, MIRACO 2 can handle challenging surfaces and geometries, including reflective metals, black objects, intricate structures, and human bodies.
Additional capabilities include:
- Markerless tracking for textured objects in laser-line modes (PC mode).
- A recommended minimum scan volume of 10 × 10 × 10 mm.
- A maximum scanning volume of 5 × 5 × 5 m when paired with the optional Photogrammetric Metrology Kit.
- VCSEL working distance ranging from 300 mm to 1,000 mm.
Revo Agents: An AI-Native Ecosystem for 3D Workflows
Capturing an object is only the beginning. Turning scan data into CAD models or inspection results often means navigating complex software and hours of manual processing.
Revo Agents is designed to change that.Introduced by Revopoint as the world's first agent-powered 3D reality ecosystem, Revo Agents acts as an AI-native engineering co-pilot, allowing users to direct complex 3D operations through simple natural language commands.
Its autonomous, prompt-driven pipeline spans:
- Real-time point cloud fusion
- Automated Scan-to-CAD conversion
- Scan-to-Inspection tolerance analysis
Rather than manually navigating each processing step, users can describe the task they want to accomplish and let Revo Agents help carry the workflow forward.
Paired with MIRACO 2, Revo Agents bridges high-precision reality capture and production-ready engineering output—reducing repetitive post-processing while keeping creators focused on design, analysis, and decisions.
You define the task. Revo Agents helps execute it.
Full-Color Capture and Physically Scaled 3DGS
MIRACO 2's dual RGB camera system combines a 2 MP near-field camera and a 50 MP far-field camera for detailed, full-color 3D capture.
In PC mode, it also supports physically scaled 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), allowing users to export 1:1-scale.splat models for XR applications and digital visualization.
AI-powered cleanup tools further simplify model preparation:
- AI Segmentation: Automatically identifies and removes unwanted environmental point clouds.
- AI Cropping: Streamlines model cleanup and editing.
Together with Revopoint's software ecosystem, these capabilities support an integrated Scan-to-CAD workflow, helping users move from physical objects to usable digital models.
Built for Indoor and Outdoor Work
Designed for both indoor and outdoor applications, it supports ambient lighting conditions of up to 100,000 lux. Its 10,000 mAh battery provides approximately three hours of runtime, with 65 W fast charging.
Two configurations are available:
- 16 GB RAM + 256 GB storage
- 32 GB RAM + 512 GB storage
Now Live on Kickstarter
Limited Super Early Bird pricing offers up to 38% off for early backers starting at $1,425.
Back MIRACO 2 on Kickstarter

articles.title: 7 new Intel Nova Lake-S Core Ultra 4000-series CPUs detailed in new leak — lineup includes 5.5GHz Ultra 9 4970K BFC, ahead of the expected February 2027 release
articles.text:
7 new Intel Nova Lake-S Core Ultra 4000-series CPUs detailed in new leak — lineup includes 5.5GHz Ultra 9 4970K BFC, ahead of the expected February 2027 release
The desktop chips range from 22 to 28 cores, featuring boost speeds up to 5.5 GHz, with manufacturers expected to show compatible motherboards at CES in January.
A newly leaked document purportedly details no less than seven new Nova Lake-S desktop processors based on C1 stepping qualification samples, including 28-core models, three months before Intel is expected to officially take the wraps off them. The new leak, from VideoCardz, includes an Intel warning that clock speeds and performance may change before the final products are ready to be shipped. But given the fact that this rarely happens when dealing with qualification samples, it's believed that the chips will likely be released just as they are outlined in the document, if the leak is accurate.
Of the seven chips that have been detailed, the top-of-the-line Core Ultra 9 4970K BFC will be the one of most interest. It will reportedly feature 28 cores comprising eight performance cores, 16 efficiency cores, and four low-power efficient cores. Its base efficiency core clock speed of 2.7 GHz is eclipsed by the 5.5 GHz boost speed its performance cores will reach, while 144 MB of L3 cache and a 125-watt power rating round out the main figures. According to the leak, it will be joined by a Core Ultra 9 4950K with the same core count and almost identical clock speeds, albeit with a much smaller 36 MB L3 cache. Beyond that, the report says the Core 9 4900 BFC will be locked at 65 watts, have 22 cores, and a 120 MB L3 cache.
If the leak holds up, the mid-range will be catered for by the Core Ultra 7 4870K and 4850K chips. Both will reportedly have a 125-watt power rating and 24 cores, but will again differ in terms of L3 cache — the former will have 144 MB, the latter just 36 MB. Both will boost to 5.2 GHz.
The report says the entry-level models will include the Core Ultra 5 4650K and 4650KF, both packing 22 cores and 30 MB L3 caches, and that they'll also have the same 125-watt power rating and top out at a boosted 5.1 GHz, according to the documentation.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Core Ultra 9 4970K BFC | 28 (8+16+4) | 144 | 2.7 | 4.6 | 3.4 | 3.3 | 5.5 | 5.5 | 3.1 | 125 | 
| Core Ultra 9 4950K | 28 (8+16+4) | 36 | 2.7 | 4.6 | 3.6 | 3.4 | 5.4 | ✗ | 3.1 | 125 | 
| Core Ultra 9 4900 BFC | 22 (6+12+4) | 120 | 2.0 | 4.3 | 3.2 | 2.0 | 5.3 | 5.3 | 3.0 | 65 | 
| Core Ultra 7 4870K BFC | 24 (8+12+4) | 144 | 2.6 | 4.4 | 3.3 | 3.2 | 5.2 | ✗ | 2.9 | 125 |

| Core Ultra 5 4650KF | 22 (6+12+4) | 30 | 2.9 | 4.3 | 3.2 | 3.6 | 5.1 | ✗ | ✗ | 125 | 
The document reportedly states that all seven processors will support DDR5-8000 RAM, an increase over the DDR5-6400 that the Arrow Lake-S chips top out at. The specs also indicate a maximum of 256 GB of RAM is supported, with 24 CPU PCIe lanes and a 77 PTOPS integrated NPU. Integrated graphics are set to range from 2.9 to 3.1 GHz depending on the chosen chip, with support for the DNx, XAVC, JPEG-XS, and VVC decoding all included alongside AV1 High and Professional profile support.
It has previously been reported that Intel is likely to announce its next-gen chips at an event in Berlin, Germany, between February 22 and 25, 2026. But we can also expect that motherboard manufacturers will show off products compatible with the new chips before that — no doubt at the CES 2027 event in Las Vegas in January. It's already been confirmed that new motherboards will be needed if you plan on picking up any of the next-gen chips.
This latest leak comes weeks after it was reported that the new Nova Lake chips would "universally limit the maximum core frequency to 5.1 GHz when above 90°C." However, it's important to remember that the limitation only applies when the chips reach that temperature. Machines with adequate cooling will not experience that limitation, although it remains to be seen how easy these chips are to cool.

articles.title: Elon Musk hizo su propio Instagram: creó un editor de videos verticales para creadores
articles.text:
X, la red social de Elon Musk, anunció una serie de herramientas destinadas a facilitar la creación y publicación de videos verticales dentro de la plataforma. La actualización incorpora un editor multimedia con funciones de grabación, edición y posproducción, con el objetivo de que los creadores produzcan contenido sin recurrir a aplicaciones externas.
La compañía busca aumentar la cantidad de videos originales y competir por la atención de los usuarios frente a servicios como YouTube, Instagram y TikTok.
Las novedades forman parte de una estrategia para convertir los videos cortos en uno de los principales formatos de contenido de la red social propiedad de Elon Musk. Además de ofrecer nuevas opciones de edición, X pretende que los creadores tengan más oportunidades de generar ingresos a partir de sus publicaciones.
La disponibilidad de estas herramientas dependerá de la región, según informó la compañía. Algunas funciones ya se habían presentado durante los últimos meses, mientras que otras se incorporan ahora para ampliar las posibilidades de producción audiovisual.
X incorpora un editor para crear videos verticales sin salir de la aplicación
Una de las principales novedades es la actualización del editor multimedia de X. Esta herramienta permitirá grabar, modificar y publicar videos verticales directamente desde la plataforma, sin necesidad de utilizar programas de edición externos.
Entre las opciones de grabación se encuentra la posibilidad de capturar videos por segmentos, una función útil para combinar diferentes tomas en una misma publicación. También incorpora efectos de pantalla verde, que permiten sustituir el fondo de una grabación por otra imagen o escenario.
El editor incluye herramientas de posproducción para adaptar el contenido antes de compartirlo. Los creadores podrán convertir videos horizontales en formato vertical, recortar fragmentos, generar subtítulos automáticamente y agregar textos superpuestos.
También tendrán la posibilidad de seleccionar miniaturas personalizadas para sus publicaciones y realizar ajustes en fotografías. Estas opciones buscan simplificar el proceso de producción, especialmente para quienes publican contenido de manera frecuente.
Con esta actualización, X intenta reducir la dependencia de aplicaciones externas y ofrecer un entorno en el que los creadores puedan completar todo el proceso audiovisual.
Los usuarios podrán compartir hasta 20 fotos y videos en una publicación
Otra de las novedades recientes de la plataforma permite incluir hasta 20 fotografías y videos en una sola publicación. Los usuarios podrán recorrer el contenido deslizando el dedo horizontalmente, en una experiencia similar a la de una galería multimedia.
X considera que esta herramienta puede resultar útil para compartir resúmenes de eventos, imágenes detrás de cámaras, lanzamientos de productos y otros contenidos que requieren mostrar varias escenas.
La función amplía las posibilidades de las publicaciones tradicionales, que anteriormente tenían mayores limitaciones para combinar diferentes archivos multimedia en una misma entrada.
La compañía también presentó a comienzos de noviembre una herramienta para recortar videos largos y convertirlos en fragmentos más breves. Los usuarios pueden seleccionar una parte de una grabación, añadir sus propios comentarios y compartirla sin abandonar X.
Un aspecto importante es que estos clips conservan el crédito y un enlace al video original. Además, tanto la persona que publica el fragmento como el creador del contenido inicial pueden recibir ingresos por las visualizaciones, según las condiciones del programa.
X busca que los creadores ganen más dinero con sus videos
La estrategia de la plataforma no se limita a mejorar las herramientas de edición. X también está incorporando programas para incentivar la publicación de videos originales y fortalecer su sistema de monetización.
Uno de ellos es el denominado Bono de Inicio Rápido para Videos, un programa piloto disponible únicamente por invitación. Está dirigido a creadores seleccionados que publiquen videos verticales originales de menos de tres minutos y sin marcas de agua.
La iniciativa busca impulsar contenido producido específicamente para X, en lugar de publicaciones que hayan sido descargadas de otras redes sociales y compartidas nuevamente.
Otra incorporación son los Chats Grupales Exclusivos para Suscriptores, que permiten mantener conversaciones privadas en tiempo real con personas que pagan por acceder a contenido exclusivo de un creador.
Actualmente, esta herramienta está disponible para creadores con 800 suscriptores o menos. Cada grupo puede reunir hasta 1.000 participantes, lo que abre una alternativa para construir comunidades alrededor de cuentas que ofrecen suscripciones de pago.

articles.title: Windows 11 recebe atualização que muitos usuários não conseguem instalar
articles.text:
Windows 11 recebe atualização que muitos usuários não conseguem instalar
Microsoft liberou o pacote KB5132057 para os Windows 11 25H2 e 26H2, mas muitos usuários se deparam com um erro ao tentar concluir a instalação.
Uma vez por mês, a Microsoft lança um pacote opcional de atualizações para o Windows 11. Por não ser obrigatória, a sua instalação só é feita se o usuário acessar o Windows Update ou configurar a ferramenta para receber as atualizações mais recentes o quanto antes. O pacote de novembro de 2026 já foi liberado, mas há um problema: muitos usuários não conseguem instalá-lo.
O pacote em questão é o KB5132057, que é direcionado ao Windows 11 na versão 25H2, mas também pode ser instalado em PCs que já têm a atual versão 26H2. As suas principais novidades incluem (mas não se limitam a):
- experiência de busca renovada: o mecanismo de busca do Windows 11 (Windows Search) pode exibir recursos em lista única, tem ajustes de desempenho e consumo de memória, e pode lidar com erros de digitação mais facilmente;
- pesquisa aprimorada no Explorador de Arquivos: aqui, as buscas passam a ser baseadas em índices, tornando as pesquisas mais rápidas e consistentes;
- ajustes no Windows Hello: o reconhecimento facial agora pode aumentar temporariamente o brilho da tela em ambientes escuros, além de trazer melhorias na entrada com chaves de segurança.
Esses aprimoramentos justificam a instalação do pacote KB5132057. Mas é aí que os problemas começam: muitos usuários reclamam que, ao tentarem aplicar a atualização, o sistema operacional exibe uma mensagem de erro informando que o procedimento não pode ser realizado. Muitos deles seguiram a orientação de tentar de novo, mas, novamente, não tiveram sucesso.
Como a Microsoft não reconheceu o problema até o momento, não há nenhuma orientação formal sobre como proceder caso a tentativa de instalação do pacote KB5132057 resulte em uma mensagem de erro.
Houve quem conseguisse resolver o problema alterando o Registro do Windows e fazendo download manual de uma imagem do sistema operacional, mas esse é um procedimento complexo e que, talvez, não funcione para todo mundo.
Por isso, para a maioria dos usuários afetados, a recomendação é aguardar. Como o pacote KB5132057 é opcional, a sua ausência não deixará o Windows 11 perigosamente desatualizado.
Leve em conta também que os recursos de um pacote opcional costumam ser liberados pela Microsoft como parte do Patch Tuesday do mês seguinte, este sim um pacote de atualizações cumulativas de instalação obrigatória.
Isso sugere que, para quem tiver problemas com o pacote KB5132057, a solução chegará em dezembro. A gente só precisa torcer para não haver nada de errado com essa atualização (mas, convenhamos, não vai ser surpresa se houver).

articles.title: À l'occasion du Black Friday 2026, ces écouteurs Sony notés 5/5 passent à 179 €
articles.text:
Black Friday 2026 : Les écouteurs sans fil Sony WF-1000XM5 Noir "5 étoiles" à 179,00 €
À l'occasion du Black Friday, les Sony WF-1000XM5 passent à 179,00 € chez Amazon, Son-Video.com et Sony, soit une baisse d'environ 9 % et 18,67 € d'économie. Réputés pour leur rendu sonore précis et leur réduction de bruit active de premier ordre, ces écouteurs sans fil affichent une note actuelle de 5/5 dans nos tests.
Les Sony WF-1000XM5 prennent la suite directe des WF-1000XM4 pour s'installer au sommet du catalogue d'écouteurs sans fil de la marque japonaise. Ce modèle intra-auriculaire vise une restitution acoustique soignée accompagnée d'une isolation active de premier ordre lors des déplacements quotidiens. Cette formule technique solide avait convaincu notre laboratoire lors de son passage sur les bancs de test.
À l'occasion du Black Friday, le tarif descend à 179,00 € chez Amazon, Son-Video.com et Sony, soit environ 9 % de moins que le prix moyen constaté ces 30 derniers jours (197,67 €). Cette baisse de prix permet d'économiser 18,67 €.
Rendu audio précis et réduction de bruit active de premier plan
Les écouteurs sans fil de Sony se démarquent d'abord par leur restitution sonore détaillée et dynamique, soutenue par une scène stéréophonique aérée. Ils intègrent un système d'isolation active qui atténue fortement les bruits environnants pour préserver la musique dans les transports. Comme le souligne notre test complet, ils prennent en charge la connexion multipoint pour basculer facilement entre deux sources Bluetooth.
Sony WF-1000XM5
Points forts
- Rendu sonore incroyablement précis et dynamique.
- Scène sonore spacieuse et naturelle.
- Réduction de bruit redoutable.
- Bonnes sensations de confort.
- Autonomie colossale pour des écouteurs true wireless.
- Nombreuses fonctionnalités avancées.
Points faibles
- Forte sensation d’intrusion dans le canal auditif.
- Captation vocale décevante.
- Mode d’écoute des sons environnants qui manque de naturel.
- Commandes non modifiables.
Une endurance solide au prix d'un format intra-auriculaire prononcé
Le laboratoire a mesuré une autonomie de 8,75 heures lorsque la réduction de bruit active reste enclenchée, une durée qui monte à 12 heures sans cette fonction. Le boîtier accepte une recharge filaire via son port USB-C ou sans fil par induction. En contrepartie, le format intra-auriculaire engendre une sensation d'intrusion marquée dans le canal auditif, ce qui ne posera aucun problème aux utilisateurs déjà habitués aux embouts pénétrants mais rebutera les conduits plus sensibles.
Technics EAH-AZ100 : l'autre option face au Sony WF-1000XM5
Les Technics EAH-AZ100 affichent une note actuelle de 5/5 et avancent une signature sonore naturelle avec de très bonnes prestations en captation vocale lors des appels téléphoniques. En matière d'isolation active, les écouteurs de Technics restent toutefois en retrait sur les fréquences aiguës par rapport à l'atténuation offerte par Sony.
Le tarif des Technics EAH-AZ100 est supérieur de 20,00 € à celui des Sony WF-1000XM5, ces derniers conservant l'avantage d'une meilleure réduction de bruit pour un coût plus modéré.
Technics EAH-AZ100
Points forts
- Rendu sonore apaisé et détaillé.
- Haut-médiums très précis.
- Design compact et maintien excellent.
- Personnalisation avancée et bons micros.
- Autonomie record.
Points faibles
- Basses un peu trop imposantes.
- Réduction de bruit encore perfectible.
- Boîtier non certifié IP.

articles.title: US Treasury information chief spent three days vibecoding Civilization game clone amidst Treasury database hack — AI agent studiously attends to personal project, GitHub users raise tickets asking him to attend to cybersecurity incident
articles.text:
US Treasury information chief spent three days vibecoding Civilization game clone amidst Treasury database hack — AI agent studiously attends to personal project, GitHub users raise tickets asking him to attend to cybersecurity incident
The US Treasury CIO's vibecoded Civilization clone is getting constant regular updates while the Financial Crimes Enforcement Network investigates a "cybersecurity incident."
Someone’s vibecoding a Civilization clone, and it’s the US Treasury’s own Chief Information Officer, Sam Corcos. Some Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) systems and services have been taken offline while the bureau investigates a “cybersecurity incident”; meanwhile, Corcos’ Legatum GitHub repository has been regularly updated for the past three days as his AI agents receive instructions to build it.
In an X post earlier this month, Sam Corcos supported the General Services Administration (GSA) mandate, requiring federal workers in the office to send regular updates about what they worked on, which many criticize as micromanagement and authoritarian. Ironically, people are micromanaging Corcos instead, calling him out for spending time on his vibecoded GitHub project instead of working on the Treasury cybersecurity incident.
Legatum, Corcos’ vibecoded browser-based Civilization game clone, reached version 0.1.0 just three days ago. “A historical 4X on a hex map, built for people who love Civilization.” is Legatum’s tagline, and it’s not ashamed of it. While the repository is likely being updated by Corcos’ Claude and Codex agents, it’s funny how the repository has seen more frequent updates than the situation over at FinCEN.
Catherine Rampell on X reports that FinCEN’s Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) batch filing system has been offline for over 24 hours, requiring financial institutions to file reports manually, one at a time. Catherine Rampell further questions Legatum’s development, asking, “I would want to find out who is paying for Corcos’s Claude credits to work on his Civilization game clone. Is it US taxpayers, via Treasury?”
While this is Corcos’ personal project, Kyle Pomykala on X replied to Catherine Rampell, jokingly assuring readers that he has raised an issue on the Legatum repository, stating, “The Treasury Department is being hacked, and you are vibecoding a video game instead.” Other GitHub users have replied under the issue with their own jokes, with one even stating Corcos will likely also vibecode the Treasury cybersecurity issue. Eight hours after the ticket was opened, Claude closed it, referring the commenters to the Legatum repository Code of Conduct with no personal response from Corcos.
