articles.title: US blacklists Megaspeed, but leaves potential loophole for lower-performance chips — company at center of Jensen Huang affair scandal added to entity list
articles.text:
US blacklists Megaspeed, but leaves potential loophole for lower-performance chips — company at center of Jensen Huang affair scandal added to entity list
But does it make any sense now?
The U.S. Department of Commerce has added Megaspeed and six affiliated entities to its Entity List due to concerns about diversion of advanced AI accelerators to China. However, unlike previous additions of companies suspected of similar activities, the department did not apply a special foreign direct product rule (FDPR) designation to Megaspeed, which raised questions about the effectiveness of the restrictions. While the omission potentially limits the scope of the sanctions, existing U.S. export controls should still restrict Megaspeed's access to advanced processors from AMD and Nvidia. Former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, allegedly a Chinese intelligence asset, is the woman at the heart of the Jensen Huang scandal, which saw Nvidia's CEO resign and then be reinstated as head of the company in recent days.
Chris McGuire, a fellow at the Council on Foreign Relations and a former Biden administration official who dealt with export controls at the National Security Council, noted that neither Megaspeed nor any of the six associated entities received a so-called Footnote 4 designation on the Entity List. According to McGuire, the Department of Commerce had previously applied the designation to Chinese companies blacklisted over concerns about their access to advanced AI processors.
McGuire claims that without the application of the Entity List-specific FDPR, the new restrictions will have essentially no effect on Megaspeed's ability to procure Nvidia's AI processors since, while they are developed in the U.S., the vast majority of them are produced by TSMC in Taiwan.
While McGuire acknowledged that new U.S. export controls that took effect on November 19 already require licenses for shipments of high-end AI accelerators to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, Indonesia, and Brazil, with exemptions for U.S.-based companies and their subsidiaries (i.e., Google or Microsoft can get Rubin-based machines for their data centers in the said countries, but Megaspeed or other local players cannot), he questioned the rationale behind Megaspeed's addition to the Entity List without Footnote 4.
It is necessary to note that the new country-wide controls impose a license requirement, not an outright ban, whereas the addition of Megaspeed to the Entity List subjects license applications to a presumption of denial, which is a reason why the designation has practical effect even without Footnote 4. Meanwhile, McGuire suggested that the omission could be either a regulatory oversight or a deliberate decision to reduce the scope of restrictions.
Companies on the Entity List typically cannot procure products subject to the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR) without a license from the Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS). Such license applications are reviewed with a presumption of denial, and this certainly concerns Megaspeed and entities linked to it. Footnote 4 substantially expands the scope of products subject to the EAR to include foreign-made goods that use American technology or are made using American technologies.
Meanwhile, advanced AI accelerators from AMD and Nvidia are already subject to a separate Advanced Computing FDPR (§734.9(h) of the EAR), which has worldwide geographical coverage irrespective of where the chips are made. In fact, BIS explicitly retained the worldwide scope of this provision in its November 19 amendments to the EAR. Therefore, Megaspeed's addition to the Entity List should effectively cut the company off from qualifying advanced AI accelerators even in the absence of Footnote 4.
Get Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.
What the absence of Footnote 4 could mean, though, is that Megaspeed may retain access to certain foreign-made lower-performance AI GPUs, networking chips, and other data center hardware that falls outside the scope of the EAR. At this point, it remains unclear whether the Department of Commerce deliberately opted for a narrower set of restrictions.
Meanwhile, Malaysia's Ministry of Investment, Trade and Industry announced on Tuesday that it would advise all data center operators in the country against the provision of infrastructure, space, or services to the seven blacklisted entities, a move that could affect Megaspeed's ability to operate its existing AI infrastructure in Malaysia, regardless of the scope of U.S. export restrictions.

iPhone 15 (256 GB) recebe o segundo maior desconto do ano na Black Week
iPhone 15 (256 GB) com tela OLED de 2.000 nits e câmera de 48 MP fica abaixo da metade do preço no Pix em oferta da Amazon, na semana da Black Friday 2026
O iPhone 15 de 256 GB está saindo por apenas R$ 3.999 no Pix na Amazon. O celular da Apple, com câmera wide de 48 MP e tela OLED de 2.000 nits, atinge o 2.º menor preço de 2026 na semana da Black Friday, com desconto de 51% sobre o original de R$ 8.099.
Esta oferta é interessante para quem procura um celular da maçã acessível e com mais câmeras que o 16e e 17e, mas está disposto a abrir mão do Apple Intelligence para isso.
O menor preço que já encontramos para o iPhone 15 256 GB foi R$ 3.499, na Black Friday de 2026 (Amazon). Fora de datas promocionais, esta oferta é o menor preço que já encontramos.
O iPhone 15 é o modelo mais acessível dos celulares da Apple no momento. Seu chip A16 Bionic e os 6 GB de RAM rodam apps pesados e games, mas não suportam a suíte Apple Intelligence. Os 256 GB de espaço interno são adequados para guardar fotos e vídeos.
Sua tela Super Retina XDR OLED de 6,1″ com brilho de até 2.000 nits reproduz cores vibrantes com visibilidade garantida em qualquer lugar. O vidro Ceramic Shield protege o display contra pancadas e arranhões.
O corpo de alumínio possui certificação IP68, que confere resistência em situações como poeira intensa e mergulhos acidentais.

articles.title: Nothing dévoile en vidéo les Ear (note), des écouteurs conçus pour prendre des notes par IA
articles.text:
Nothing dévoile en vidéo les Ear (note), des écouteurs conçus pour prendre des notes par IA
Nothing prépare une nouvelle catégorie d’écouteurs. Baptisés Ear (note), ils seront présentés le 8 décembre et se positionnent avant tout comme un outil de prise de notes assisté par IA. La marque vient également de dévoiler leur design dans une vidéo, avec une promesse qui dépasse simplement l'écoute musicale.
Nothing ne compte pas seulement faire écouter de la musique avec ses prochains écouteurs. Avec les Ear (note), la marque britannique veut faire de l’oreille un point d’entrée vers une nouvelle façon de travailler.
Teasés ces derniers jours, les Ear (note) ont désormais un nom, une date et un premier aperçu de leur design. Nothing annonce leur présentation pour le 8 décembre, avec une ambition clairement affichée : proposer un outil de prise de notes par IA, tout en embarquant ce que la marque décrit comme son meilleur système audio intra-auriculaire à ce jour.
La vidéo dévoilée par Nothing ce 25 novembre accompagne cette annonce d’un slogan évocateur : "The first step in our AI vision will change how we work. And play." Une formule qui évoque une stratégie orientée vers l’intelligence artificielle, sans pour autant dévoiler les fonctionnalités concrètes ni la fiche technique de ces écouteurs.
The first step in our AI vision will change how we work. And play.
This is Ear (note), an AI notetaker with our best in-ear audio to date.
8 December. pic.twitter.com/fFQjqFfTlZ
— Nothing (@nothing) November 25, 2026
Des écouteurs conçus pour prendre des notes, pas seulement pour écouter
À ce stade, Nothing reste avare en détails. Les Ear (note) sont présentés comme un AI notetaker, autrement dit un appareil dédié à la prise de notes par IA. Leur boîtier semble jouer un rôle important dans cette expérience, avec des boutons physiques Rec et Talk, ainsi que plusieurs microphones intégrés. Sur le plan du design, cet étui se démarque par l’usage du métal, à l’instar de celui des Ear (3a), et l’usage plus modéré de la transparence sur son couvercle.
On peut donc s’attendre à une interaction pensée pour lancer ou contrôler rapidement une capture audio, plutôt que de passer obligatoirement par l’application. Pour l’heure, Nothing n’a pas encore confirmé le fonctionnement exact, les services compatibles ni les possibilités de transcription, de résumé ou encore de traduction en direct. On ne sait pas non plus s’il sera possible d’interagir avec un assistant vocal.
Étant donné que Nothing ne les présente pas comme de simples écouteurs sans fil dotés de fonctions IA, on peut toutefois s’attendre à une combinaison entre son savoir-faire acoustique et des usages avancés de l’intelligence artificielle.
Une évolution logique après les Ear (3) et Ear (3a)
Ce virage vers l’IA ne sort pas complètement de nulle part. Les Nothing Ear (3) et les Ear (3a) ont déjà introduit des fonctions qui rapprochent les écouteurs de la capture vocale. Les Ear (3) disposent notamment d’un boîtier intégrant un microphone, tandis que les Nothing Ear (3) permettent notamment d’enregistrer des appels. Ces fonctions restent avant tout des outils audio, sans couche d’intelligence artificielle dédiée à la prise de notes.
Elles ressemblent néanmoins à des premières étapes : Nothing a progressivement fait de ses écouteurs et de leur boîtier des dispositifs capables de capter la voix, et pas seulement de restituer du son. Les Ear (note) pourraient désormais transformer cette capture en une expérience plus complète, tournée vers la transcription et l’exploitation de l’information.
Plaud, Shokz, etc., la concurrrence va être féroce
Nothing ne sera pas seul sur ce terrain. Plaud, spécialiste des enregistreurs intelligents, s’est déjà rapproché de l’univers audio avec ses écouteurs Plaud One. La démarche consiste à faire évoluer un outil de prise de notes vers un format plus proche des accessoires audio que l’on porte au quotidien.
Ces écouteurs se distinguent notamment par l’intégration d’une eSIM, qui leur permet de transmettre des données au cloud sans passer par un smartphone. Ils nécessitent toutefois un abonnement payant pour exploiter pleinement les capacités de Plaud Intelligence.
À l’inverse, Shokz vient de l’audio et explore lui aussi l’intelligence artificielle avec ses OpenFit 2 AI, pour l’heure uniquement lancés en Chine. La marque cherche ainsi à enrichir des écouteurs conçus pour l’écoute avec des fonctions davantage orientées vers l’assistance et la productivité. Nothing se place à la croisée de ces deux approches : celle d’une marque d’audio grand public, dotée d’une identité visuelle forte, qui veut désormais faire de l’IA un usage central de ses écouteurs.
Rendez-vous le 8 décembre
Les Ear (note) pourraient marquer une nouvelle étape pour Nothing, à condition que la marque parvienne à rendre la prise de notes réellement simple et utile au quotidien. Pour l’instant, le design et l’intention sont les seuls éléments clairement dévoilés : les fonctionnalités, les compatibilités, l’autonomie, le prix et la disponibilité restent à confirmer.
Le 8 décembre devrait donc permettre de comprendre si Nothing propose simplement des écouteurs dotés de fonctions de transcription ou un véritable nouvel outil de productivité porté à l’oreille.

articles.title: Seoul Semiconductor Enables Beyond-OLED Picture Quality with LCD
articles.text:
Wednesday, November 25th 2026
Seoul Semiconductor Enables Beyond-OLED Picture Quality with LCD
Seoul Semiconductor Co., Ltd., a global opto-semiconductor company, today announced that its 'WICOP Pixel'—the world's first package-free technology, developed by its subsidiary Seoul Viosys—arranges RGB chips at an ultra-fine pitch of several tens of micrometers (µm) to render tens of thousands of colors. Replacing conventional white-light LCD backlights, the technology achieves 100% of DCI-P3 color gamut, the international film industry standard for reproducing natural colors, while delivering more than three times the brightness of OLED displays. The company has entered full-scale mass production and begun expanding supply to global TV manufacturers.
Seoul Semiconductor's display-related revenue in the third quarter rose nearly 20% year-over-year. To meet capacity needs across the global market, the company plans to convert its existing white backlight light-source capacity to WICOP Pixel production rather than make large new investments, while expanding both revenue and profit through a global patent licensing program. In this way, it will support stable production for its customers while generating royalty income, which it plans to invest in expanded research and development in future fields such as biotechnology, 3D printing, AR and AI data communications.The core of the 'WICOP Pixel' RGB backlight technology is that, while using a standard LCD panel, it reproduces natural colors and scenes more faithfully than OLED and heightens immersion even in bright settings such as living rooms and public spaces. This strengthens its appeal for home-theater TVs and raises product value and profitability for TV manufacturers. In addition, it reduces dependence on expensive LCD panels, and to cut costs further, the company is also researching technology to eliminate the color filter, which accounts for about 20% of LCD panel material costs.
The technology also covers 100% of the DCI-P3 color gamut, the international standard for digital cinema, enabling richer, more vivid color than OLED. Its peak brightness of up to 3,000 nits is more than three times that of OLED, delivering sharp images and strong immersion even in bright indoor and outdoor environments. Experts expect this to further strengthen TV's role as home theaters and to deliver clear images even in bright public spaces. It also offers more than twice the lifespan of OLED.
According to a market research firm Omdia, the shift to RGB backlights—the category that WICOP Pixel technology addresses—is accelerating. Global RGB TV shipments, led by the large-screen premium segment, are expected to reach about 7 million units by 2030, representing more than 10% of global TV market revenue. As the current white-backlight market of about USD 3 billion shifts to RGB, the market is expected to more than double in size with the adoption of Advanced Packaging technology.
- DCI-P3 (Digital Cinema Initiatives - P3): An international color gamut standard used in the digital cinema industry that defines the range of colors a display can reproduce. 100% DCI-P3 coverage means a display can reproduce the standard's entire color gamut.
- BT.2020: An international standard for ultra-high-definition video established by the International Telecommunication Union (ITU).
- WICOP Pixel: Seoul Viosys' WICOP is the world's first opto-semiconductor technology that achieves a robust chip structure without a separate package, allowing it to be used like an ordinary electronic component. The WICOP technology previously applied to blue opto-semiconductors has been extended to all wavelengths, including green, red and UV. WICOP Pixel integrates multiple wavelengths, such as red, green and blue, into a single pixel unit. Each color is controlled independently and combined precisely, reproducing tens of thousands of natural colors efficiently and vividly.
Source:
				Seoul Semiconductor

articles.title: Varios usuarios han mostrado en directo cómo 'GTA VI' fríe sus consolas. De momento no es como para perder la calma
articles.text:
Llevo casi una semana jugando bastante a 'GTA VI' en una PS5 de 2020 sin ningún tipo de problema. No suena más de la cuenta ni me ha dado ningún error raro. Sin embargo, no todos pueden decir lo mismo, ya que por redes están circulando vídeos sobre consolas que dejan de funcionar con fallos visuales típicos de una GPU o VRAM que deja de funcionar como debe.
Esto ya ha encendido las alarmas, claro, y aunque no hay comunicados oficiales, las redes ya están dictando sentencia.
En corto. Tom Warren, periodista de The Verge, es uno de los que se ha hecho eco del problema citando un vídeo en el que a una streamer se le 'fríe' la consola en pleno directo. Empiezan a aparecer artefactos en la pantalla, que se congela y lleva al apagado de la consola.
En su caso, una PS5 que, como mostró poco después, había limpiado para no tener polvo acumulado en la zona del ventilador. También afirma tenerla en un espacio bien ventilado y, claro, se empezó a decir que 'GTA VI' está derritiendo la PS5.
No sólo PS5. Uno de los primeros culpables al que apuntaron algunos fue al sistema de disipación de calor de la consola de Sony. Los japoneses, al contrario que Microsoft, utilizaron metal líquido para conducir el calor de la APU al disipador y, con el tiempo, puede presentar fugas. Se ha dicho que, sobre todo, si está en vertical la consola es más susceptible debido a una degradación en las máquinas más antiguas del encapsulado de la APU. Pero, al margen de esto, los fallos no son sólo cosa de PS5.
En Reddit hay un hilo bastante generoso en el que hay usuarios que también están reportando fallos de sus Series X y Series S. Algunos responden a bugs del juego, pero otros muestran vídeos e imágenes que se corresponden con esos fallos de GPU/VRAM. Un taller llamado Solder Surgeon aseguró en un comunicado propio del 22 de noviembre que reparó 38 consolas (PS5 y Xbox Series X) durante las 72 horas posteriores al lanzamiento, atribuyendo los problemas al metal líquido en el caso de PS5, a daños en la alimentación eléctrica y a puertos HDMI mal soldados.
Exigente. Es innegable que 'GTA VI' es un juego tremendamente exigente. Es de lo más impresionante que he visto en cualquier plataforma y no es algo al aire: la propia Digital Foundry ha afirmado que nunca se ha hecho algo así en tiempo real. Es lógico que lleve las consolas al límite, pero en el caso de PS5, y como leemos en Notebookcheck, el técnico modyfikatorcasper midió 220 W con el juego encendido, pero sin hacer nada. Durante una prueba de carga máxima, el medidor registró 274,2 W.
Como apuntan, Sony diseñó el hardware para funcionar a 340-350 W como máximo y los juegos normalmente consumen entre 180 y 220 W, por lo que 'GTA VI' es, definitivamente, más glotón, pero no lleva al límite la energía de la máquina.
El matiz. Lo que sí puede pasar, y es algo que apunta el propio técnico, es que ese mayor consumo de energía y, por tanto, mayores temperaturas internas, hagan que el material entre la APU y el disipador pueda ser más maleable. En las consolas más nuevas o en la PS5 Pro se introdujeron cambios para mitigar esas fugas del metal líquido durante los vaivenes de la temperatura, pero podría afectar a las consolas más antiguas.
Cuidados. El asunto de la PS5 en vertical tiene sentido porque el metal líquido se puede ir deformando hasta no llegar a cubrir de forma homogénea la superficie de la APU, lo que hace que pierda propiedades de disipación. Hay recomendaciones básicas como una limpieza interior regular (da "miedo" desmontar un cacharro, pero no es tan difícil y hay mil tutoriales) y, sobre todo, no tenerla encajonada para que pueda 'respirar', pero esos cuidados son muy generales y llega un momento en el que pierden efectividad.
Las consolas se rompen por diferentes motivos, pero en el caso de la disipación, lo más efectivo es hacer un cambio de metal líquido o de pasta térmica. También puedes hacerlo en casa, aunque si nunca te has puesto, es algo más delicado que simplemente abrir para aspirar el polvo. Estos materiales se degradan, pierden efectividad y pueden causar esos fallos que estamos viendo, por lo que una visita a un técnico de confianza no está de más.
¿Anecdótico? De la forma que sea, aquí me gustaría tocar madera porque mi PS5 lleva en vertical seis años sin ningún problema y, además, poner un poco los pies en el suelo. Antes del primer día, 'GTA VI' vendió más de 30 millones de unidades, por lo que hay mucha, muchísima gente que está jugando al título de Rockstar y no a todos les están dando fallos.
Lo más fácil es que el juego, al exigir ese punto de más respecto a otros, está sacando a relucir algún fallo que la propia máquina ya podía tener, con la mala suerte de 'freírla'. Si la cosa se pone más seria y es la que empieza a hacer que una oleada de máquinas empiecen a fallar, hablaremos de ello, pero de momento, simplemente, parece muy mala suerte para un pequeño porcentaje de todos los jugadores que se han hecho con el título.

articles.title: Así es el centro de Ciencias de robótica, realidad virtual y prototipado en Colombia
articles.text:
Programar un dispositivo, probar un modelo, recorrer una simulación digital o producir una pieza audiovisual forman parte de las actividades que se pueden hacer en un centro de Ciencias en Colombia.
Este tipo de espacios reúne áreas de robótica educativa, realidad virtual con visores, experimentación científica, prototipado, creación tecnológica y trabajo colaborativo, con propuestas dirigidas a niños, adolescentes y adultos.
Qué se puede hacer en el área de robótica en el centro de Ciencias
La zona de robótica educativa está destinada a la construcción y programación de dispositivos. Allí, los participantes podrán aproximarse a los elementos que intervienen en el funcionamiento de un sistema automatizado: estructuras, componentes, instrucciones y respuestas frente a una acción determinada.
La zona de robótica educativa dispone de estructuras móviles armadas con piezas modulares, motores, ruedas y sensores. Algunos de esos dispositivos incorporan pinzas, brazos mecánicos y detectores de proximidad, elementos que permiten introducir nociones de movimiento, distancia y control.
Este tipo de práctica permite entender que detrás de un robot hay decisiones de diseño y secuencias lógicas. El aprendizaje no parte únicamente de un aparato terminado, sino de las pruebas necesarias para que un dispositivo cumpla una tarea.
“Queremos que la ciencia y la tecnología dejen de percibirse como conocimientos lejanos o exclusivos de especialistas”, señaló Camilo Roncancio, director de la Fundación Conecta +, detrás del centro de Ciencias en Bogotá.
Cómo se implementa la realidad virtual
El centro cuenta con puestos de realidad virtual integrados con visores, auriculares y asientos para experiencias inmersivas. Quien utiliza el dispositivo puede observar un entorno digital en 360 grados y modificar el punto de vista a partir de los movimientos de la cabeza.
Esta tecnología se diferencia de una pantalla convencional porque pone al usuario dentro de una simulación. Puede servir para recorrer un escenario, observar una reconstrucción, conocer la representación de un proceso científico o participar en una actividad que requiere interacción con elementos virtuales.
Por qué es útil el área de prototipado
El prototipado es la etapa en la que una idea se convierte en un modelo de prueba. Puede tratarse de un objeto, una estructura, un mecanismo o un sistema electrónico. El propósito no es obtener una versión final de inmediato, sino comprobar si la propuesta funciona y qué cambios necesita.
Un participante puede construir un vehículo, añadirle un brazo mecánico, probar cómo se desplaza y luego modificar la posición de las ruedas o el programa que controla sus movimientos.
Asimismo, este proceso incorpora el error como parte de la actividad. Un prototipo puede no girar, chocar con un obstáculo o fallar al tomar un objeto. En cada caso, el problema exige una revisión: puede estar en la estructura, en el circuito, en la programación o en la combinación de estos factores.
Qué aportan los espacios de experimentación científica
Las áreas de experimentación científica están enfocadas en la observación y la práctica. La intención es trasladar algunos conceptos de las aulas a actividades en las que los participantes puedan formular preguntas, contrastar resultados y conocer procesos a partir de la experiencia.
La ciencia, en este formato, es una práctica que requiere comprobación. Un experimento puede mostrar cómo se comporta un material, qué sucede ante una reacción o qué variables modifican un resultado.
La iniciativa se apoya en la Apropiación Social del Conocimiento, un enfoque que plantea que la ciudadanía no debe limitarse a recibir información científica. Debe participar en su comprensión, aplicación y construcción.
“La innovación adquiere mayor valor cuando el conocimiento se comparte y se convierte en oportunidades para las personas”, afirmó Roncancio.
El lugar tiene espacios de producción audiovisual y trabajo colaborativo que permiten relacionar la tecnología con la comunicación de ideas, la elaboración de contenidos y el intercambio entre personas con distintos intereses.

articles.title: NVIDIA : Jensen Huang nie l'implication de Trump dans son retour
articles.text:
Pour beaucoup, le retour de Jensen Huang à la tête de NVIDIA est surtout le résultat d'un coup de pression de Donald Trump. Mais le principal intéressé nie.
Onze jours se sont à peine passés entre le moment où Jensen Huang a déposé sa démission, et celui où il a finalement repris les rênes de la compagnie qu'il a fondé : NVIDIA. Un temps durant lequel de nombreuses personnalités se sont exprimées en sa faveur, dont le président des États-Unis Donald Trump. Mais Jensen Huang nie toute implication de ce dernier dans son retour.
Non, Donald Trump ne serait pas intervenu en faveur de Jensen Huang
Pendant l'intermède de onze jours durant lequel Jensen Huang n'était plus à la tête de NVIDIA, Donald Trump s'est plusieurs fois exprimé pour son retour, allant même jusqu'à poster un message sur Truth Social demandant publiquement à NVIDIA de reprendre son fondateur.
Pourtant, Jensen Huang a tenu à nier l'implication de Donald Trump, à l'occasion d'un entretien chez NVIDIA, dont le New York Times se fait l'écho. « C'est […] tout à fait faux » a-t-il ainsi réagi. Ce qui ne l'a pas empêché d'affirmer que Donald Trump « aime vraiment, vraiment notre entreprise » et « se vante de Nvidia ».
Pour Jensen Huang, son retour n'est dû qu'à une évaluation positive de la situation par le conseil d'administration
Reste qu'il a affirmé dans le même entretien que NVIDIA était une entreprise apolitique. « Nous sommes l'entreprise la plus apolitique qui soit » a ainsi asséné Jensen Huang. Pour lui, la raison de son retour est beaucoup plus simple que celle de tortueuses intrigues politiques menées en sa faveur.
Il a ainsi expliqué que le conseil d'administration de NVIDIA avait simplement « rassemblé des éléments d'information », et « évalué l'ensemble de la situation », arrivant tout seul à la conclusion de la nécessité de son retour. Le conseil d'administration aurait par ailleurs reçu de la part de l'administration Trump l'assurance que Jensen Huang n'était pas une menace à la sécurité nationale. La fin d'une (courte) affaire d'État ?
Source : New York Times

articles.title: Google DeepMind AI engineers conjure mathematical proof of Signal's encryption protocol — AlphaProof Code framework powered human-bot cooperation for speedy work
articles.text:
Google DeepMind AI engineers conjure mathematical proof of Signal's encryption protocol — AlphaProof Code framework powered human-bot cooperation for speedy work
Code tests are one thing, but a mathematical proof is one heck of a security blanket.
A team at Google's DeepMind AI labs has performed a complete formal proof of the code that implements the encryption mechanism for the Signal private chat application. The scientists call their procedure AlphaProof Code and claim it can be applied to other situations requiring complete end-to-end verification of computer code, meaning Signal is safe, and you can find the full paper and the code repository detailing the proof.
More explicitly, the team reviewed an Arm-compiled version of libsignal, the library that the Signal application itself incorporates and uses, with some minimal scaffolding around it. Note that the verification wasn't done against the source code: it was purposely executed against an AArch64 binary, meaning the method can be reused for future verifications of other software.
In a similar vein to the AI labs' work on mathematics, the bulk of the work was done in Lean, a purpose-built language for formal proofs. There's a key difference for this effort, though. Lean is primarily used to prove the underlying math in algorithms, which in this case would be the specifications for Signal's encryption.
However, what the scientists actually did was create millions of lines of Lean proofs that were run against the actual implementation, in this case checking that the final binary executable corresponds to the initial specification.
Everyone knows about code tests in software development, but a mathematical proof of code is a different beast altogether, and one particularly elusive over the history of computing. It's akin to being able to check that an entire factory campus produces the actual parts it was designed to make, with the same exact inputs, with zero variation, no matter what else is happening.
The DeepMind scientists mention previous year-long efforts in this vein to create formal proofs for relatively small pieces of software. The seL4 microkernel purportedly took twenty years to prove, while CompCert's C compiler took six. This may sound like going way overboard on software engineering, until you consider that said programs are now, in practical terms, bulletproof and cannot fail due to a code flaw, at least for the inputs they control.
While it'd be a questionable use of resources to formally prove all software on Earth, AlphaProof Code providing the ability to do so for mission-critical code like the Signal comms protocol is quite a boon.
As an oversimplification, the actual AlphaProof Code workflow comprised various stages of back-and-forth between humans and Gemini 4 Carbon agents. The first steps were laying out the groundwork and infrastructure. The team defined the base scope of work, and then created textual bot skills to prepare agents for their future tasks, among them specification writers, proof workers, and orchestration.
Then, it was time to have agents create the first set of Lean definitions for AArch64 instructions, how registers, memory, and system calls work, and how Linux processes operate. At this point, however, nothing is proven about Signal or any other application. That came next, as the team and its army of agents drafted fully revised specifications for libsignal's cryptography implementation. This then generated just over 1.2 million lines of Lean, for checking the mathematical reasoning behind the protocol.
The bulk of the agentic work was generating 5.3 million lines of Lean to verify that each binary instruction matched the previously defined AArch64, CPU, and process formal behaviors. During this stage, the agent flagged one percent of the codebase for humans to review and verify. When it was all complete, the team had fully verified that the cryptographic engine in the binary did indeed match all the generated proofs, down to the last processed bit.
As the researchers point out: "the most important lesson from our experience is that, once proofs become cheap, the hard question is what to prove," adding that "the majority of our effort went not into proofs but into specifications," and underscoring that this is particularly important for software topics like cryptography.
Interestingly, they mention that "writing specifications against real code also turned out to be a stress test for the literature," an insightful note on verifying that one did write the software's specifications properly to begin with.
With the disclaimer that this is a note about security in general and we think Signal is indeed top-notch as a private messaging application: Google's team "only" proved that libsignal works exactly as advertised. If a malicious actor were to booby-trap the Signal app — or any other one — with additional code to copy your messages, this sort of proof likely wouldn't catch it. Likewise, the fact that a third-party app implements the Signal protocol for encryption doesn't automatically mean it offers full privacy.
Bruno Ferreira is a contributing writer for Tom's Hardware. He has decades of experience with PC hardware and assorted sundries, alongside a career as a developer. He's obsessed with detail and has a tendency to ramble on the topics he loves. When not doing that, he's usually playing games, or at live music shows and festivals.

articles.title: Samsung Display Makes Strategic Push into Next-Generation Ultra-Small MicroLED Technology
articles.text:
Wednesday, November 25th 2026
Samsung Display Makes Strategic Push into Next-Generation Ultra-Small MicroLED Technology
Samsung Display announced today that it has signed an investment agreement to acquire a 9.1% equity interest in ams OSRAM for approximately EUR 210 million. Under the agreement, Samsung Display will acquire 9,984,439 newly issued shares of ams OSRAM and is expected to become its largest shareholder upon closing.
Separately, the two companies have also entered into a strategic partnership to jointly develop next-generation ultra-small microLED technology for display applications. Through this collaboration, Samsung Display plans to step up research and development to accelerate the potential commercialization of ultra-small microLED technology, including efforts to improve its efficiency and cost competitiveness.With more than 120 years of history, ams OSRAM has extensive technological expertise in advanced epitaxy, LED miniaturization and high-volume LED manufacturing, as well as high-density integration.
Drawing attention as a future display technology following OLED, microLED is a next-generation inorganic self-emissive display technology that uses ultra-small light-emitting diodes (LEDs), offering advantages such as high brightness, long lifespan and freeform design capabilities.
Through its investment in ams OSRAM, Samsung Display plans to extend its world-leading technological expertise in OLED to inorganic self-emissive technologies. In particular, the company plans to evaluate the performance and applicability of ultra-small LEDs manufactured by ams OSRAM and establish the manufacturing processes and production technologies needed to commercialize next-generation ultra-small microLED displays. The company will also explore mid- to long-term business opportunities across a wide range of applications, from ultra-small to ultra-large displays.
Aldo Kamper, CEO of ams OSRAM"This partnership marks a major strategic milestone for ams OSRAM. It creates a funded pathway for a novel next-generation ultra-small microLED technology from technology development towards potential industrialization, while Samsung Display's strategic investment in ams OSRAM underscores our shared commitment to its successful development and commercialization".
Chung Yi, President and CEO of Samsung Display."Ultra-small microLED is a next-generation inorganic self-emissive technology with the potential to overcome the limitations of existing technologies in areas such as brightness and lifetime. Its potential is not limited to any particular product category, but extends across an exceptionally broad range of applications, from ultra-small to ultra-large displays".
"This investment reflects our determination not to remain complacent with where we are today, but to proactively respond to technological evolution and emerging market demand while securing new engines for future growth," Yi added.
Samsung Display expects to complete the share acquisition in early 2027, subject to customary closing conditions, including applicable regulatory approvals.
Source:
				Samsung Display			
	
	
	
		
	
		
1 Comment on Samsung Display Makes Strategic Push into Next-Generation Ultra-Small MicroLED Technology
It would be interesting if this pans out. One of the main limitations of OLED is its short(ish) lifespan. Colors tend to fade and individual pixels my. die early. This is at least partially due to it using components of organic origin - which tend to break down over time. Switching to a non-organic component could potentially resolve those issues. Hopefully it'll work, time will tell.

articles.title: Justiça dos EUA condena Huawei por roubo de segredos comerciais
articles.text:
Justiça dos EUA condena Huawei por roubo de segredos comerciais
Empresa e três subsidiárias também foram consideradas culpadas por fraude bancária, lavagem de dinheiro e violações de sanções contra o Irã.
A Huawei foi considerada culpada pela Justiça dos Estados Unidos por conspiração para roubar segredos comerciais de empresas do país. Além da espionagem, a empresa também foi condenada por fraude bancária, lavagem de dinheiro e violações de sanções contra o Irã.
Segundo o Departamento de Justiça dos EUA (DOJ), outras três subsidiárias da companhia também foram condenadas: Huawei Device, Futurewei Technologies e Huawei Device USA. Apesar disso, o júri absolveu a Huawei das acusações de conspiração para extorsão organizada e de conspiração para obstruir a Justiça.
Em nota, mencionada pela Associated Press, a Huawei comemorou a absolvição nestes pontos e contestou os demais vereditos. “Acreditamos que as acusações restantes do governo também não têm mérito jurídico ou factual”.
As acusações fazem parte de um processo iniciado em 2019, mesmo ano em que os Estados Unidos sancionaram a Huawei por suspeitas de espionagem para a China — o que impede a empresa de negociar com empresas do ocidente há anos. A sentença deve ser determinada em audiência marcada para 14 de setembro de 2027. Em nota, a companhia alega que pretende recorrer.
De acordo com o DOJ, a Huawei e suas subsidiárias participaram durante anos de um esquema para obter propriedade intelectual de concorrentes e parceiros comerciais nos Estados Unidos. O material incluía códigos-fonte, manuais técnicos, tecnologia de antenas e sistemas usados para testar smartphones.
Em um dos casos, funcionários da Huawei teriam fotografado e até enviado peças de um robô de testes para telas sensíveis ao toque, que simulam gestos humanos, usado pela operadora T-Mobile. Em outra situação, engenheiros da chinesa teriam copiado código-fonte usado nos roteadores da Cisco.
Funcionários e pesquisadores ligados à Huawei também teriam roubado informações e repassado ao país asiático em casos envolvendo a Fujitsu e o laboratório de semicondutores CNEX. A acusação ainda aponta que a Huawei recebeu informações confidenciais da fabricante de antenas Quintel, sob um acordo de não divulgação, e depois apresentou um pedido de patente que incorporava a tecnologia da empresa.
Segundo o DOJ, a empresa também foi considerada culpada em acusações relacionadas a violações das sanções dos Estados Unidos contra o Irã, fraude bancária e lavagem de dinheiro. A Huawei teria fornecido serviços de telecomunicações ao governo iraniano, incluindo infraestrutura de internet e redes móveis, e ajudado autoridades do país a monitorar e censurar o acesso à internet.
As operações no Irã eram conduzidas por uma companhia chamada Skycom, que, segundo a acusação, tratava-se de uma subsidiária da fabricante chinesa. A Huawei dizia publicamente que a companhia era apenas uma parceira comercial.
A Huawei também teria fornecido informações falsas a bancos, jornalistas e ao governo dos Estados Unidos sobre suas atividades no país e sobre o cumprimento das sanções americanas. Segundo os promotores, bancos processaram bilhões de dólares em operações relacionadas à Huawei sem saber a verdadeira extensão das atividades da empresa no Irã.

articles.title: Infineon CoolSET™ SiP Enables ‘First-Time-Right’ Designs
articles.text:
Infineon Technologies’ CoolSET™ system-in-package (SiP) flyback controller ICs integrate the PWM controller, high-voltage switch, and high-voltage startup cell on the primary side and the system control and the synchronous-rectifier (SR) driver on the secondary side, with both sides communicating across integrated galvanic isolation.
Digital communication across integrated galvanic isolation
The primary side starts up independently from the secondary side. After startup, the secondary side takes control, and the primary side no longer performs automatic switching. This handover is communicated across the integrated galvanic isolation to the primary side, which is when the IC enters closed-loop operation.
Under the secondary side’s control, every on/off switching of the primary-side high-voltage MOSFET is initiated by the secondary side. The secondary side controls the switching frequency and the on-phase duration of the primary-side switch. The secondary side emulates current-mode control, which provides strong immunity against primary-side noise.
When the requested output power is low, the secondary side operates the primary side in burst mode, whereby the primary-side high-voltage switch temporarily ceases switching. When the output voltage of the integrated error amplifier of the secondary side reaches a certain threshold, then the primary side resumes operation.
The primary side goes into auto-restart mode if the secondary side detects an abnormality (protection mode), such as:
- Secondary-side under- or overvoltage
- Secondary-side open-loop or overload
- Input of a configuration pin is short-circuited or floating
Note that in protection mode, the secondary side halts the primary side’s high-voltage switching. After a certain elapsed time, the primary side auto-restarts.
Finally, the secondary side uses the integrated galvanic isolation to send an on/off signal to activate/deactivate a discrete primary-side load, e.g., an LDO. This enables the lowest standby power consumption, eliminating the need for a discrete digital isolator or an optocoupler.
ZVS advantages
Unlike standalone PWM controllers or PWM-controller-integrated primary-side switches, CoolSET™ SiP supports quasiresonant (QR) switching and continuous-conduction mode (CCM), as well as zero-voltage switching (ZVS).
ZVS avoids hard turn-on switching of the primary-side high-voltage MOSFET, significantly reducing the dv/dt of its drain voltage, resulting in inherently lower conducted common-mode noise and radiated electromagnetic interference (EMI) compared with QR switching, greatly reducing the requirements for common-mode EMI filtering. Because EMI filtering against differential-mode noise is fully sufficient and straightforward, less filtering improves power density, BoM savings, and efficiency and reduces R&D.
Additionally, in ZVS, the energy stored in the primary-side high-voltage MOSFET output capacitance is recovered, significantly improving energy efficiency.
Great for CCM
CCM is frequently used to accommodate temporary peak loads or to reduce RMS current under low-line input when a high Pout is required. CCM maximizes the effective utilization of the magnetic flux in a transformer. In a traditional lineup with a primary-side PWM IC and a separate SR IC, there is a shoot-through risk when operating in CCM, i.e., the primary-side high-voltage switch and secondary-side SR-switch conduct concurrently. Here, excessively high currents pass through both switches, leading to permanent degradation. Integrating CoolSET™ SiP is the most robust way to remove this risk because the control for both sides resides in one IC. Because the secondary side controls the on/off timing of the primary-side high-voltage switch, it is inherently precise and deploys a mandatory but short (e.g., 100 ns) deadtime, improving efficiency because current through the body diode is minimized.
20 years of operational life, IEC 60747-17–certified
In most flyback designs, mandatory galvanic isolation is provided by a transformer. Unless a non-isolated secondary-side analog direct sensing approach is good enough for an application, optocouplers are used for analog feedback loops. The snag with that is that their isolation certification is UL1577-based, which defines the zero-hour device isolation advantage, i.e., fresh out of the box.
CoolSET™ SiP with non-optical isolation (e.g., Infineon’s coreless transformers) has UL1577 and IEC 60747-17 certificates, along with GB4943.1, for reinforced isolation.
IEC 60747-17 is the most meaningful standard, encompassing a time-dependent dielectric breakdown limit over 37.5 years to project isolation performance across a 20-year product operational lifetime.
Coreless transformer built like a tank
Infineon uses fourth-generation coreless transformer technology for functional robustness in CoolSET™ SiP products. As the name suggests, the integrated coreless transformer uses a magnetic coupling principle to communicate across the galvanic isolation barrier. This is achieved using two coils, having multiple windings to maximize the magnetic flux in the desired direction, which are placed on top of each other. The isolation is facilitated by a strong, high-quality silicon dioxide layer. A peripheral seal ring around the coil stack perimeter shields against external EMI and abates electromagnetic emissions.
The strong CMTI rating of CoolSET™ SiP products is a solid basis for uninterrupted, reliable system operation, even under substantial ground shifts between the primary and secondary sides.
Designed and manufactured as an integral part of a chip, the coreless transformer is a perfect choice for robust applications operating at elevated temperatures for extended periods of time. Unlike optocouplers, coreless transformers are virtually free from fatigue and have near-zero part-to-part skew. Their FIT rate, according to JEDEC JESD58, is two orders of magnitude better than optocouplers.
Infineon subjected CoolSET™ SiP products to IEC 61000 standard tests:
- Radiated EM field immunity test up to 30 V/m (IEC 61000-4-3)
- Power frequency magnetic field immunity testing up to 1,000 A/m (IEC 61000-4-8)
- Impulse magnetic field immunity testing up to 1,175 A/m (IEC 61000-4-9)
All tests were passed with performance criterion A.
Integrated isolated flyback ICs are the preferred choice
After power-up, in normal operation, the control of the circuitry resides on the secondary side, which is the best master of the system, as it directly senses the output. It controls the MOSFET switching on both sides and eliminates shoot-through risk. Such closed-loop control significantly reduces efforts required by application engineers. Reliable communication across the integrated galvanic isolation provides high efficiency and operational robustness. Out-of-the-box zero-hour current-transfer-ratio variations of optocouplers and provisions against temperature drift and across operational lifetime are historical with integrated flyback ICs.
ZVS completely avoids hard on-switching of the primary-side high-voltage switch, simplifying EMI filtering. Less filtering not only improves power density and BoM savings but also improves efficiency and reduces R&D efforts. CoolSET™ SiP safely operates in CCM without shoot-through risk, as closed-loop control resides in one IC controlling both sides.
For high efficiency across a wide range of loads, extended operational lifetime at elevated temperatures, and tight PCB areas, CoolSET™ SiP is excellent for designers to deliver first-time-right products.

Comprar un nuevo televisor es algo que no hacemos todos los años. Por esa misma razón, cuando llega ese momento, merece la pena pensar bien lo que vamos a adquirir, especialmente si tenemos en la cabeza dar el salto a uno con más pulgadas. Ahora que estamos en Black Friday, tenemos una muy buena oportunidad para ello, puesto que es posible encontrar modelos de gran formato a precios ajustados. Aunque eso sí: no todo es el tamaño.
TV QD-Mini LED 65" - TCL 65P8L, UHD 4K, TCL AiPQ Processor, Smart TV, DVB-T2, Dolby Vision·Atmos, 144Hz, Google TV, Negro
Una de las opciones más interesantes ahora mismo la tenemos con el TCL P8L, un televisor QD-Mini LED que podemos adquirir en varios tamaños diferentes: de 55 a 98 pulgadas. Son varias las cosas que destacan del mismo (las vamos a ver a continuación), pero su precio en Black Friday es lo más tentador: por ejemplo, tenemos disponible el de 65 pulgadas por 549 euros.
TCL P8L: un televisor QD-Mini LED disponible en hasta 98 pulgadas
Lo primero a destacar de esta tele TCL es que combina retroiluminación Mini LED con puntos cuánticos. Pero, ¿y qué ventajas tiene esto? En esencia, es una combinación que permite controlar mejor la iluminación de la pantalla, una gama de colores más amplia y un mejor contraste. El TCL P8L, además, incorpora el procesador AiPQ, encargado de optimizar aspectos como la nitidez o el color de lo que estamos viendo.
A esto hay que sumarle que es un televisor con una tasa de refresco nativa de 144 Hz, algo ideal para gaming y para escenas con movimientos rápidos. Además, cuenta con algunas tecnologías como el VRR, que adapta el refresco de la tele a los fotogramas que genera la consola o PC que estemos usando. De esta forma, se evita un desgarro en la imagen o el conocido como tearing.
Además de todo lo anterior, es compatible con HDR10+ y Dolby Vision e incorpora Google TV, que facilita el acceso a las principales plataformas de entretenimiento y ofrece funciones inteligentes de Google, con integración de Gemini según disponibilidad. También tiene Chromecast integrado (para mandar contenido desde el móvil, por ejemplo), funciones de control por voz y un sistema de sonido Onkyo 2.1 con subwoofer integrado en las versiones a partir de 65 pulgadas.
Tenemos la TCL A65K para completar la experiencia
Este sistema de sonido tiene lo necesario para rendir bien, pero podemos ir un pasito más allá si queremos una experiencia más envolvente. Ahí está la TCL A65K, una barra de sonido que incorpora un sistema de 3.1.2 canales físicos y que es compatible tanto con Dolby Atmos como con DTS:X.

Otro de sus puntos interesantes es TCL AI Sonic-Adaptation, una función que, a través de la aplicación TCL Home, permite analizar las características acústicas de la habitación y ajustar el sonido para ofrecer una experiencia de escucha más equilibrada.
Todo ello en un diseño ultradelgado, con una altura de aproximadamente 5,2 centímetros, que permite colocarla discretamente bajo el televisor. La tenemos disponible por 175 euros.

¿Qué tamaño de TCL P8L es el ideal para ti?
Volviendo al televisor, es muy importante elegir el tamaño correcto. Esto es algo que viene determinado por nuestro presupuesto, pero también por el espacio que tenemos disponible en casa. Por ejemplo, si nuestro salón tiene un tamaño medio, lo ideal sería adquirir un TCL P8L de 65 pulgadas, la opción más equilibrada. Si preferimos tener más pantalla, la versión de 75 pulgadas puede ser la indicada para nosotros, especialmente si tenemos una distancia de visionado aproximada de entre 2,5 y 3 metros. Si tienes un salón especialmente amplio o si directamente buscas montar un cine en casa, la versión de 98 pulgadas es entonces una opción interesante para ti. TV QD-Mini LED 98" - TCL 98P8L, UHD 4K, TCL AiPQ Pro Processor, Smart TV, DVB-T2 (H.265), Negro

articles.title: Rackspace forced to shut down Spot cloud platform following security breach
articles.text:
Rackspace forced to shut down Spot cloud platform following security breach
Users are paying their respects on Reddit
- Attackers used stolen credentials to access Rackspace Spot, exposing Kubernetes secrets, API tokens, and other sensitive cloud resources
- Rackspace revoked affected credentials, advised customers to rotate secrets, and investigate cluster activity for potential compromise
- The company later announced it would discontinue the Rackspace Spot platform, giving customers until December 8 to migrate their workloads
Rackspace has recently announced it is shutting down its cloud platform, Rackspace Spot, allegedly after cybercriminals broke in and stole user information.
In the early hours of November 17 2026, a threat actor used stolen login credentials to access parts of Rackspace Spot. The company learned about the intrusion a day later from a customer report, and later confirmed that multiple customers had been affected.
During the intrusion, the unidentified attackers created pods in people’s clusters, read Kubernetes secrets, and listed nodes and volumes.
What happened?
“With that access, they could have read any Secret in an affected user’s clusters, and any Spot API token or refresh token that user held,” Rackspace told the affected customers in a data breach notice emailed at the time.
Kubernetes Secrets can hold sensitive information, including database passwords, API keys, or authentication credentials. If threat actors managed to access these, they could use them to compromise other services, or systems connected to affected clusters. This is, among other things, why Rackspace urged its users to rotate their credentials, even if no data leak was confirmed.
To tackle the intrusion, Rackspace revoked affected Spot tokens and sessions, removed the pods the attackers created, and rotated the platform and storage keys involved.
The company urged its customers to reissue their Spot API tokens and replace any Spot refresh tokens stored in automation. It also told them to download fresh kubeconfigs for their cloudspaces, rotate credentials stored in their cluster Secrets, and review access logs from November 17 onward.
Sign up to the TechRadar Pro newsletter to get all the top news, opinion, features and guidance your business needs to succeed!
Pulling the plug
A few days after the incident, the company apparently decided it was time to sunset the whole operation. In an email notice seen by BleepingComputer, the company gave its customers until December 8 to migrate their services and download their data.
"Following a review of the situation, Rackspace has made the decision to wind down the Rackspace Spot service. This decision is being made to provide a clear path forward for customers," the company said in the notice.
Customers have until December 8, 2026, 5PM Central Time, to move their data, after which all remaining workloads will be terminated.
The announcement did not sit well with Rackspace’s customers. Its cloud computing platform was a relatively inexpensive way to access cloud servers, virtual machines, and managed Kubernetes infrastructure. Its unique selling proposition was to offer lower cloud computing costs through a bidding system, rather than traditional fixed pricing. The company advertised savings of up to 90% compared to conventional, on-demand computing resources, with the caveat being that users must design their workloads to tolerate possible interruptions.
And tolerate them, they did. Reddit is filled with disappointed users, some of which are even urging the company to reconsider.
“I bet the vast majority of spot users would gladly pay a bit more for the service to keep it running,” one user said. “It's incomparable to anything out there right now. For the average Joe it's not the service, but for those of us who can handle our own clusters and workarounds the quirks, it's by far the best option out there.”
“Don't take this down!!!”
Others were more at peace with their fate, thanking Rackspace for the affordable compute and saying, “it was good while it lasted.” Rackspace has not commented on the calls to keep going, so we don’t know if they’re willing to reconsider.
As of November 25, 2026, no threat actors claimed responsibility for the attack on Rackspace, so we don’t know if this was ransomware or a nation-state attack. Furthermore, the data stolen in the incident doesn’t appear to have surfaced anywhere on the dark web, either for sale or for free.

articles.title: Il est désormais possible de se connecter à FranceConnect avec l'application carte Vitale
articles.text:
Une nouvelle méthode rejoint les six existantes pour vous connecter à FranceConnect. L'application carte Vitale est désormais de la partie, pour près de 4 millions d'utilisateurs.
L'application carte Vitale rejoint la liste des fournisseurs d'identité de FranceConnect. Elle permet depuis peu de se connecter à plus de 1 800 services publics en ligne, grâce à une double authentification sur smartphone. L'objectif : simplifier les démarches des usagers.
Un moyen d'identification supplémentaire
Pour accéder à une démarche en ligne via FranceConnect, il fallait jusqu'ici utiliser l'un des comptes ou identités numériques déjà reconnus par le dispositif : impots.gouv, compte ameli, France identité, MSA, Trustme ou l'INLP. L'application carte Vitale s'ajoute à cette liste. Elle concerne les 3,8 millions d'assurés qui l'ont téléchargée et activée.
Le parcours se déroule en trois étapes. L'usager choisit « FranceConnect » sur le site de la démarche qu'il souhaite effectuer, sélectionne l'application carte Vitale parmi les fournisseurs d'identité proposés, puis valide la connexion sur son téléphone.
Cette validation repose sur deux éléments : le smartphone sur lequel l'application a été activée, et l'identification par biométrie ou par mot de passe. Une personne qui ne disposerait que de l'un des deux ne pourrait pas se connecter à la place de l'usager.
Parmi les services accessibles par cette méthode figurent le portail des Allocations familiales (CAF), le portail Ameli, les sites de l'Agence nationale des titres sécurisés (ANTS) et info-retraite.fr.
Deux modes d'utilisation
L'application peut servir à s'identifier de deux manières, complémentaires.
Via FranceConnect, cette option s'adresse aux usagers qui veulent accéder aux services en ligne compatibles. Seules les données d'identité civile sont alors transmises.
Par accès direct, les fournisseurs de services peuvent intégrer le bouton « M'identifier avec mon appli carte Vitale » dans leur propre parcours d'identification. Cette option concerne en particulier les secteurs de la santé, du social et du médico-social : prise de rendez-vous en ligne, pré-admission en ligne dans les établissements de santé, téléconsultation, etc. Selon les données demandées et autorisées, il est possible de transmettre l'identité civile, l'Identité Nationale de Santé (INS) et des informations relatives à l'assurance maladie obligatoire. Les informations sur l'assurance maladie complémentaire sont prévues par la suite.
Ce second mode répond notamment aux besoins des acteurs du numérique en santé dont les démarches exigent une vérification d'identité renforcée. Les premiers services pourront intégrer la fonctionnalité au fur et à mesure que les fournisseurs concernés y seront autorisés.
Source : Gouvernement

articles.title: AMD's Radeon RX 9060 XT sets new GPU frequency world record of 4.837 GHz — VP Jack Huynh and veteran OCer Bill Alverson push mid-range RDNA 4 GPU to the max under liquid nitrogen
articles.text:
Radeon RX 9060 XT sets new GPU frequency world record of 4.837 GHz — AMD overclocking team pushes mid-range RDNA 4 GPU to the max under liquid nitrogen
AMD's smaller RDNA 4 GPU gets one step closer to 5 GHz.
AMD has set a new GPU overclocking world record by pushing the Radeon RX 9060 XT to 4,837 MHz. Veteran overclocker Bill Alverson and AMD VP Jack Huynh found the limits of this particular chip as part of a celebration of the opening of a new Micro Center location in Austin, Texas. According to the OC World Record Museum database maintained by SkatterBencher, Huynh and Alverson set the new record on November 15.
If you were expecting to see this record from AMD's high-end RX 9070 XT, you're not crazy. The record was indeed achieved using the midrange RDNA 4 part rather than AMD’s flagship GPU. The RX 9060 XT uses a smaller Navi 44 GPU featuring 2,048 shading units (32 compute units), a 160W TDP, 16GB of GDDR6 memory on a 128-bit bus, and a stock boost clock speed of up to 3,130 MHz.
The new frequency record was achieved using liquid nitrogen cooling. At 4,837 MHz, the GPU was running approximately 54.5% faster than its advertised boost frequency. A GPU-Z screenshot confirms the record breaking frequency with the GPU temperature at -49°C, 62W power draw, and voltage at 1.434V.
Of course, nobody should expect these numbers to bear any relationship to the clock speeds that can be achieved from any stock, air-cooled RX 9060 XT. Liquid nitrogen and liquid helium are commonly used in extreme overclocking, as they bring component temperatures well below what air and liquid cooling at ambient temperatures can achieve, essentially removing thermal limits from an overclocking attempt and enabling large amounts of power to be pushed into a chip for the highest clocks.
But these coolants require careful preparation of hardware, constant monitoring, and custom heatsinks to contain them while an extreme overclocking run is in progress, and they're only useful for short durations due to evaporation.
Such record-breaking frequencies are primarily intended to demonstrate the absolute limits of the hardware itself, rather than serve as an example of sustained performance for everyday use cases.
This isn’t the first time enthusiasts have pushed AMD’s RDNA 4 GPU to extreme frequencies. The RX 9060 XT previously reached 4,769 MHz in February 2026, followed by another attempt in June which reportedly reached 4,789 MHz. The latest attempt is 48 MHz higher compared to the previous record, bringing AMD’s latest GPU IP closer than ever to the elusive 5 GHz milestone.
Get Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.
For the average gamer, the biggest obstacle to getting the most out of an RX 9060 XT isn't its overclocking headroom, but its high price in late 2026. The RX 9060 XT 16GB had an MSRP of just $349, but these cards are currently selling for over $700, making this formerly budget-friendly enthusiast card a poor value today. Achieving a world-record GPU frequency on one of these chips is an impressive achievement in extreme overclocking, but it's unlikely to translate into more Radeon gamers any time soon.

articles.title: QNAP Launches 2U 12-inch Short-Depth 8-Bay HDD NAS TS-h1065eU/TS-h1065eU-RP
articles.text:
Wednesday, November 25th 2026
QNAP Launches 2U 12-inch Short-Depth 8-Bay HDD NAS TS-h1065eU/TS-h1065eU-RP
QNAP Systems, Inc., a leading innovator in storage, networking, and data protection solutions, today introduced its new 12-inch short-depth NAS series, the TS-h1065eU and TS-h1065eU-RP. Equipped with eight 3.5-inch drive bays and two highly expandable E1.S/M.2 PCIe NVMe slots, these new NAS models provide large storage capacity, high performance, and flexible expansion in a compact 2U chassis. They are ideal for small to medium-sized businesses and edge deployment scenarios where space is limited.
Sean Teng, Product Manager of QNAP,"QNAP continues to enhance its exclusive short-depth NAS series to help businesses build storage solutions that balance capacity, performance, and data protection in space-constrained environments. The TS-h1065eU series is designed for users who need high storage capacity, cache performance, and data security, providing the optimal balance between long-term stability and overall cost-effectiveness."
TS-h1065eU/TS-h1065eU-RP product highlights
- High Reliability ZFS Storage: The ZFS-based QuTS hero operating system supports self-healing, inline data deduplication and compression, along with SnapSync disaster recovery and WORM data protection, ensuring data immutability while optimizing SSD performance for mission-critical workloads.
- 2U 12-inch Short Depth Design Saves 38% Rack Space: With a depth of just 30.48 cm (12 inches), the short-depth NAS series can be easily deployed in shallow racks, edge storage environments, or space-constrained areas such as data centers, AV rooms, and surveillance control rooms, maximizing the utility of limited space.
- DDR5 Memory for Performance and Reliability: Equipped with high-performance, low-power DDR5 memory (expandable up to 16 GB) and supports In-Band ECC (IBECC) to further enhance data integrity and system stability.
- Next-Generation Intel Quad-Core Processor with iGPU Acceleration: Powered by a quad-core processor with a clock speed burst up to 3.6 GHz, supporting AES-NI hardware encryption acceleration, and integrated Intel graphics (iGPU) for video decoding, display acceleration, and Intel OpenVINO AI inference acceleration (such as facial recognition), boosting the efficiency of surveillance and multimedia applications.
- Flexible Storage Expansion: Leverage the QXP-40G2UC expansion card for connecting two USB4 JBOD TL-R1210TC4-RP storage expansion devices, adding up to 24 additional hard drives to meet data growth and long-term backup needs.
- Excellent Network Connectivity and Storage Expansion Flexibility: Two 2.5GbE ports, and two E1.S / M.2 PCIe NVMe slots that can be configured as SSD cache or high-speed storage pools; paired with the QXG-ES10G1T E1.S network expansion card for 10GbE expansion. Port Trunking or SMB Multichannel further enhances bandwidth, meeting high-performance needs for fast transfers, large file accesses, and backup/restore operations. A PCIe slot is also provided for flexible expansion with a 2-port 10GbE NIC, storage expansion card, or QM2 M.2 SSD card.
- Ideal for Surveillance, AI Facial Recognition, and Edge Recording Applications: Equipped with high-capacity hard drives and iGPU video acceleration, ideal for deploying QNAP's QVR Surveillance Solution to centrally manage multiple camera feeds, run smart surveillance applications, and secure video footage. The iGPU, combined with the Intel OpenVINO inference engine, offloads AI video analytics to reduce CPU load, accelerating QVR Face real-time facial recognition, QVR Human people detection and counting, and QVR Smart Search for fast video retrieval.
- Redundant Power Supply for System Stability: The TS-h1065eU-RP features dual power supply redundancy, reducing the risk of power failure and enhancing business continuity by ensuring stable, uninterrupted service.
The TS-h1065eU and TS-h1065eU-RP NAS models are available now.

- New York has enacted a five-year moratorium on the manufacturing, distribution, and sale of AI-powered toys
- The ban comes ahead of the holiday season, with parents warned that many AI toys currently operate with minimal safety guardrails
- Numerous studies have found AI toys to be highly data-invasive, with some even encouraging children to find dangerous items
At a beloved Harlem toy store in New York, Governor Kathy Hochul announced a five-year ban on the manufacture and sale of AI toys, citing the potential harms that they can have on children.
Given that numerous AI toys have been found to be requesting dangerous levels of device access, such as location, microphone, and camera access, and others encouraging children to find dangerous objects such as matches and knives, many experts have called for greater regulation on putting the technology in children's toys.
Outside of the obvious risks in collecting data on children and AI toys hallucinating, Hochul also encouraged parents to actively engage in how their children play rather than resorting to tech to keep them entertained, especially during the holiday season.
No more AI toys in New York
“Parents, as you're out there buying gifts for the kids for the holiday season, I wanted you to hear this loud and clear. This is a warning that there are toys out there that could be harmful to your children,” Hochul said.
To enforce the new ruling, companies found to have violated the new rules could face hefty fines of up to $15,000 per day, with Hochul adding that regulations need to keep pace with technology in order to keep it safe.
The announcement was made at Grandma's Place, a toy store opened in the late 1990s by retired schoolteacher Dawn Harris-Martine. “A good toy for a child is the one that stretches their imagination,” Harris-Martine said, adding that parents need to be present with their children during play.
“Do not put an iPad in your child's hands and go off and let them sit there and play with it themselves, she said. “It's really necessary when a three-year-old can sit and listen to a teddy bear telling them to do strange things—it's not a good thing.”
Sign up for breaking news, reviews, opinion, top tech deals, and more.
"We as the parents, and the children, we want these toys to be fun," said Muna Heaven, a Harlem mother and member of Mothers Against Media Addiction. "But we also have a baseline expectation that they will be safe."
The ban comes alongside numerous child safety groups calling on huge retailers such as Amazon and eBay to pause the sale of AI toys until they can be proven to be safe.
AI toy concerns accompany wider worries surrounding the effect of AI and other technology on children, especially how they learn and interact with the world around them.
New York mayor Zohran Mamdani has banned the use of AI in some schools and has encouraged New Yorkers to push back against the “reckless adoption” of AI. This has already caused issues with how Google search is deployed for education in New York.
Studies have found that students are increasingly turning to AI to help with schoolwork, with 96% of college students using the technology to help stay on top of their education. Some countries have taken drastic measures, with Norway banning AI from being used to educate those below the age of 13 to allow basic reading, writing, and math skills to develop.
For better or for worse, how AI affects the way children learn and play will likely take years to be fully understood.

articles.title: Consultar el voto con la IA: lo que más pesa en la respuesta no es el programa electoral, eres tú
articles.text:
Parecía que no iban a llegar, pero ya casi están aquí: las elecciones del 29N son el próximo domingo. Los diferentes partidos han ido lanzando propuestas, todas reunidas en sus respectivos programas electorales. Como dichos programas son más densos que cambiar el Colacao por cemento, la IA se ha convertido en la herramienta ideal para consultarlos. Ahora bien: los chatbots no son tan imparciales como parecen.
Los programas electorales. Los hay escuetos y los hay tan enrevesados como un BOE tras el Consejo de Ministros. ChatGPT y compañía son muy útiles para resumir esos documentos casi ilegibles, igual que para hacer comparaciones entre los distintos programas y partidos.
Desde el programa electoral más corto (el de Vox, con 66 páginas) al más largo (el de Frente Amplio, con 158 páginas), hay más del doble de extensión. ¿Significa eso que las izquierdas proponen más medidas que las derechas? No tiene por qué: cada partido cuenta y desarrolla las propuestas a su manera. Para saberlo de verdad habría que entrar con bisturí en los documentos y después compararlos con lupa. Es normal que deleguemos este trabajo en la IA.
Qué dicen los datos. Si los chatbots son ya un recurso habitual para desgranar contratos, documentos del banco y otros ficheros de texto difíciles de entender, la lógica dicta que debemos de ser muchos quienes les pedimos consejo de voto. Los datos dibujan una práctica que crece, pero que todavía es minoritaria.
Según el INE, el 54,8% de la población de 16 a 74 años usó herramientas de IA generativa en los tres últimos meses, 16,9 puntos más que en 2025. La diferencia por edad es enorme: la ha usado el 83,3% de los jóvenes de 16 a 24 años, frente al 19,5% de quienes tienen entre 65 y 74. Pero usarla no es lo mismo que informarse con ella. Según el Digital News Report España 2026, solo el 8% usó chatbots para acceder a noticias en la última semana, y apenas el 1% los considera su fuente principal.
En España no hay datos públicos sobre cuántos votantes usan los chatbots de IA para decidir hacia qué partido va su papeleta. La referencia más cercana es Reino Unido: en las elecciones generales de 2024, el 13% de los votantes recurrió a ellos para buscar información útil con la que decidir su voto.
Lo que sí se ha medido es qué responden. Un estudio de la UOC y Science4Insights, cuyas primeras oleadas ya contamos en Xataka, lanzó este mes 61 preguntas a seis chatbots de IA en las cuatro lenguas oficiales. El 85,4% de las respuestas evitó recomendar un partido, pero no todos se comportaron igual: Grok se decantó en el 44,7% de los casos y ChatGPT en el 25,4%, frente al 1,6% de Gemini y el 1,2% de Claude.
Los sesgos. Una cosa es pedirle a ChatGPT que resuma lo imprescindible de una hipoteca y otra muy distinta pedirle que te oriente el voto a partir de los programas. La respuesta terminará influida por determinados sesgos:
- El de la memoria. Si tienes configurada la IA para que recuerde los datos que intercambias con ella, puede terminar usándolos para darte una recomendación de voto, más allá de lo que digan los programas electorales. Un estudio del MIT y Penn State comprobó que el perfil que el chatbot guarda del usuario es lo que más aumenta su tendencia a darle la razón.
- El del entrenamiento. Varios estudios, como el de David Rozado o el de Stanford, han encontrado que la mayoría de modelos responde con cierta tendencia progresista, fruto de su entrenamiento. No es una regla fija: Grok tiende a virar a la derecha, y en la última oleada de la UOC el partido más recomendado fue el PP.
- El de la complacencia. Los modelos de IA tienden a darte la razón, incluso aunque los datos objetivos apunten a lo contrario. Si el chatbot sabe hacia qué lado se inclina tu voto, te aconsejará en ese mismo sentido. En un experimento publicado en El Salto, cuando el perfil declaraba afinidad con un partido, el modelo de OpenAI se la confirmó en el 99,97% de las respuestas.
- El del modelo. No todos los chatbots responden igual. De hecho, un mismo modelo puede cambiar de un mes para otro: según la UOC, la cuota de recomendaciones de ChatGPT a favor del PSOE cayó del 44,6% al 20,9% entre octubre y noviembre.
- El del idioma. Preguntar en catalán, euskera o gallego puede hacer variar las recomendaciones. En catalán, la IA citaba de media más formaciones que en castellano (4,78 frente a 3,82) y daba más visibilidad a los partidos de ámbito autonómico.
Todo termina influyendo, es la suma de todos los factores. La IA puede contrastar los programas electorales y trazar las diferencias entre las distintas medidas. Pero, al final, siempre habrá factores ajenos a los programas que hagan que la balanza se incline hacia un lado que no tiene por qué ser el tuyo.
Cómo usar la IA sin que vote por ti. Estas herramientas son buenas para leer programas y regulares para aconsejar el voto. Lo más sensato es pedirle comparaciones y no recomendaciones, abrir un chat temporal para esta tarea o con la memoria desactivada y exigirle que cite la página del programa para comprobar en qué se basa su recomendación. Al final, la IA puede ahorrarte horas de lectura, pero no debería borrarte el criterio.

articles.title: Le Black Friday s’invite en cuisine : le prix de l’airfryer Ninja Foodi FlexDrawer fond de 110 € chez Amazon
articles.text:
Le Ninja Foodi FlexDrawer est un airfryer doté d’un seul tiroir, qu’il est possible de diviser en deux pour réaliser des cuissons séparées. Pour le Black Friday, Amazon propose sa version beige et or à 159,99 € au lieu de 269,99 €.
L’airfryer peut facilement remplacer le four traditionnel dans de nombreuses situations, à condition de disposer d’un modèle dont la capacité est adaptée à vos besoins. Le Ninja Foodi FlexDrawer propose une généreuse capacité de 10,4 litres qui convient à un usage familial, et il y a un twist : son compartiment peut se diviser en deux pour offrir deux zones de cuisson. En ce moment, le Ninja Foodi FlexDrawer AF500EUSD est disponible pour 159,99 € chez Amazon. Son prix baisse de 41 % durant le Black Friday, ce qui le rend encore plus intéressant.
Le Ninja Foodi FlexDrawer de 10,4 litres est à 159,99 € au lieu de 269,99 € chez Amazon pendant le Black Friday.
Pourquoi choisir le Ninja Foodi FlexDrawer ?
- Pour son séparateur amovible : passez de deux zones de 5,2 litres à un grand espace de 10,4 litres pour préparer vos plats familiaux.
- Pour la synchronisation des cuissons : la fonction Sync permet de terminer deux préparations au même moment, malgré des réglages différents.
- Pour ses sept modes : l’appareil peut notamment frire à l’air chaud, rôtir, réchauffer, déshydrater et faire lever une pâte.
Un tiroir qui s’adapte à tous vos menus
Le Ninja Foodi FlexDrawer dispose d’un grand tiroir de 10,4 litres, mais l’airfryer intègre aussi deux systèmes de cuisson qui peuvent fonctionner de manière indépendante. En séparant le tiroir en deux zones de 5,2 litres, vous pouvez, par exemple, préparer du poulet d’un côté et des légumes de l’autre, chacun avec sa température et sa durée de cuisson.
En retirant le séparateur, vous disposez de l’espace nécessaire pour faire cuire une grande pièce de viande ou plusieurs kilogrammes de frites. Le tiroir, les plaques de cuisson et le séparateur sont amovibles et passent au lave-vaisselle.
Plus modulable qu’un modèle à deux paniers, mais encombrant
Si le grand espace de cuisson de cet appareil offre une grande souplesse d’utilisation, cela le rend également plus encombrant que d’autres modèles. En outre, l’unique tiroir oblige à ouvrir les deux zones ensemble pour remuer ou vérifier une cuisson.
✅ Les points forts
- Capacité modulable de 10,4 litres.
- Réglages indépendants et fins de cuisson synchronisées.
- Éléments amovibles compatibles avec le lave-vaisselle.
❌ Les limites
- Format volumineux sur le plan de travail.
- Un seul tiroir à ouvrir pour accéder aux deux zones.
Pour le Black Friday, le Ninja Foodi FlexDrawer passe à 159,99 € chez Amazon dans sa version beige et or.
Pour les grandes familles adeptes du fait maison, le Ninja Foodi FlexDrawer se présente comme un ajout utile à installer dans la cuisine. Ses sept modes de cuisson et sa température qui peut monter jusqu’à 240°C en mode Max Crisp autorisent bien des préparations.
Pour un couple, sa capacité de 10,4 litres peut s’avérer trop importante. L’encombrement est aussi à prendre en considération dans une petite cuisine. Dans ce genre de situation, un modèle d’une plus petite capacité peut s’avérer plus adapté.
