articles.title: Comment la Russie utilise l'IA pour filtrer le trafic Internet
articles.text:
Le régulateur russe a dépensé 2,27 milliards de roubles (environ 28 millions de dollars) pour un système de filtrage basé sur l’apprentissage automatique. La description du système ne mentionne pas les VPN, mais un expert pense que l’outil pourrait servir à les repérer.
Le programme 2026-2028 de Roskomnadzor, révélé le 13 novembre, ne donne pas de nom à ce modèle. Il tourne sur l’infrastructure du régulateur et ce n’est pas un grand modèle de langage, du genre de ceux qui animent les chatbots.
Repérer un VPN à son comportement plutôt qu’à son contenu
Nous rapportions début avril que le ministre du numérique, Maksut Shadayev, annonçait un renforcement de la répression contre les VPN, après près de 400 services déjà bloqués à la mi-janvier. Le nouvel outil se base sur l’apprentissage automatique. Il s’intègre au système qui pilote les TSPU, des équipements de filtrage installés chez les fournisseurs d’accès à Internet russes.
Ces équipements pratiquent déjà l’inspection approfondie des paquets (DPI). Elle examine les adresses IP, les paramètres de connexion, la taille des paquets de données et la façon dont ils circulent. Elle ne peut pas lire un contenu chiffré, mais ces indices peuvent suffire à repérer un VPN, un peu comme on devine la nature d’un colis à son poids sans l’ouvrir.
Reste à connaître l'usage exact de ce nouveau modèle. Proton explique que le document ne fait aucune mention des VPN. En revanche, selon Dmitry Kuteinikov, du groupe de défense de la liberté d’Internet RKS Global, le modèle pourrait estimer la probabilité qu’une connexion soit un VPN, d’après la taille et le rythme des paquets ou la durée de la session. Mais sans certitude cette probabilité pourrait affecter le fonctionnement des VPN d’entreprise et des services cloud. Un projet de plan national sur l’intelligence artificielle aurait aussi inclus un objectif chiffré : bloquer les VPN avec “95 % d’efficacité”. Les informations rapportées ne précisent pas comment cette efficacité serait mesurée. Le ministère du numérique affirme que la version actuelle du texte ne contient aucune mesure de ce genre.
Proton rappelle que des blocages touchent des plages entières d’adresses chez des hébergeurs depuis août. Depuis début novembre, des messages sur Telegram parlent de serveurs privés, partagés par deux ou trois personnes, qui tombent en quelques heures alors qu’ils fonctionnaient pendant des mois. Aucune mesure publiée ne confirme l’ampleur de cette vague et Roskomnadzor, le régulateur russe d’internet n’a pas commenté. Un test sur quatre serveurs privés donne des résultats inégaux : trois sont devenus inaccessibles après trois jours, huit jours et environ trois mois, le quatrième a tenu quatre mois, jusqu’à ce que son propriétaire l’éteigne. Le projet de budget 2027-2029 réserve par ailleurs près de 60 milliards de roubles (environ 730 millions de dollars) au filtrage du trafic, soit environ le double du montant annuel prévu jusque-là.
Source : Proton

articles.title: Le casque sans fil qui transforme un RER en bibliothèque est à son meilleur prix pour le Black Friday
articles.text:
Bose a construit sa réputation sur la réduction de bruit active, et le QuietComfort SC en est l’illustration directe. Ce casque circum-aural sans fil pèse 240 grammes et se positionne juste en dessous du QuietComfort Ultra, dont il reprend l’essentiel des qualités sonores sans le mode spatial. Face à des concurrents comme le Sony WH-1000XM6 ou le Jabra Evolve2, il tient largement la comparaison sur le confort et l’isolation. Et pour le Black Friday, Cdiscount propose le QuietComfort SC avec un code promo qui le fait tomber à 135,99 euros.
Les atouts du Bose QuietComfort SC
- Son puissant et détaillé, réponse en fréquence très large
- Réduction de bruit active parmi les plus efficaces du marché
- Léger (240 g), confortable, avec coussinets à mémoire de forme
Sur Cdiscount, le Bose QuietComfort SC est affiché à 150,99 euros, puis passe à 135,99 euros en appliquant le code 10DES99 au moment du paiement. Une belle occasion de mettre la main sur un casque haut de gamme noté 9/10 pour moins de 140 euros.
Si, par la suite, l’offre mentionnée dans cet article n’est plus disponible, merci de jeter un coup d’œil ci-dessous afin de dénicher d’autres offres concernant Bose QuietComfort SC. Le tableau s’actualise automatiquement.
Un casque taillé pour le confort longue durée
Le QuietComfort SC est un casque circum-aural : les coussinets englobent entièrement les oreilles, même les plus grandes. La mousse à mémoire de forme est particulièrement tendre, et le revêtement en cuir synthétique ne chauffe pas désagréablement à l’usage. L’arceau est réglable pour les grandes têtes. Dans notre test, Tristan Jacquel a porté le casque des heures sans inconfort, ce qui est loin d’être acquis dans cette catégorie.
Le châssis est presque entièrement en plastique, avec une âme d’arceau en métal. L’ensemble reste sobre, intégralement mat et sans fioriture visuelle. La qualité de fabrication est solide : aucun craquement quand on tord le casque, et les chocs accidentels sont bien amortis. Le détecteur de port est absent, ce qui oblige à mettre en pause manuellement la lecture quand on retire le casque.
Un son équilibré et une réduction de bruit redoutable
C’est sur le plan sonore et l’isolation que le Bose QuietComfort SC se distingue nettement. Notre test relève une réponse en fréquence très large et des qualités dynamiques au-dessus de la moyenne, avec une scène sonore bien construite. Le résultat : un son détaillé et percutant qui s’adapte aussi bien à la musique classique qu’aux genres plus bass-heavy. L’ANC, lui, est capable de faire passer le bruit d’un moteur diesel pour celui d’un train électrique, ce qui reste l’une des meilleures performances du segment. Autonomie annoncée : 24 heures avec la réduction de bruit activée, ce qui couvre largement une semaine d’usage quotidien sans chercher le câble.
Seul bémol mesuré : le volume reste un peu faible sur l’entrée analogique lorsque le casque est allumé, un cas d’usage marginal mais à noter si vous comptez l’utiliser filaire en mode alimenté.

articles.title: Hackers now exploit critical Drupal RCE flaw to hijack sites
articles.text:
The Drupal security team has confirmed that a critical vulnerability that lets attackers hijack unpatched sites has been actively exploited since at least Thursday.
Drupal is a content management system (CMS) commonly used by large organizations, including government entities, major research universities, and high-profile enterprise and media organizations.
The security flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-132165, was discovered by Anthropic's OSS Scanner and can be exploited by anonymous users to gain remote code execution or take over vulnerable sites by abusing the Drupal installer.
"Drupal core ships with an install.php file for installing Drupal core. Under specific conditions, an attacker can use the installer to attempt to reinstall Drupal. This can lead to a site takeover or remote code execution," the Drupal security team warned last Wednesday. "Some exploit paths are mitigated if the web server cannot write to or change permissions on settings.php."
While it wasn't initially flagged as abused in the wild, in an update to the original security advisory, Drupal warned that this flaw has been "exploited on live sites as early as 2026-11-19 19:00 UTC."
Websites using the paid Drupal Steward Web Application Firewall (WAF) service are already protected from known attack vectors, but admins are still advised to upgrade to the latest available Drupal version in case other attack vectors are discovered.
Those who can't immediately upgrade should block access to /core/install.php in the web server configuration or the .htaccess file in the web root to secure the Drupal installer.
On Tuesday, the US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has also added the vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog and ordered federal agencies to secure their systems against ongoing attacks by Friday, November 27.
"These types of vulnerabilities are a frequent attack vector for malicious cyber actors and pose significant risks to the federal enterprise," the agency warned. "While BOD 26-04 applies only to FCEB agencies, CISA encourages all organizations to adopt risk-based vulnerability management and prioritize remediation of KEV Catalog vulnerabilities."
Since November 2021, CISA has tagged five Drupal vulnerabilities as abused in the wild, two of which have also been exploited by ransomware groups.

articles.title: Beyond UPI: Why many Indians still need help accessing basic banking services
articles.text:
Beyond UPI: Why many Indians still need help accessing basic banking services
Assisted banking is not an alternative to regular banks or the mobile application that banks provide. Through the extension of their services via designated local access points, banks can make use of the business correspondent model to extend basic banking functions to the local population.
The digital payments revolution has changed the way transactions happen in India. In both urban and rural settings, transactions take place through the use of QR codes. The use of payment systems like UPI is common. According to the report by National Payments Corporation of India, as of October 2026, there were 25.47 billion transactions worth more than Rs 31.53 lakh crore made using UPI.
While there has been a quick shift towards the use of digital payments, the use of digital payments does not imply the use of routine banking services. Digital payments are only one component of routine banking services. Routine banking services include withdrawing cash, transferring money, and checking the balance. There has been uneven access to basic banking services in India despite the quick expansion in payment transactions.
Financial inclusion beyond opening bank accounts
Opening an account is the initial step of financial inclusion. According to the official PMJDY dashboard, the Department of Financial Services, under the Ministry of Finance of India, the total number of beneficiaries under Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana was 59.63 crore as on 21 October 2026.
The performance report demonstrates vast structural coverage: 46.29 crore beneficiaries come from rural and semi-urban areas, 33.26 crore beneficiaries are female beneficiaries, and deposits in accounts is Rs 3.25 lakh crore.
Having an account does not necessarily guarantee smooth operation through that account. An account itself does not make the trick when operational issues appear.
- Distance problem: The process of getting to formal banking facilities costs time and daily wage.
- Digital constraints: Many people have one smartphone in the family or do not know how to use complicated digital banking applications.
- Operational issues: Issues such as language barrier in banking application, poor network connection, and possibility of transaction failures discourage usage of banking application independently.
It is crucial to note that digital literacy significantly varies depending on region, generation and social class. For some families, which rely on cash money, the possibility of taking out the money is as important as receiving anything
Why assisted banking continues to matter
Although self-service mobile applications eliminate all hassles for many individuals, there are many instances in which customers require personal help. In such a scenario, the banking correspondent (BC) model and assisted banking become invaluable.
Assisted banking is not an alternative to regular banks or the mobile application that banks provide. Through the extension of their services via designated local access points, banks can make use of the BC model to extend basic banking functions to the local population.
Local retailers authorised by the appropriate authorities act as an important connection in this case. Due to the regular visits made by community members to these retail outlets for daily necessities, the provision of secure technology in them will enable customers to access banking facilities without making an extra effort to visit a faraway branch of the bank.
This human-based service point acts as a reassuring factor for new users. Assistance from a trusted local retailer in withdrawing money, checking balance, or transferring money within the country will provide comfort to all types of users.
Digital literacy, security, and building trust
It is not enough just to increase access; making sure that usage is safe is equally important. The customer may be quite happy to effect a merchant payment via UPI but may be unsure as to how to authenticate the receipt and deal with any surprise payment failure.
Long-term confidence-building can be accomplished through a concentrated effort in three main directions:
- Local language campaigns can educate customers on the issues of transaction authentication, fraud prevention, and safe use of the digital interface.
- Intermediate accountability can ensure that all local service centres and BCs do their job with maximum transparency. Although customers enter their authentication details into the secure terminal by themselves, they should be constantly reminded never to share these details with anybody, including the intermediaries.
- Grievance redressal is essential for cases of transaction failure to ensure that there is always a way out when something goes wrong, and if the customer’s money has been withdrawn from his or her account without completing the transaction.
The next phase must focus on usability
India has been rather successful in integrating millions of people into the formal financial sector with the help of various financial inclusion schemes. But, in the coming years, the attention must be on usability rather than integration of citizens in the formal financial sector.
It would take a joint effort from all the stakeholders in the ecosystem. On one hand, the banks have to ensure adequate availability and liquidity support to the local access points while, on the other hand, the technology companies have to develop an intuitive system that accommodates different levels of digital literacy.
In short, financial inclusion does not necessarily entail moving everything on a smartphone.
The author is Founder and CEO of Ezeepay, a digital financial services platform.
Edited by Swetha Kannan

articles.title: Du jamais-vu depuis 2013 : voici Ladybird, le navigateur qui ne dépend pas de Google, Apple ou Mozilla
articles.text:
L’alpha est arrivée le 23 novembre, en image disque pour macOS et en paquets Flatpak, Ubuntu ou Fedora côté Linux. Jusqu’ici, essayer Ladybird imposait de compiler soi-même son code source. Le canal est désormais continu, mis à jour automatiquement, et l’avertissement ne cache rien : « C’est une alpha, certains sites ne fonctionneront pas et il plantera parfois ».
Un web à trois moteurs, tous branchés sur la publicité
Chrome, Edge, Opera et consorts reposent sur Blink, Safari sur WebKit, Firefox sur Gecko. Le dernier moteur indépendant à avoir pesé s’est éteint en 2013, quand Opera a abandonné son Presto pour rejoindre la base de Chrome, un chemin que Microsoft a suivi en 2020 avec Edge.
Les trois moteurs sont open source. Blink et WebKit appartiennent pourtant à des géants de la publicité et du matériel, et l’essentiel des revenus de Mozilla provient d’un accord de recherche signé avec Google. « Ils sont tous financés par l’empire publicitaire de Google », résumait dès 2024 Chris Wanstrath, le cofondateur de GitHub qui a doté le projet d’un million de dollars. Ces mêmes acteurs siègent d’ailleurs aux consortiums qui écrivent les standards du web.
Ladybird, lancé en 2022 dans le sillage du système expérimental SerenityOS, n’emprunte pas une ligne de code à Blink, WebKit ou Gecko. Andreas Kling, son fondateur, est un ancien développeur WebKit passé par Apple et Nokia. La fondation à but non lucratif qu’il a montée avec Chris Wanstrath vit des dons et du mécénat d’entreprises comme Shopify, Cloudflare ou Proton VPN. Aucun accord de moteur de recherche par défaut n’est prévu.
Lire aussi : Proton recrute pour bâtir l’anti-Chrome que ses fans réclament depuis des années
Pourquoi treize ans sans nouveau venu
Un moteur de rendu doit parler toutes les langues du web : HTML, CSS, JavaScript et des centaines d’interfaces de programmation. Le W3C et le WHATWG, les consortiums qui tiennent ces standards, les amendent en continu, et suivre la cadence exige des ingénieurs à plein temps.
La conformité se mesure, et Ladybird s’y plie : le navigateur validait plus de 2 millions de sous-tests Web Platform Tests au printemps. Son score à l’exercice de vitesse Speedometer 2 est passé d’environ 47 à 64 au seul mois d’août. Le projet a aussi commencé, en février, à réécrire des pans entiers du code en Rust, moteur JavaScript en premier, pour limiter les bugs de mémoire propres au C++.
Aucune promesse n’est faite sur la sécurité, et les chercheurs sont même invités à malmener le logiciel : « Nous voulons que les passionnés de sécurité le piratent ! ». Les développeurs web disposent des protocoles WebDriver et des outils de développement de Firefox pour tester leurs sites. Windows devra patienter, faute d’installateur natif à ce stade.
La feuille de route vise une bêta en 2027 et une version stable en 2028, le temps de passer du jouet pour curieux au navigateur du quotidien. D’ici là, macOS et Linux peuvent déjà afficher un web rendu sans les lunettes de Google, d’Apple ou de Mozilla. Le projet entend prouver que le web reste une plateforme ouverte, où un moteur payé par des dons plutôt que par la publicité a droit de cité.

articles.title: Steve Jobs, fundador de Apple: “La única forma de hacer un gran trabajo es amando lo que se hace”
articles.text:
Una de las frases más recordadas de Steve Jobs, fundador de Apple, resume una parte central de su visión sobre el trabajo y las decisiones personales: “La única forma de hacer un gran trabajo es amando lo que se hace”.
La frase la pronunció durante su discurso de graduación en la Universidad de Stanford, en 2005, cuando relató tres experiencias de su vida: el abandono de la universidad, su despido de Apple y un diagnóstico de cáncer.
Jobs no presentó esas vivencias como una fórmula para alcanzar el éxito. Habló de incertidumbre, pérdidas y cambios de rumbo. Sus palabras, dirigidas entonces a jóvenes graduados, plantearon una invitación a valorar la curiosidad, sostener los proyectos propios y revisar las decisiones cuando la rutina se aleja de los objetivos personales.
Cómo fue la etapa en la universidad de Steve Jobs
Jobs contó que dejó el Reed College a los seis meses porque no encontraba sentido a gastar los ahorros de sus padres en una carrera sin un rumbo claro.
Aunque abandonó las materias obligatorias, siguió asistiendo a cursos que despertaban su interés. “Empecé a frecuentar con asiduidad las que sí consideraba interesantes”, explicó ante los estudiantes de Stanford.
Entre esas clases estaba la de caligrafía. Allí aprendió sobre tipografías, espaciado y diseño de letras, conocimientos que años después incorporó al primer Macintosh.
El consejo para los jóvenes no consistía en abandonar los estudios, sino en reconocer qué áreas despiertan una atención genuina y pueden aportar una mirada propia al trabajo futuro.
Por qué algunas decisiones solo cobran sentido con el paso del tiempo
La historia de la caligrafía llevó a Jobs a formular una de sus ideas más conocidas: “No pueden conectar los puntos mirando hacia el futuro, solo pueden conectarlos mirando hacia el pasado”. En su caso, una materia sin aplicación inmediata terminó por influir en el diseño de las computadoras personales.
El fundador de Apple proponía aceptar que algunas elecciones solo adquieren sentido con el tiempo. Para quienes comienzan una carrera laboral o académica, esa idea puede servir para reducir la presión de tener un plan cerrado desde el inicio. La formación, los trabajos temporales y los intereses culturales pueden aportar herramientas que luego sean útiles.
Qué hacer ante un fracaso profesional
A los 30 años, Jobs fue despedido de Apple, la empresa que había creado con Steve Wozniak en el garaje de la casa de sus padres. Describió aquel episodio como un fracaso público y recordó que, durante meses, no supo cuál sería su próximo paso.
Con el tiempo, interpretó esa situación de otra forma. “Ser despedido de Apple fue lo mejor que podría haberme pasado”, afirmó. Después creó NeXT y Pixar, y más tarde volvió a Apple tras la compra de NeXT.
Su experiencia sugiere que una pérdida laboral no define por completo una trayectoria y que, en ocasiones, obliga a reconsiderar capacidades, intereses y posibilidades.
Su consejo a los graduados fue: “Si aún no han encontrado un propósito, sigan buscando. No se rindan”. La idea no exige encontrar una vocación definitiva de inmediato. Plantea, en cambio, la necesidad de mantener una búsqueda activa, revisar las propias metas y no conformarse con un camino elegido.
Cuál pregunta se hacía Steve Jobs todos los días
Jobs relató que, desde los 17 años, se hacía una pregunta cada día frente al espejo: “Si hoy fuera el último día de mi vida, ¿querría hacer lo que estoy a punto de hacer?”. Cuando la respuesta era negativa durante varios días, entendía que necesitaba modificar algo en su rutina o en sus prioridades.
El diagnóstico de cáncer de páncreas que recibió antes de su discurso reforzó esa perspectiva. “Su tiempo es limitado, así que no lo pierdan viviendo la vida de otra persona”, dijo.
Para los jóvenes, el mensaje apunta a diferenciar los deseos propios de las presiones familiares, sociales o profesionales que pueden orientar decisiones sin reflejar convicciones personales.

articles.title: La nueva vida de Íñigo Segurola, expresentador de ‘Bricomanía’, viviendo en un bosque de 20 mil metros cuadrados
articles.text:
Íñigo Segurola fue durante más de dos décadas uno de los rostros más conocidos de ‘Bricomanía’, donde acompañaba a Kristian Pielhoff enseñando a los espectadores cómo cuidar sus plantas, diseñar jardines o montar un pequeño huerto en casa. Pero aquella etapa terminó en 2020, cuando el programa dejó de emitirse, y el paisajista donostiarra pasó a centrarse en un proyecto bastante más grande que los jardines que enseñaba en televisión: un espacio de 20.000 metros cuadrados rodeado de naturaleza en Oiartzun (Gipuzkoa).
Lo curioso es que Segurola no empezó de cero cuando abandonó los platós. En realidad, llevaba desde 2013 trabajando en Lur Garden, un jardín botánico que creó junto a su equipo y su entonces socio Juan Iriarte. Allí, en un pequeño valle, fue dando forma a lo que hoy es uno de sus grandes proyectos personales, con 16 jardines temáticos en los que se pueden encontrar desde plantas acuáticas hasta especies de inspiración japonesa. Y todo en un terreno de unas dos hectáreas.
Lur Garden, el jardín al que ha dedicado más de una década
En noviembre de 2024, Segurola reapareció en televisión durante una entrega de ‘MasterChef Celebrity’ que se grabó precisamente en su jardín. Allí habló del esfuerzo que había supuesto levantar aquel espacio: «Han sido 12 años de trabajo que no se acababan nunca, pero era algo que se tenía que hacer». El recinto cuenta con estanques, praderas y diferentes zonas vegetales que, además de recibir visitantes, sirven para experimentar con especies y diseños de paisajismo.
Y aunque ha dejado atrás su etapa habitual en ‘Bricomanía’, no ha abandonado la divulgación sobre jardinería. Sigue vinculado a ‘Jardinatis’, el proyecto digital en el que comparte consejos sobre plantas, huertos y mantenimiento de jardines. De hecho, Lur Garden también abre al público durante parte del año y ofrece visitas guiadas en las que el propio Segurola explica cómo ha ido construyendo cada espacio.
Su relación con la televisión, por tanto, ha cambiado bastante, pero no su trabajo con las plantas. En una entrevista con Deia explicó que vivía en Lur Garden, rodeado de vegetación y animales, mientras continuaba dedicándose al paisajismo. Un lugar que no solo es su hogar, sino también el resultado de muchos años de trabajo y que, desde 2021, pueden conocer quienes reservan una visita.

articles.title: League of Legends ganha ferramenta de coaching em tempo real com voz feminina
articles.text:
O aplicativo de coaching Absol anunciou, em parceria com a WIBR, o lançamento do que as empresas apresentam como a primeira voz feminina de coaching em tempo real para League of Legends (LoL) no Brasil.
Disponível a partir desta quarta-feira (25), a ferramenta oferece orientações durante as partidas, dicas personalizadas e avisos sobre objetivos do mapa, com o objetivo de incentivar a participação feminina nos esportes eletrônicos.
A data escolhida para o lançamento coincide com o Dia Internacional pela Eliminação da Violência contra as Mulheres.
Como funciona a ferramenta de coaching para League of Legends?
O Absol funciona em segundo plano durante as partidas de League of Legends, fornecendo orientações por voz de acordo com o andamento do jogo.
Entre os principais recursos da ferramenta estão:
- Avisos sobre os tempos de surgimento de objetivos, como Dragão e Barão;
- Orientações de posicionamento;
- Dicas específicas para cada campeã;
- Análise de desempenho após as partidas;
- Informações sobre dano, visão e tomada de decisão;
- Histórico e estatísticas de evolução.
Para utilizar a novidade, basta selecionar a voz feminina, identificada pela marca da WIBR, nas configurações do aplicativo.
O projeto é liderado por Laura Peres, gestora de produto do Absol, e a nova voz foi testada por jogadoras do cenário competitivo de League of Legends.
“Quando decidimos incluir uma voz feminina que ensina, orienta e comemora cada jogada, quisemos que cada jogadora sentisse que o Absol também foi feito para ela”, afirma Peres.
Iniciativa também cria comunidade exclusiva para mulheres
Além da ferramenta de coaching, a parceria contempla a criação de um canal exclusivo no Discord para pessoas que se identificam com o gênero feminino.
O espaço permitirá que jogadoras troquem experiências, encontrem parceiras para partidas ranqueadas, formem equipes e organizem sessões de jogo.
A comunidade será monitorada e moderada pela WIBR, com a proposta de oferecer um ambiente acolhedor para as participantes.
“A WIBR nasceu para que mais mulheres se sintam parte do universo dos games. Agora elas terão uma coach que fala com elas e uma comunidade para jogar junto”, afirma Roberta Coelho, criadora da WIBR e Chief Business Officer da SPUN.
A iniciativa também recebeu apoio de Samanta Penhalbel, publishing manager de League of Legends na Riot Games Brasil, que destacou a importância de ações voltadas à representatividade feminina na comunidade do jogo.
A nova voz está disponível na versão web e no aplicativo para desktop do Absol. Mais informações podem ser encontradas na página oficial da iniciativa.
Rachele Victoria é formada em Letras, MBA em Inovação e atua há 10 anos com comunicação e conteúdo gamer.
Amazon Prime também é feito para jogadores!
Todo mês, obtenha itens exclusivos, jogos grátis, uma assinatura gratuita na Twitch.tv e muito mais com sua assinatura Prime. Clique aqui para um teste gratuito de 30 dias.

articles.title: Wie Hawaii uns hilft, das Innere des Erdkerns zu entschlüsseln
articles.text:
Kosmisches Erbe: Forscher finden Kohlenstoff aus dem Erdkern auf Hawaii
Ein internationales Team unter Leitung des Geochemikers Yves Moussallam von der Columbia University in New York und des Kosmochemikers Damanveer Grewal von der Yale University in New Haven im US-Bundesstaat Connecticut hat erstmals anhand von Vulkangestein auf die Kohlenstoffzusammensetzung des Erdkerns geschlossen. Wie aus ihrer im Fachmagazin Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences veröffentlichten Studie hervorgeht, stammt der überwiegende Teil des irdischen Kohlenstoffs demnach von kohlenstoffreichen Meteoriten aus dem äußeren Sonnensystem.
Die Wissenschaftler:innen untersuchten dafür Lava-Ablagerungen auf der Inselgruppe Hawaii und stießen am Vulkan Kīlauea auf isotopisch schweren Kohlenstoff. „Wir gehen davon aus, dass wir Hinweise auf Kohlenstoff aus dem Erdkern gefunden haben, der in die Grenzschicht zwischen Kern und Mantel austritt und den gesamten Weg bis an die Oberfläche zurücklegt“, erklärt Erstautor Moussallam in einer Mitteilung der Columbia Climate School.
Vulkan Kīlauea auf Hawaii: Olivinkristalle bewahren Kohlenstoff aus Mantelplumes
Weil sich Kohlenstoff unter hohem Druck bevorzugt mit flüssigem Eisen verbindet, wanderten bei der Entstehung der Erde rund 80 Prozent des gesamten Bestands in den metallischen Kern. Nach oben gelangen Spuren davon laut dem Studienmodell über sogenannte Mantelplumes, das sind langsam aufsteigende Säulen aus heißem Gestein, die an der Grenze zwischen Erdkern und Erdmantel wurzeln und Vulkane wie den Kīlauea mit Magma speisen.
Steigt Magma zur Oberfläche auf, entweicht normalerweise gelöstes Kohlendioxid, wodurch sich die Zusammensetzung des zurückbleibenden Kohlenstoffs verändert. Kühlt die Gesteinsschmelze jedoch schon in der Tiefe ab, schließen wachsende Kristalle des Minerals Olivin winzige Magmatröpfchen luftdicht ein, noch bevor das Gas entweichen kann.
Anhand solcher Tröpfchen aus früheren Ausbrüchen des Kīlauea, die Moussallam als „Fossilien des Magmas“ bezeichnet, untersuchten die Forscher:innen das konservierte Gas. Sie maßen darin das Verhältnis der beiden Isotope Kohlenstoff-12 und Kohlenstoff-13, also zweier Atomvarianten, von denen die zweite durch ein zusätzliches Neutron im Kern etwas schwerer ist.
In der Geochemie wird dieses Verhältnis als Promille-Abweichung von einem festen Referenzwert angegeben: Je näher der Minuswert bei null liegt, desto mehr schwerer Kohlenstoff steckt in der Probe. Proben aus dem Vulkangebiet Tantalus am äußeren Rand der Aufstiegszone lagen mit minus fünf bis minus sieben Promille im normalen Bereich des Erdmantels, während das Gestein direkt über dem Zentrum am Kīlauea rund minus ein Promille erreichte.
Asteroid Bennu und die Entstehung des Mondes: Kohlenstoff aus dem äußeren Sonnensystem
Wie Mitautor Grewal in einer Mitteilung der Yale University erläutert, lässt sich anhand der Daten aus Hawaii erstmals mit Messwerten eingrenzen, welcher Kohlenstoff im Erdkern steckt. Die Proben vom Kīlauea passen nicht zum trockenen Gestein des inneren Sonnensystems, sondern zu wasser- und kohlenstoffreichen Steinmeteoriten aus dessen äußeren Regionen.
Ähnlich zusammengesetzten Kohlenstoff wiesen Forscher:innen bereits in Gesteinsproben des Asteroiden Bennu nach, die eine Raumsonde zur Erde gebracht hat. Die US-Raumfahrtbehörde Nasa stuft diesen über 4,5 Milliarden Jahre alten Himmelskörper als nahezu unveränderten Überrest aus der Frühzeit des Sonnensystems ein.
Laut Grewal konnten solche Meteoriten ihren Kohlenstoff nur in einer späten Phase der Erdentstehung dauerhaft im Kern ablagern. Bei früheren Einschlägen hätten nachfolgende Zusammenstöße den Kohlenstoff verdampft und wieder ins All geschleudert, während der metallische Erdkern bei späteren Treffern bereits fertig geformt und nach außen abgeschlossen war.
Den leichteren Kohlenstoff im darüberliegenden Erdmantel führen die Autor:innen auf den späteren Einschlag des etwa marsgroßen Himmelskörpers Theia zurück, durch den auch der Mond entstand. Da Theia laut einer im Wissenschaftsmagazin Science veröffentlichten Studie aus dem inneren Sonnensystem stammte, verteilte sich sein leichterer Kohlenstoff vor allem im Gesteinsmantel und gelangte kaum noch in den Erdkern.
Offene Fragen zum Erdkern: Warum die Spur am Kīlauea noch kein Beweis ist
Einen direkten Beweis dafür, dass der schwere Kohlenstoff am Kīlauea aus dem Erdkern stammt, liefern die Gesteinsproben allerdings nicht. Der berechnete Ausgangswert schwankt um plus/minus zwei Promille, zudem lässt sich allein anhand dieser Messwerte nicht ausschließen, dass der Kohlenstoff aus einer anderen Quelle im tiefen Erdinneren stammt.
„Wir brauchen weitere Messungen“, mahnt deshalb auch Studienleiter Moussallam zur Zurückhaltung. Bestätigen künftige Analysen diese Annahme, gelangt Kohlenstoff aus dem Eisenkern der Erde über Vulkane an die Oberfläche und schließlich in lebende Organismen.

South Africa’s Cell C buys mobile virtual network operator
Cell C, the South African telecoms operator, has acquired Melon Group, the owner of Melon Mobile, a South African mobile virtual network operator (MVNO). The companies did not disclose the financial terms, and Melon will continue operating as a separate business under its existing management.
Explain like I’m new here: Cell C has played the infrastructure-provider role for many mobile brands by providing network access that other companies use to sell their own mobile services. It hosts 5.71 million MVNO lines, including Capitec Connect, the mobile service offered by South African bank Capitec, and FNB Connect, the equivalent offering from First National Bank. Cell C estimates that it serves 80–85% of South Africa’s MVNO market.
What does Cell C get out of this? Melon brings more than 100,000 customers to the deal. It was also among the early South African MVNOs to offer eSIMs, which let users activate mobile services without inserting a physical SIM card. Cell C also gets Melon’s technology. In March 2025, Melon launched Melon Digital, a mobile virtual network enabler (MVNE) that allows other companies to launch and manage their own mobile services without building the systems themselves.
What’s interesting: Melon originally launched using MTN’s network and will remain a multi-network operator after the acquisition. Customers currently using MTN will not automatically move to Cell C. So, Cell C now owns a mobile business that still relies partly on its biggest rival’s infrastructure.

Vodafone records $3.3 billion gain from Safaricom deal
Vodafone’s latest Safaricom deal has produced two eye-catching figures: KES 272.4 billion ($2.1 billion) spent and KES 430.2 billion ($3.3 billion) gained. But there’s a catch. The second amount isn’t money that landed in Vodafone’s bank account.
The British telecoms giant recorded the KES 430.2 billion ($3.3 billion) accounting gain after its South African subsidiary, Vodacom, increased its stake in Kenya’s Safaricom from 35% to approximately 55%. 
Explain like I’m new here: In June, Vodacom bought 15% of Safaricom from the Kenyan government for KES 204.3 billion ($1.57 billion) and another 5% from its parent company, Vodafone, for KES 68.1 billion ($524 million). The purchases gave Vodacom control of Safaricom. And in accounting, gaining control changes how a company reports an investment. 
Previously, Vodacom treated Safaricom as an associate, recording its share of the Kenyan company’s profits. Now, it can include Safaricom’s full financial results in its group accounts. Accounting rules also required Vodafone to reassess the value of its existing investment, producing the KES 430.2 billion gain. 
Between the lines: This was a one-off gain on paper, not profit from selling airtime or processing M-Pesa transactions. Vodacom separately reported a KES 181.8 billion ($1.4 billion) accounting gain from the same takeover. Even with its larger gain, Vodafone recorded an overall €3.6 billion ($4 billion) loss for the six months ended September, weighed down by charges elsewhere in its business. 
State of play: There’s also a legal complication. In September, Kenya’s High Court nullified the government’s 15% stake sale, ruling that the transaction’s effect on Safaricom’s ownership and control had not been adequately disclosed. The decision is under appeal, and Vodacom retains control while the case continues. 
Zoom out: The bigger prize is control of Safaricom’s telecoms business, M-PESA operations, and Ethiopian expansion. Vodafone has booked its accounting gain, but the ownership battle isn’t over. A favourable balance sheet entry is one thing; keeping control of the business behind it is another.

MultiChoice wants ISPs to block pirate streams
Imagine paying for a football match on a streaming website, only to discover later that the service is illegal. Some pirate platforms look so legitimate that customers don’t even realise they’re paying the wrong people.
South African broadcaster MultiChoice wants to make those services harder to access. The DStv owner is lobbying the Independent Communications Authority of South Africa (ICASA), the country’s telecom regulator, to require Internet service providers (ISPs) to block websites distributing pirated content.
Explain like I’m new here: MultiChoice has been fighting online piracy for years. The problem is that many illegal streaming services operate outside South Africa, where local copyright enforcement has limited reach. Even when one website disappears, its operators can simply move to another address.
How would it work? MultiChoice wants dynamic site-blocking. Instead of pursuing a fresh court order each time a pirate website changes its address, ISPs could update their blocklists to stop customers from reaching the replacement site.
State of play: South Africa’s existing laws don’t clearly require ISPs to block access to these websites. Parliamentary advisers raised the issue last week, suggesting that ICASA explore interim regulations while lawmakers consider changes to existing legislation. No new blocking requirement has been approved.
Between the lines: MultiChoice is changing where it applies pressure. If a pirate operator overseas ignores a takedown request, a South African ISP is much easier for local regulators to reach.
But ISPs have concerns of their own. Blocking an IP address can accidentally cut off legitimate websites sharing that address. Industry body ISPA wants clear laws and judicial oversight before providers are required to decide what customers can access.
Zoom out: An industry-backed study on piracy’s economic impact is due on December 7. Its findings could strengthen the case for tougher enforcement, but stopping piracy without blocking innocent websites will require more than a list of addresses.

Botswana plans satellite-to-phone service for 2027
Botswana Telecommunications Corporation (BTC), the country’s state-owned telecoms operator, plans to launch BTC Satellite in partnership with Starlink, the satellite internet business owned by Elon Musk’s SpaceX, in early 2027. The service will let compatible smartphones connect directly to Starlink satellites, without requiring users to buy a satellite dish or separate equipment.
Explain like I’m new here: Starlink already has a presence in Botswana. The Botswana Communications Regulatory Authority granted the company a commercial operating licence in May 2024, and it launched its broadband service in August that year. BTC Satellite will extend that relationship into mobile connectivity.
BTC says the service will target gaps in places such as the Central Kalahari, wildlife conservation corridors and remote border areas. Users are expected to access services such as SMS, maps, WhatsApp calls and light browsing.
Africa is embracing direct-to-phone: Airtel Africa and Starlink launched Starlink Mobile in the Democratic Republic of Congo in August. The service reached Uganda in September, granting eligible Airtel customers access through a free introductory trial and qualifying data bundles.
In 2023, satellite company Lynk Global signed an agreement with Vodafone Ghana to extend mobile coverage to subscribers using its satellites. Vodacom is also eyeing a 2027 launch of direct-to-phone services in South Africa.
Although direct-to-phone services could help telecoms operators reach people in remote locations without the cost of building mobile towers across difficult terrain, it depends on compatible smartphones and operator integration. Not every phone will work, and users may need to update their devices to access it.

articles.title: En 2027, Netflix hace desaparecer más de 80 series originales. Entre ellas, una magnífica trilogía fantástica de Guillermo del Toro
articles.text:
Netflix tiene previsto retirar en 2027 decenas de series y películas que estrenó precedidas por su logo. La trilogía de series animadas de fantasía de Guillermo del Toro para Dreamworks, 'Bloodline', 'Alias Grace' o 'Vis a vis' ya tienen fecha de salida, y hay un motivo muy claro para todo ello: la eterna confusión entre las series de Netflix que son propiedad de la plataforma y las que no, aunque todas comparten la etiqueta Netflix Original.
Fecha de caducidad. Antes de nada conviene concretar un par de detalles. Primero, este es el recuento anual de la web What's on Netflix: 84 Netflix Originals, series, películas y especiales que tienen su salida prevista a lo largo de 2027. La web sigue el catálogo estadounidense, así que las fechas pueden variar en España, además de que renovaciones de última hora, habituales entre plataformas, pueden prolongar estas fechas. Netflix, como siempre, no ha comentado estas hipotéticas retiradas, así que estamos ante datos no oficiales.
Más datos. La propia Netflix cuenta que licencia series y películas de estudios de todo el mundo y que, cuando un contrato vence, comprueba si los derechos siguen disponibles y si la audiencia del título en cada región compensa lo que cuesta renovarlo. Y finalmente: existen diferentes clases de Original, y solo las series que la plataforma desarrolla y posee enteras, como 'Stranger Things' o 'Los Bridgerton', carecen de fecha de caducidad. Series emblemáticas de Netflix como 'House of Cards' o 'Orange is the New Black' no son de Netflix, por mucho que las entendamos como abanderadas de la plataforma.
Arcadia se desmonta. Quizás la ausencia que más nos duele: el 21 de julio desaparecerán a la vez 'Trollhunters', 'Los 3 de abajo' y 'Magos', las tres series de 'Cuentos de Arcadia' que Del Toro ideó para DreamWorks Animation. La primera llegó a Netflix el 23 de diciembre de 2016 gracias a un acuerdo de producción con el estudio, que conserva los personajes y hoy pertenece por completo a NBCUniversal. De esa alianza salió también 'Fast & Furious: Espías a todo gas', que se irá el 7 de noviembre.
Cosecha de 2017. Sony Pictures Television posee 'Bloodline', cuya última temporada se estrenó el 26 de mayo de 2017 y saldrá el 26 de mayo de 2027, así como 'The Get Down', el musical de Baz Luhrmann que se despide el 7 de abril, justo diez años después del estreno de su segunda temporada. 'La increíble Jessica James', que Netflix compró tras Sundance por más de tres millones de dólares, saldrá el 28 de julio, la misma fecha en que se estrenó.
España no. Vamos con algunas producciones españolas. Salen 'Vis a vis' el 20 de abril, que es de Antena 3; 'Merlí. Sapere Aude' el 1 de junio; 'La cocinera de Castamar', de Atresmedia y Buendía Estudios, el 25 de junio: y 'Las del hockey' el 23 de julio, una serie de TV3 de la que se dijo que Netflix la acogería en todo el mundo. En estos casos sí que vemos posible una renovación en territorio español, especialmente de éxitos como 'Vis a vis'. Durante años, la estrategia de Netflix fue la de comprar fuera de Estados Unidos la distribución de series locales, lo que permitió a Netflix presentar como propio un catálogo que en cada país tenía distintos dueños.
Lo sigue haciendo. Esta política no es, para nada, algo que Netflix haya dejado de hacer. El 30 de julio, AMC Global Media anunció que había cedido a Netflix los derechos de todo el universo de 'The Walking Dead', con sus siete series y 371 episodios, por 500 millones de dólares durante cinco años, tras los que los derechos volverían a AMC. Es lo que acaba de suceder con 'Bloodline', por ejemplo, y es un recurso muy habitual de Netflix mientras se esfuerza por sacar a la luz franquicias nuevas y propias.
El auténtico problema. Series excelentes como la adaptación de Margaret Atwood 'Alias Grace' corren el riesgo de desaparecer de la parrilla de Netflix (esta en concreto, el 3 de noviembre de 2027) y que les pase como a la también extraordinaria 'The End of the F***ing World', que se esfumó el 4 de noviembre. El problema: aunque hay excepciones, la mayoría de estas series no tienen edición en formato físico, y cuando desaparecen, desaparecen de verdad. Una auténtica pena para quien quiera atesorar sus series favoritas cuando no hablamos, de producciones que calan en el mainstream como 'Stranger Things', 'Miércoles' o 'Los Bridgerton'.

articles.title: Palo Alto Networks Patches Fragnesia Flaw Used to Root Firewalls
articles.text:
Palo Alto Networks on Tuesday announced PAN-OS updates that patch the Fragnesia Linux kernel vulnerability exploited to root its firewalls.
Tracked as CVE-2026-46300, Fragnesia was disclosed in May 2026 as a privilege escalation bug in the kernel’s XFRM ESP-in-TCP subsystem. It allows unprivileged attackers to overwrite sensitive system files to gain root permissions.
On October 26, cybersecurity firm Dream warned that a Chinese-speaking threat actor successfully exploited the critical PHP2Shell bugs and the Linux kernel weakness to hack two servers of a US government-affiliated organization.
As part of the AI-assisted campaign, the attackers compromised 25 servers (24 firewalls and one internal firewall management server), exploiting PHP2Shell to gain remote code execution (RCE), and executing a Fragnesia exploit to deploy webshells with root privileges.
On October 29, Palo Alto Networks confirmed that the threat actor hit PAN-OS firewalls with management interfaces exposed to the internet in attacks chaining PHP2Shell with Fragnesia.
By October 30, the company had released patches for PHP2Shell across all supported PAN-OS versions, closing the known initial-access path.
“If you are running a fixed PAN-OS listed in the CVE-2026-109618 [PHP2Shell] advisory, you are protected,” Palo Alto Networks notes in a Tuesday advisory.
Regardless, the company released new PAN-OS versions that address CVE-2026-46300: 12.2.4-h3, 12.1.10-h6, 12.1.7-h15, 12.1.4-h15, 11.2.16-h3, 11.2.13-h6, 11.2.10-h19, 11.2.7-h25, 11.2.4-h25, 11.1.16-h6, 11.1.13-h18, 11.1.10-h38, 11.1.7-h14, 11.1.6-h42, 11.1.4-h40, 10.2.18-h15, 10.2.16-h14, 10.2.13-h29, 10.2.10-h45, and 10.2.7-h41.
Palo Alto Networks recommends applying the fixes for Fragnesia, although the only known way to exploit it against PAN-OS is to first exploit PHP2Shell via an internet-exposed management interface.
The company also recommends not allowing direct access to the management interface from the web. Instead, users should only allow access from the management network or route the access via a VPN.
“Exploitation of CVE-2026-46300 has been observed targeting the Palo Alto Networks management interface exposed to the internet,” Palo Alto Networks notes.

articles.title: Tiny flaws in diamonds could unlock a quantum computing revolution
articles.text:
Tiny flaws in diamonds could unlock a quantum computing revolution
By treating qubits like individual molecules, scientists can now predict their behavior faster and more accurately
- Date:
  November 13, 2026
- Source:
  Princeton University
- Summary:
  Scientists have discovered a faster way to identify diamond-based materials that could power quantum computers and sensors at room temperature. The breakthrough has already revealed promising new quantum building blocks that could help unlock computing capabilities far beyond those of today's supercomputers.
- Share:
A new computational technique could accelerate the search for diamond materials capable of powering future quantum computers and highly sensitive sensors. Developed by a researcher at the U.S. Department of Energy's (DOE) Princeton Plasma Physics Laboratory (PPPL), the method makes it much easier to identify promising materials for quantum technology, potentially opening the door to advances across many areas of science.
The approach has already revealed new candidates for quantum computing and sensing applications. The findings were recently published in ACS Central Science and have attracted attention from other researchers in the field.
One of the biggest challenges in developing quantum technology is finding materials that can maintain delicate quantum states under practical conditions. Many candidates require extremely low temperatures to function reliably. Diamond materials stand out because certain quantum properties can remain useful even at room temperature.
This capability could help advance technologies that are important to national research priorities and the development of next-generation computing. Quantum sensors promise levels of sensitivity and precision beyond those of conventional instruments, while quantum computers could eventually solve certain extraordinarily complex problems much faster than today's most powerful supercomputers.
Why Imperfect Diamonds Could Be the Key to Quantum Computing
Although diamonds are made of carbon atoms, a flawless diamond crystal is not enough to create a useful quantum computing system. The key lies in tiny irregularities within the crystal structure.
These imperfections, known as defects, can occur when a carbon atom is absent from its normal position, when another element replaces a carbon atom, or when both changes occur together. The atoms surrounding these defects can form qubits, the basic units used to store and process quantum information in quantum computers and sensors.
Finding the most useful defects, however, has been difficult. Accurately modeling their quantum behavior traditionally requires enormous computational resources, making it challenging to evaluate large numbers of possible candidates.
A Simpler Way to Discover Better Diamond Qubits
Mark Martirez, a staff research scientist at PPPL, developed a way to dramatically reduce the complexity of these calculations. Instead of simulating a much larger diamond structure, he isolates a small region containing just 16 to 30 atoms around a defect.
By "carving out" this tiny atomic cluster and treating it like a separate molecule, Martirez can use powerful computational methods that chemists have spent decades refining. These established techniques make it possible to analyze the quantum properties of diamond defects much more efficiently without sacrificing the high level of accuracy needed for the calculations.
"Because we're treating the qubits as molecules, the cost of calculating these defects is equivalent to the cost of just modeling a simple molecule," Martirez said. "This method really opened the floodgates" in terms of how qubits can be assessed.
The new technique allows researchers to calculate how different qubits respond to laser light and microwave pulses far more quickly than before. Using this approach, the team identified promising defects involving boron and oxygen that could serve as new types of qubits.
New Diamond Defects Reveal a Spectrum of Quantum Colors
Light plays an important role in how scientists interact with diamond qubits. Researchers use lasers and microwave pulses to manipulate their quantum states and retrieve stored information.
Much of the previous work in this area has centered on a defect known as the nitrogen-vacancy center. This structure forms when a nitrogen atom takes the place of a carbon atom in a diamond crystal, while an adjacent position that would normally contain another carbon atom remains empty.
Under laser illumination, this type of defect can emit red light when it occupies a particular quantum state.
The newly investigated defects offer different optical properties. Oxygen defects can produce blue light, while those involving boron emit ultraviolet light.
These differences could make it possible to combine several types of qubits within a single quantum device. Because each type responds differently to light, researchers might be able to interact with one group of qubits without disturbing another.
"One could imagine, then, combining different qubits of different responses, so you can basically probe one qubit but not the other," Martirez said.
Beyond identifying new candidates, the findings suggest a broader change in how researchers approach quantum technology. Diamond qubits have traditionally been studied primarily through physics, but understanding their underlying chemistry could provide additional ways to design them.
Martirez believes that researchers could eventually engineer qubits for particular functions using principles similar to those applied when chemists create specialized molecules, including compounds designed for new medications.
How Quantum Chemistry Could Transform Future Research
The potential benefits extend well beyond the development of quantum computers themselves. Martirez sees an intriguing possibility in which advances made possible by quantum chemistry eventually lead to quantum technologies that help improve the field of chemistry.
In other words, quantum chemistry could develop the very tools needed to "enrich itself" in the coming decades.
A practical quantum system containing multiple qubits could make molecular calculations substantially more accurate. That would allow scientists to study increasingly complex chemical structures, including large biological molecules and proteins, with a level of detail that is difficult to achieve using conventional methods.
"We could describe larger molecules, biomolecules, proteins and everything like that in a more accurate way, and that could improve all the chemical-adjacent industries, such as pharmaceutical science and materials science. Even our fundamental understanding of molecular systems could be enriched."
Such improvements could have far-reaching implications for pharmaceutical development, materials research, and the fundamental study of how molecules behave.
Martirez also hopes the research will encourage more chemists to explore solid-state physics. Although building advanced quantum computers is often viewed as a challenge primarily for physicists, he argues that chemistry offers valuable expertise that could help accelerate progress.
"At this moment in time, there's a great emphasis on building the first state-of-the-art qubit computer," he said. "But it's not just physicists who should be participating in this research. Chemists have decades of developed intuition about chemical systems that could be easily translated into understanding defects in solids as well."
By bringing these disciplines together, scientists may be able to develop more effective ways to discover, understand, and eventually engineer the quantum materials needed for future technologies.
The research was funded through PPPL's Laboratory Directed Research and Development program under prime contract number DE-AC02-09CH11466, with additional support from the DOE Office of Science, Office of Fusion Energy Sciences.
Story Source:
Materials provided by Princeton University. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
Journal Reference:
- John Mark P. Martirez. A Chemist’sGuide to Solid-State Qubits: DiamondColor Centers as Embedded Vacancy-Centered Molecules. ACS Central Science, 2026; 12 (10): 1578 DOI: 10.1021/acscentsci.6c00548

articles.title: FCC signs off on SpaceX’s plan to put up to 1 million data center satellites into space
articles.text:
In an announcement on Wednesday, the FCC says it authorized SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million AI chip-equipped satellites as part of the Elon Musk-owned company’s “Starmind” initiative. With several others also pursuing the idea of putting AI data centers in space, including Google and Blue Origin, this is the first approval the agency has granted for a full “constellation” of AI satellites.
FCC signs off on SpaceX’s plan to put up to 1 million data center satellites into space
SpaceX aims to power AI capabilities here on Earth with its ‘Starmind’ constellation.
The FCC’s approval requires SpaceX to deploy at least one satellite by 2033, and meet the 1 million satellite milestone by 2040. The FCC also deferred SpaceX’s request to dispose of satellites located above 600km in space “graveyard” orbits, rather than having them burn up in the Earth’s atmosphere, saying the company hasn’t provided “sufficient information” about its disposal process plans.
SpaceX has described its Starmind project as a way to “capture solar energy in space to power” AI capabilities on Earth. The company says Starmind will transmit data to Earth using high-speed lasers that connect to Starlink. It plans to produce chips for its satellites at an upcoming Terafab facility.
Google has already taken its first steps toward putting compute into space, with the launch of a “Project Suncatcher” AI server satellite last month. Jeff Bezos’ Blue Origin will carry out the first dedicated heavy-lift launch for Project Suncatcher in 2029.

articles.title: Goldman Sachs, Societe Generale buy Rs 920-Cr stake in Lenskart
articles.text:
Goldman Sachs, Societe Generale buy Rs 920-Cr stake in Lenskart
The investors acquired a total of 1,26,97,702 equity shares on Monday, amounting to a 0.73% stake in Lenskart, as per the stock exchange data.
Global financial giants Goldman Sachs and Societe Generale together bought nearly a 1% stake in eyewear retailer Lenskart Solutions for Rs 920 crore through separate block deals on the NSE.
The investors acquired a total of 1,26,97,702 equity shares on Monday, amounting to a 0.73% stake in Lenskart, as per the stock exchange data.
Goldman Sachs through its affiliates purchased 65.21 lakh shares in Gurugram-based Lenskart, while Societe Generale (SocGen) acquired 61.76 lakh shares of the company at an average price of Rs 725 apiece on the NSE.
The transactions amounted to a total value of Rs 920.58 crore.
On the selling side, San Francisco-based Steadview Capital Management offloaded an equal number of shares through its two affiliates at the same price on the National Stock Exchange (NSE).
Following the stake sale, global investment firm Steadview's holding in Lenskart has come down to 2.58% from 3.31%.
Shares of Lenskart fell nearly 4% to close at Rs 715.90 apiece on Monday.
Earlier this month, US-based Goldman Sachs and French financial services group Societe Generale were among the investors that acquired shares of Lenskart from Japanese technology investor SoftBank for Rs 1,896 crore.

articles.title: 1Password é invadida por hackers e tem dados de clientes roubados
articles.text:
A 1Password confirmou que hackers invadiram sistemas internos da empresa e roubaram informações de clientes. Segundo a companhia, porém, o ataque não deu acesso aos cofres digitais que armazenam senhas, chaves secretas e outras credenciais dos usuários.
A invasão foi identificada na última quinta-feira (19). De acordo com a empresa, o criminoso conseguiu acessar a conta corporativa de um funcionário no GitHub, plataforma utilizada pela 1Password para armazenar e compartilhar códigos-fonte.
Com esse acesso, o invasor inseriu código malicioso em servidores internos da companhia e conseguiu baixar informações de clientes. Entre os dados obtidos estão nomes, endereços de e-mail usados para entrar nas contas, datas de criação dos perfis e registros do último acesso.
A empresa afirma que os cofres de senhas não ficaram disponíveis ao invasor em nenhum momento. A 1Password também diz não ter acesso às senhas das contas nem às chaves secretas utilizadas para embaralhar as credenciais armazenadas — proteção que impede a própria companhia de visualizar esse conteúdo.
Os aplicativos e as extensões do serviço também não foram afetados, segundo a empresa.
Leia mais:
- Hackers invadem CIA e agência de inteligência dos EUA e expõem dados
- Tesouro dos EUA tira sistemas do ar após acesso não autorizado
- Sabe o aparelho antigo que ainda funciona bem? É uma porta para hackers
Origem do ataque ainda é desconhecida
- A 1Password não explicou como o invasor conseguiu acessar a conta corporativa do funcionário;
- Também não foram divulgados o número de clientes afetados nem informações sobre eventuais notificações às pessoas que tiveram dados expostos;
- A empresa tampouco informou se recebeu alguma comunicação ou exigência dos responsáveis pelo ataque;
- A 1Password, sediada em Toronto (Canadá), afirma atender milhões de consumidores e mais de 200 mil empresas;
- Seus produtos são utilizados para armazenar senhas, credenciais de acesso, informações de cartões de pagamento e outros dados sensíveis.
Rodrigo Mozelli é jornalista formado pela Universidade Metodista de São Paulo (UMESP) e, atualmente, é redator do Olhar Digital.

articles.title: Vous avez jusqu’au 28 novembre pour tester gratuitement la conduite autonome de Xpeng dans les rues de Paris
articles.text:
Comme nombre de personnes, la conduite autonome doit certainement vous intriguer. Comment fonctionne un tel dispositif ? Est-ce uniquement du marketing ? De la science-fiction seulement opérante sur circuit fermé ? Ou bien une toute nouvelle façon d’aborder l’automobile ? Voilà autant de questions qui pourraient enfin trouver leurs réponses grâce à Xpeng, qui organise des sessions d’essais auxquelles vous pouvez prendre part.
Il suffit pour cela de réserver un créneau, puis de se rendre à la boutique Xpeng de Paris située au 10 Boulevard Gouvion-Saint-Cyr. Jusqu’à trois personnes pourront ainsi expérimenter le système Next Generation Pilot (NGP) de la marque, concurrençant frontalement le FSD de Tesla. Cependant, il ne faudra pas tarder, l’opération prenant fin le 28 novembre. Ce serait tout de même dommage de passer à côté.
30 minutes dans les rues de Paris pour découvrir la conduite autonome
Surtout que c’est la première fois que la marque organise ce genre d’événement hors de Chine. He Xiaopeng, le PDG d’Xpeng, tient d’ailleurs à le souligner : « nous lançons des essais publics du NGP ici à Paris. Nous devenons ainsi la première marque chinoise à le faire en Europe. Nous sommes ici en Europe, pour l’Europe, avec l’Europe ». De quoi avoir un avant-goût du futur pendant 30 minutes de roulage ?
Partiellement, car un représentant de la marque sera toujours assis derrière le volant, au cas où… Le constructeur a pourtant mis le paquet, en sortant de son coffre à jouets le modèle ayant le plus gros potentiel de ventes en Europe, le SUV L03. Présenté en version haut de gamme Performance Ultra, l’engin est équipé en série de deux puces Turing d’une puissance de calcul de 750 TOPS. C’est ce duo qui permet la conduite entièrement autonome.
Caméras, capteurs et puces Turing : la recette du SUV L03
Et contrairement à Tesla, Xpeng s’appuie non seulement sur des caméras, mais également sur une flopée de capteurs pour assurer une bonne perception de l’environnement. Il est vrai que BYD avait déjà proposé une chose similaire en marge du Mondial de Paris. Mais l’expérience était uniquement réservée à la presse. Et il valait mieux, vu ce que nous avons constaté de nos propres yeux.
Sortie abrupte d’un giratoire, non-respect d’un passage piéton, manque d’anticipation sur les obstacles… Le système maison God’s Eye ne porte pas encore bien son nom ! Côté Xpeng, cela devrait donc mieux se passer, même si l’on suppose que la marque a soigneusement sélectionné son itinéraire pour ne pas trop mettre son NGP en difficulté. Précisons que l’utilisation du système n’est pas encore autorisée pour les clients. Elle le sera potentiellement plus tard.

articles.title: Karnataka clears Pixxel’s Rs 350 Cr satellite manufacturing project
articles.text:
Karnataka clears Pixxel’s Rs 350 Cr satellite manufacturing project
Welcoming the company’s decision to expand its manufacturing operations in Karnataka, Patil said it reaffirmed Bengaluru’s position as a leading hub for aerospace, space technology and advanced manufacturing.
The Karnataka government has approved Bengaluru-based space technology company Pixxel’s proposal to set up a satellite manufacturing facility in the state with an investment of Rs 350 crore, State Industries Minister MB Patil said on Tuesday.
The proposal, involving an application for six acres of land, was received on November 3 and cleared by the State Level Single Window Clearance Committee within two weeks, he said.
Welcoming the company’s decision to expand its manufacturing operations in Karnataka, Patil said it reaffirmed Bengaluru’s position as a leading hub for aerospace, space technology and advanced manufacturing.
“We are delighted that Pixxel has chosen Karnataka for its next phase of expansion. The state government is committed to extending all necessary support to ensure the timely implementation of this project,” he said in a release.
The minister said the government had been engaging with Pixxel over the past several months to understand its expansion plans, address its requirements and facilitate the investment.
Karnataka has a strong ecosystem of skilled talent, research institutions, technology companies and advanced manufacturing capabilities, he said.
The government would continue to engage with Pixxel and other emerging space technology companies and extend support to strengthen the state’s position as a leading aerospace and space technology hub, Patil added.
He reiterated the government’s commitment to attracting investments in emerging technologies, promoting ease of doing business and creating a conducive environment for innovation-led manufacturing.

articles.title: Microsoft confirms authentication issues after November updates
articles.text:
Microsoft has confirmed that customers may experience authentication issues after installing November security updates that address a high-severity remote code execution vulnerability.
Tracked as CVE-2026-118737, this security flaw was found in the Windows Remote Procedure Call Runtime and stems from a timing-dependent authentication weakness that unauthenticated attackers can exploit to remotely execute code without user interaction on unpatched systems.
Microsoft says the November security updates represent the first phase of NTLM message-signing improvements, which reduce exposure to relay attacks by ensuring authenticated NTLM sessions always establish a cryptographic session key and negotiate real message signing.
However, as Microsoft explained in an updated support document, the new security improvements introduced to address this vulnerability may also cause authentication failures on patched devices.
"Microsoft is aware of compatibility issues affecting some third-party apps and devices, including authentication proxy servers, single sign-on (SSO) solutions, and application packaging solutions that use NTLM authentication," it said.
"This issue can occur when such a proxy device does not correctly implement the NTLM protocol. For example, an affected device might set the NTLMSSP_NEGOTIATE_TARGET_INFO flag in its CHALLENGE_MESSAGE but provide an empty or incomplete TargetInfo field."
While a fix is not yet available, Microsoft said affected apps and devices return an NTLMSSP_CHALLENGE message with an empty "Target Info List" in network trace signatures or Target Machine fields with "Not Found" values in event logs.
As a temporary workaround, the company advised customers to go through the following procedure on affected systems:
- Set the ClientAllowUnsignedNtlm REG_DWORD registry value under HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\MSV1_0 to 1 (the value used for clients that do not offer SIGN)
- Check whether the affected device or application supports a configuration that uses Kerberos authentication or whether the vendor provides a software or firmware update compatible with the NTLM signing requirements introduced by CVE-2026-118737.
- If neither option is available, contact the device or software vendor to request an update that complies with the NTLM protocol requirements described in 3.1.5.1.2 Client Receives a CHALLENGE_MESSAGE from the Server.
However, Microsoft said the ClientAllowUnsignedNtlm registry setting is a short-term solution and may be removed in the future.
"Updating the affected product or using a compatible authentication configuration is the recommended long-term resolution," it noted.
Since it addressed installation issues affecting the November 2026 cumulative updates, Microsoft has also confirmed that this month's security updates are causing Windows activation failures and SQL Server performance issues.
The company is also investigating a known issue that may break printing documents with complex formatting for customers who have installed the latest Windows updates.

articles.title: Pour le Black Friday 2026, la centrale vapeur Philips Série 7000 passe à 299,99 €
articles.text:
Black Friday 2026 : La centrale vapeur Philips PerfectCare Série 7000 PSG7300 à 299,99 €
À l'occasion du Black Friday, la centrale vapeur Philips PerfectCare Série 7000 PSG7300 passe à 299,99 € chez Amazon, soit une baisse d'environ 6 % et 19,00 € d'économie. Efficace sur les tissus épais grâce à son déclenchement automatique de la vapeur, elle affiche une note actuelle de 4,5/5 dans nos tests.
Philips propose avec sa PerfectCare Série 7000 PSG7300 une centrale vapeur pensée pour automatiser l'envoi de vapeur selon les mouvements du fer. L'appareil vise un repassage fluide sur tous types de textiles sans exiger de réglage manuel de température entre un linge épais et une matière délicate. Ce modèle s'est distingué lors de son passage dans notre labo par la simplicité de son guidage et l'efficacité de son lissage.
À l'occasion du Black Friday, la centrale vapeur descend à 299,99 € chez Amazon, soit environ 6 % de moins que le prix moyen constaté ces 30 derniers jours (318,99 €). Cela représente une économie de 19,00 €.
Une vapeur automatique pensée pour fluidifier le repassage
Le principal intérêt de cette référence réside dans son capteur de mouvement, capable de libérer la vapeur dès que le fer glisse sur la planche. L'utilisateur repasse ainsi sans maintenir la gâchette enfoncée en continu. Lors de notre test complet, un jean épais et une chemise en lin sont ressortis parfaitement lisses sans intervention sur le thermostat. La pression de 8.5 bar(s) et le débit continu de 170 g/min assurent une pénétration efficace au cœur des fibres.
Le confort de manipulation repose aussi sur un fer maniable qui se verrouille fermement sur son socle de transport. En cas de pli particulièrement marqué, la fonction pressing pousse ponctuellement le débit à 650 g/min pour venir à bout des tissus les plus rêches.
Philips PerfectCare Série 7000 PSG7300
Points forts
- Vapeur à déclenchement automatique ou manuel.
- Verrouillage du fer sur le socle.
- Fer assez léger.
- Bons résultats de repassage des tissus épais.
Points faibles
- Pas de position debout pour le fer.
- Consommation élevée.
- Pompe de remplissage peu discrète.
- Pas d'enrouleur de cordon d'alimentation.
Quelques concessions d'ergonomie et d'énergie
Cette efficacité s'accompagne de particularités matérielles à connaître avant l'achat. Le fer ne dispose pas de talon pour tenir en position verticale, ce qui oblige à le reposer directement sur sa base entre deux manipulations. La pompe de remplissage émet un bruit intermittent facilement audible, et l'appareil affiche une consommation électrique élevée. Ces points restent sans conséquence pour qui cherche avant tout un défroissage rapide de pièces difficiles, mais ils demanderont une habitude à ceux qui repassent régulièrement de petites sessions.
Philips PerfectCare Elite-Plus GC9682/80 : l'autre option face au Philips PerfectCare Série 7000 PSG7300
Dans la même marque, la PerfectCare Elite-Plus GC9682/80 se positionne comme une référence plus haut de gamme par son ergonomie générale pensée pour réduire le temps de travail sur la planche. Elle affiche une note maximale à ce jour dans nos tests avec 5 étoiles, face aux 4,5/5 de la PSG7300.
Son tarif actuel est inférieur de 0,99 € par rapport à la PerfectCare Série 7000 PSG7300, ce qui place les deux appareils au même niveau de prix. La Philips PerfectCare Elite-Plus GC9682/80 prend l'avantage avec sa note supérieure et sa vitesse d'exécution globale face à une PSG7300 qui conserve l'intérêt de sa gestion automatique de la vapeur.
Philips PerfectCare Elite-Plus GC9682/80
Points forts
- Centrale sans réglage.
- Joli design.
- Longueur des câbles d'alimentation et tuyau vapeur.
- Efficacité de défroissage et fonction pressing.
Points faibles
- Poids.
- Pas de pose verticale.
- La couleur or qui peut déplaire.

articles.title: Amazon está negociando con Meta abrirle la puerta a Muse: el verdadero problema es que una IA no se para a ver anuncios
articles.text:
A finales de septiembre, quien pedía a Muse que comprase algo en Amazon se encontraba con un muro que el agente no podía traspasar. Según el gigante del ecommerce, un agente de IA no autorizado incumplía las condiciones de uso de su tienda, que estaba reservada solo para los usuarios humanos. El agente de IA de Meta llevaba solo dos semanas en el mercado y ya tenía una puerta cerrada. No una puerta cualquiera. Ni más ni menos que la del principal vendedor minorista a nivel global.
Según adelanta una exclusiva de Fortune, dos meses después, las dos compañías hablan de volver a abrirla. Para Meta, Amazon es un importante escaparate que su agente no puede visitar. Para Amazon, el agente de IA de Meta tira por tierra toda su estrategia publicitaria porque los agentes no atienden a anuncios, se limitan a cumplir sus tareas e irse. Toda la industria está tomando notas de cómo Amazon y Meta encuentran el equilibrio entre el uso de agentes de IA y rentabilidad publicitaria.
Un portazo con letra pequeña. Amazon justificó el bloqueo con un argumento recogido en su contrato con el usuario: el acceso de Muse rompe las condiciones que aceptan sus clientes. Según las alegaciones de Amazon, Muse no se identificaba correctamente como IA y que no gestionaba con diligencia los datos de los usuarios.
Son fallos técnicos que cualquier pacto técnico debería poder que resolverse en un par de reuniones. Pero el trasfondo es mucho más profundo. Lo que estaba en juego era todo el modelo de negocio comercial de Amazon tirado por tierra por el agente de IA de un tercero.
Lo que hay sobre la mesa. Según cuenta el reportaje de Fortune, las partes ya han mantenido varios encuentros para acercar posturas hablado varias veces pero hay dos puntos que estarían obstaculizando un acuerdo: los resultados de búsqueda y la publicidad. Andy Jassy, CEO de Amazon, aseguraba que no descarta abrir la tienda a agentes externos si hay un "buen intercambio de valor".
Amazon teme perder ingresos si un agente de Meta entra en su tienda, compra exactamente lo que le ha encargado su usuario y se va sin mostrar otras opciones alternativas al usuario. La compañía fundada por Jeff Bezos también teme que estos agentes debilitan su relación con el comprador alejándoles de la familiaridad con la marca. Los usuarios ya no sentirían que compran en Amazon, sino que es Muse quien les provee de lo que piden. Dónde se haya comprado pasa a ser secundario.
Anuncios que nadie ve. Según explicó Jassy en su última llamada de resultados con los accionistas para el tercer trimestre, "aún son pocos los clientes que compran de esta manera. Todavía no es ni óptima ni más cómoda", haciendo referencia al uso de agentes de IA como Muse en las compras del futuro. Añadió que esos agentes no explican el flojo resultado publicitario del tercer trimestre.
No es raro que Jassy quiera restar importancia a la visita de agentes de IA a su plataforma de ventas, cuando la compañía estaría preparando su propia "Alexa de compras": un agente de IA interno que se encarga de facilitar las compras a los usuarios de Amazon, pero mostrando otras sugerencias interesantes para el usuario. La función del agente parece ser la misma, pero está condicionada por los intereses de su dueño, que en unos es el usuario, mientras que en el otro es Amazon.
Meta quiere su comisión. Muse es el mayor éxito de consumo de Meta en el ámbito de la IA. Durante su presentación de resultados del tercer trimestre de 2026, Zuckerberg contó que más de diez millones de personas en EEUU y Canadá lo habían configurado desde su lanzamiento el 8 de septiembre. Realizar compras es su uso más extendido y la compra media que hace este agente supera los 200 dólares.
Meta planea cobrar una comisión al comercio minorista por cada venta que Muse ayude a cerrar. Con ese plan, cada tienda que se suma le da más ingresos posibles. Con Shopify y Walmart prepara un estándar propio que establece cómo hablan los agentes de los usuarios con los de las tiendas. Para no dejar escapar ese pedazo de su pastel en ventas, Amazon tendría que aceptar un nuevo intermediario entre ella y sus clientes.
